sections.title: PHASEMATION Phase
sections.overview: A transistor-type phono equalizer amplifier developed by inheriting the design philosophy and musical expression of EA-1.The circuit configuration employs an all-stage symmetrical non-feedback amplifier.The first stage consists of a low-noise voltage-to-current conversion circuit with the complimentary service connection of a phase-correction FET (field-effect transistor). Since carefully selected elements are used and the operating point is determined by the self-bias operation, no bias circuit is required. This eliminates the inflow of noise and the deterioration factor of sound quality, enabling the original low-noise operation of the element.The second stage consists of a current amplification and voltage conversion circuit. The RIAA impedance element connected to the current output point gives the reproduction characteristics. This makes it a CR type equalizer circuit with no RIAA deviation up to the ultra-high frequency range, giving excellent transient characteristics.This circuit employs a circuit technique that achieves high precision without being affected by current variation errors and parameter variations of the amplifying element that depend on the output voltage. This circuit realizes excellent electrical characteristics comparable to those of a feedback amplifier despite being a non-feedback amplifier.The output buffer circuit uses an input bootstrap circuit to ensure high input impedance over a wide range, while the Darlington-connected output element provides sufficient current amplification and powerful drive for devices connected to the next stage.The power supply section uses an independent power transformer on the left and right and a shunt type local power supply. It provides an ideal power supply without parameter fluctuation due to power supply load, and channel separation is improved by minimizing circuit current loop.In addition, a large R-type transformer is used for the power transformer to minimize magnetic vibration and leakage flux by operating with a margin due to low magnetic flux density.The internal layout uses symmetrical dual monaural construction to achieve uniformity of the left and right channels.The power transformer is mounted directly to the brass round bar machined foot via a 5 mm thick baking plate, which is an insulator with high electrical and magnetic resistance, so that the vibration generated by the power transformer is not propagated to the chassis and is directly released to the ground.The chassis structure is vibration free, resonance free and interference free.The amplifier is mounted on an electromagnetically floating sub-chassis so as not to be affected by signals other than music signals and vibration. In addition, the chassis base and top cover are plated with copper on 1.2 mm and 1.6 mm thick steel plates, respectively, and coated with paint to ensure rigidity and reduce magnetic distortion.The front panel is made by cutting out aluminum of 6 mm thickness.Equipped with a full-fledged active subsonic filter with a cutoff frequency of 20Hz/40Hz.Machined gold plated terminals are used for input / output terminals.

sections.title: PHILIPS LHH500
sections.overview: A CD player using the bit stream method.The D/A converter uses the bit stream method.The conventional method method, 16 circuit elements (resistors) were used, but in the bit stream method, the analog amount is not represented by the amplitude of the pulse, but by the modulation method of representing it by the coarse / dense wave, and the D/A conversion is performed by a single switch circuit. This makes it possible to perform D/A conversion with high linearity without depending on the accuracy of the element.In the process of the bit stream method, the signal density is increased by 256 times higher oversampling, quantization noise is reduced by noise shaping, coarse / dense waves are formed by a pulse generator consisting of a pair of capacitors, and an analog signal is obtained by passing the coarse / dense waves through a low-pass filter.The LHH500 uses a bit stream D/A converter in differential mode.In differential mode, the left and right channels are fed to completely separate chips, and one chip receives the positive and negative phase components of one channel, and extracts the difference as an output to improve distortion, noise and channel separation.A CDM-4 mini die-cast mechanism is adopted for the mechanism part.This mechanism adopts a unique swing arm system with weights and balances placed at the rear, while further improving sound quality.Copper-plated die cast chassis is used for the chassis.The LHH500 uses copper plating to smooth out the flow of ground current and prevent noise from entering the signal. The LHH 200 uses copper plating to maximize this effect.A toroidal transformer is used for the power supply section.Toroidal transformers are circular transformers with a seamless core and have the advantage that the loss of the magnetic field through the core is very small. Therefore, even at the same voltage, a stronger magnetic field is generated, enabling high-density voltage conversion.In addition, the electrolytic capacitors that make up the power supply are of selected large-capacity type, ensuring a stable current supply.As an output terminal, a balanced output is mounted in addition to an unbalanced output.This balanced output is usually composed of an operational amplifier, but this one is equipped with a high-grade audio transformer using nickel core.As a result, the balanced output is directly converted into a balanced output without passing through an amplifying element, and high-purity signal transmission is possible.Equipped with large capacity FIFO.FIFO is the amount of memory used for error correction and jitter removal in first in first out. This memory is 8 times larger than the usual 8 frames (up to 64 frames). This allows for better error correction and compensation and more faithful music playback with powerful servo circuits.Wireless remote control is included.

sections.overview: A CD player developed to commemorate the 100th anniversary of Philips' founding.The TDA1547 "DAC7" is used for the D/A conversion section. The DAC7 is equipped with a complete differential circuit in the chip itself, eliminating interference between right and left and even harmonics, and realizing a high S/N ratio improvement.In addition, we have achieved a "double differential mode" with two DAC-7 devices for each channel, achieving higher quality than conventional differential processes.In addition, a newly developed digital filter and SAA7350, which functions as an excellent D/A converter even on its own, are used for the noise shaper.A CDM-4 mini die-cast mechanism has been adopted for the mechanism part.A unique swing arm with a weight balance placed at the rear is incorporated into a strong die-cast base to suppress external vibration and provide a stable trace.In addition, newly developed ICs for servo systems and decoders have been introduced, and error correction and jitter removal are also cleared by the large-capacity FIFO, enabling accurate reproduction.The power supply section is equipped with a large toroidal transformer and a selected high-capacity capacitor.In addition, by setting a dedicated power supply circuit for DAC7, the capability is brought out.The chassis is a die-cast chassis that achieves high vibration resistance and no resonance, and the entire chassis is plated with copper to prevent noise.It is also equipped with an E-SAC insulator that uses a new material with excellent shock absorption for the internal damper.The balanced output is equipped with a high-end audio transformer that uses nickel core, and is converted directly into a balanced output without passing through an amplifier.A dedicated remote controller is included.This remote control is equipped with a jog / shuttle controller to improve operability.Includes high-purity OFC cable and owner's plate.

sections.title: PHILIPS LHH1000
sections.overview:
600,000 (released in 1988)  543,000 (around 1989)

A CD player system consisting of three devices : a CD drive unit LHH1001, a D/A converter unit LHH1002, and a remote control unit LHH1003.The LHH1001 CD drive unit uses the CDM-1, which is also used in the LHH2000 CD drive unit. The CDM-1 is made of aluminum die-cast for the entire mechanism including the mechanism chassis, and demonstrates the unique swing arm drive mechanism of Philips and the tracing capability of the 1-beam laser pickup.High rigidity is achieved by mounting a copper-plated die-cast chassis and die-cast side panels. In addition, the entire body is made vibration-free and resonance-free with a 3-piece aluminum top cover and a large insulator with cement-filled die-cast legs and rubber spacers.A large toroidal transformer is used for the power supply. In addition, the signal circuit and servo circuit are separated from each other on a separate board, and a copper plated shield cover is provided to eliminate mutual interference.We also use carefully selected top-grade parts and a vibration-resistant glass epoxy board.Two types of digital outputs are installed : optical and coaxial.The D/A converter unit LHH1002 uses a 16-bit 4-times oversampling digital filter, and is equipped with the SAA7220P/B TDA1541A, an "A version" LSI that improves the matching between the digital filter and the D/A converter to improve accuracy. This LSI is an improvement on the conventional SAA7220 TDA1541, and greatly improves the reproducibility of analog waveforms at low levels of -70dB or less.The LHH1002 is equipped with an A-S1LSI specially selected for linearity, and realizes high-precision D/A conversion along with excellent phase characteristics due to L/R-independent 2 dac.The balanced output circuit consists of the same circuit as that used in the LHH2000 and parts with new technology. This output circuit is equipped with an output transformer to cut unnecessary bandwidth.Equipped with four digital inputs and supporting two modes of 44.1 kHz and 48 kHz, it is possible to connect various devices.In addition, it is equipped with a jitter absorption circuit to deal with jitter (fluctuation of signal with respect to time axis) which is a problem in optical transmission. By pooling signals including jitter generated by vibration of optical fiber cable in the IC, and taking out signals with no jitter at the correct cycle, low distortion is achieved.Each of the digital circuit, D/A converter circuit, and analog circuit is equipped with a dedicated power supply section, and each power supply section is equipped with a toroidal transformer with excellent regulation.In addition to installing a dedicated power supply, each circuit block is separated as a separate board at the same time, and mutual interference is eliminated by copper plating shield cover.We are also pursuing higher sound quality by adopting a glass-epoxy board with double the thickness of the copper foil for the print pattern.The chassis employs a copper-plated diecast chassis and diecast side panels to eliminate the effects of vibration.The LHH1003 is a table-top remote control with all the keys necessary to operate all the functions of the LHH1000. You can control various functions at hand, including Philips' unique programming function FTS (Favourite Trace Selection).Equipped with a large LCD.It is equipped with a run-on function, and commands can be memorized from a remote control such as DAT or another CD player. The run-on function reads and records various command codes emitted by infrared light. It can memorize up to 10 remote control operations including LHH1000.The maximum number of commands that can be stored is 10x36 commands, and the stored commands are displayed on the LCD of the LHH1003 by operating the function keys.

sections.title: PHILIPS AH482
sections.overview: A speaker system with natural crossover design.Natural crossover system is adopted.In conventional speakers, the split vibration near the crossover point and the distinctive chirping of the tweeter were cut off with a filter. In this method, the filter of each unit has its own frequency characteristic, so the phase is disturbed and the connection between the units is not smooth, causing distortion.In the natural crossover method, all filters in each unit are removed and the crossover network is limited to one condenser.A 18 cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.The Woofer features a newly developed drive coupling and rim suspension.This system was developed based on a fundamental review of the electrical design of the voice coil, the geometric method of the cone, and the surface treatment method. The effect of the filter is incorporated into the speaker unit itself, thereby eliminating the control of characteristics by external filters.In addition to the elaborate design of the edge, damper and diaphragm, the best matching with the enclosure realizes a curve with a good fall.A 2.5 cm soft dome type tweeter is installed in the high range.The resonance peak is dumped by installing a precisely designed resonance absorption chamber on the back of the tweeter on the magnet.In addition, unlike the sound-absorbing material used in the enclosure, it is made of a material that can cope with changes over time and damping effects.The enclosure uses a bass reflex system.

sections.title: PHILIPS AH567
sections.overview: This is an active speaker system for the Studio Monitor Series that employs the MFB method.In the MFB method, the piezoelectric element (PXE) mounted on the top of the cone paper of the woofer detects the acceleration of the cone paper and converts it into voltage. The voltage and input signal are compared with each other using a comparator. This makes it possible to make the reproduced sound wave identical to the original waveform and to cancel the distortion component forcibly.In AH567, the input signal is divided into mid - and low-frequency ranges by an electronic crossover network. The mid - and high-frequency ranges are driven by a dedicated amplifier and a crossover network to drive a tweeter and a squaker, and the low-frequency ranges are reproduced without distortion by an MFB loop composed of a bass amplifier, a woofer and a comparator.It has a 25 cm cone woofer in the low range, a 5 cm dome squaker in the middle range, and a 2.5 cm dome tweeter in the high range.The input sensitivity is continuously variable and is compatible with all output signals such as preamp output and power amplifier output.Equipped with an automatic power ON/OFF mechanism driven by relay.With this mechanism, it turns ON automatically with an input of 2 mv or more, turns OFF automatically with no signal for 2 minutes or more, and the operation status can be checked with the indicator lamp.The enclosure is made of wood with a black ash finish.Parallel connection is available for each channel.

sections.title: PHILIPS RH545
sections.overview: Active speaker system of Studio Monitor Series.In order to obtain sound without distortion or coloring, the Studio Monitor Series uses the MFB (Motional Feedback) method.In the MFB method, the acceleration of the cone paper is detected and voltage converted by the piezoelectric element (PXE) installed at the top of the cone paper of the woofer. By comparing this voltage and the input signal with a comparator, the reproduced sound wave can be made identical to the original waveform, and distortion components are canceled.At RH545, the input signal is divided into high, mid, and low frequencies by a precision electronic filter. The high and mid frequencies are driven by the respective amplifiers, while the low frequency uses an MFB loop composed of a bass amplifier, woofer, and comparator for undistorted bass reproduction.It has a 30 cm cone woofer in the low range, a 5 cm dome squaker in the middle range, and a 2.5 cm dome tweeter in the high range.Equipped with a low-pass filter and continuously variable Bass control to enable sound field correction depending on the installation location.The Treble control allows you to switch the turnover frequency between two levels.Equipped with an automatic power ON/OFF mechanism driven by relay.It turns ON automatically when 2 mv or more is input, and turns OFF automatically when there is no signal for 2 minutes or more.You can check the operation status of the power ON/OFF and Treble filter by the indicator.It has an electronic protection circuit to protect the speakers from overload.The enclosure is made of wood with a black ash finish.A balanced input terminal (cannon jack) of studio specification is used.Since parallel connection is possible for each channel, power up for multiple use is possible.

sections.title: PHILIPS LHHA200
sections.overview: A pre-main amplifier with expressive power while inheriting the technology of LHH A700.Uses low NFB high-speed voltage amplification stage.The LHH A200 consists of a wide-band, small-capacity bipolar transistor for the voltage amplification stage. As a result, the bare characteristics (open-loop frequency characteristics) before applying NFB has been dramatically improved to 500 kHz (-3dB) compared with the conventional one. At the same time, by minimizing NFB, dynamic characteristics have been greatly improved and flat phase characteristics have been obtained.MOS-FET, a high-speed switching element, is used for the power stage and driver stage, which are current amplification stages. It has a single-push-pull configuration with an emphasis on linearity. The low-impedance drive realizes an ultra high-speed overall amplifier with a slew rate of 200 V / ?.In addition, the LHH A200 has a non-feedback current amplifier stage that is less affected by the back electromotive force from the speakers than the first stage. This provides excellent stability against not only low loads but also capacitance loads. The output coil, which was a necessary evil in ordinary NFB amplifiers, is eliminated, and dynamic characteristics are further improved.The volume uses a current drive type low impedance volume.In this system, the signal current does not pass through the carbon resistor or slider contact, so the deterioration of sound quality is minimized.The power supply section is equipped with a 260 VA high-capacity EI core transformer. This transformer has   separate windings and separate rectification to improve stability against fluctuations.In addition, a number of custom electrolytic capacitors with low-magnification foils are connected in parallel to the smoothing capacitor to achieve low impedance and high speed.An OFC bus bar with a diameter of 2.0 mm is used for the power supply ground.A 1.6 mm thick steel plate is used for the top cover and a 2.0 mm thick copper plated steel plate is used for the bottom chassis to increase rigidity.The heat sink uses a chimney type with excellent vibration resistance, which is connected to the top cover and bottom chassis to increase chassis rigidity.3-point support system sintered alloy heavy legs (point grounding, interview site selectable) are used for the legs.Uses carefully selected high-grade parts.  1% metal film resistor, high voltage acoustic electrolytic capacitor, Silbird dip mica capacitor, etc. are adopted.In addition, high-reliability parts such as brass machined RCA pin jacks, a vise speaker terminal for banana plugs, and a gold-plated contact relay are used.There were aluminum side panels and brass point bases as options sold separately.

sections.title: PHILIPS LHHA700
sections.overview: This is a stereo power amplifier that has been completely simplified.In the LHH A700, the voltage amplification stage is composed of a wide-band, small-capacity bipolar transistor, and the open-loop frequency characteristic, which is the bare characteristic before applying NFB, is improved to 500 kHz (-3dB). By this, NFB is suppressed to less than 20 dB, and dynamic characteristics are greatly improved.MOS FET is used in single push-pull for both power stage and driver stage of the current amplifier stage.MOS FET has characteristics such as high input impedance, high switching speed without carrier accumulation effect, and high thermal stability. However, it has characteristics such as large equivalent input capacitance, and it is important to handle the input capacitance in order to demonstrate the characteristics of a high-speed switching element. The LHHH A700 achieves an overall high-speed amplifier with a slew rate of 200 V / ? s by passing a drive current that is one order of magnitude larger than normal and charging / discharging all at once with a low impedance drive.Conventionally, the NFB is returned from the output stage to the input, but it is limited to the voltage amplification stage with gain, so that the effect of the back electromotive force from the speaker loop does not reach the first stage.For this reason, the driver stage and power stage have no distortion improvement effect due to NFB, and the static specifications are not improved as compared with conventional amplifiers. However, the operation of the amplifier is released from the effect of the back electromotive force of the speaker, which is a load, and it shows the overwhelming stability against not only low load but also capacitance load. Moreover, the dynamic characteristics are further improved by eliminating the output coil.The power supply section is equipped with a 500 VA high-capacity EI core transformer with excellent instantaneous power. In addition, by using plus or minus separate windings and separate rectification, it is possible to supply high-efficiency power that is resistant to fluctuations. In addition, a large number of custom electrolytic capacitors using low-magnification foils are connected in parallel to achieve low impedance and high speed.A 2 mm thick OFC bus bar is used for the power supply line and power supply ground to minimize a large current loop and to obtain excellent dynamic regulation and clear ground potential.A gold-plated glass-epoxy double-sided copper foil board is used for the printed circuit board, and by taking a wide ground plane, a high shielding effect and excellent high-frequency characteristics are obtained.The chassis uses 10 mm thick extruded aluminum material for the front, site, and rear. It is firmly fixed to the bottom chassis of 3 mm thick copper plated steel plate, and is connected and reinforced with each other.The heat sink uses a chimney type heat sink made of extruded aluminum material with a circumference of 10 mm and fins of 8 mm thick. This heat sink is fixed firmly to a 4 mm thick aluminum top panel and bottom chassis to form a monocoque structure. Combined with a 3-point support system of sintered alloy heavy legs (point contact and contact point can be selected), it realizes excellent vibration resistance characteristics.Extruded addition, extruded materials have higher aluminum purity than die-cast materials and have the advantage of reducing thermal resistance, realizing highly efficient heat radiation and uniform temperature distribution.The volume circuit employs a current-driven low-impedance volume in which the signal current does not pass through the carbon resistor or slider contact.It uses a custom RCA pin jack of brass carving using Teflon insulator with excellent high-frequency characteristics.The speaker terminal uses a banana plug terminal made by WBT of Germany.Uses 123g solid aluminum volume knob for volume knob.Uses high-precision parts such as   1% metal film resistance and high pressure acoustic condenser.

sections.title: PHILIPS N4520
sections.overview:
N4520 :   390,000 (around 1980)N4522 :   390,000 (around 1980)

This tape deck has been developed for professional use.N4522 is 2TR-38cm, and N4520 is 4TR-38cm.The mechanism adopts a direct drive system, and the motor shaft itself of a low-speed high-precision motor is used as a capstan.The capstan uses a quartz lock system. The reference frequency controlled by a quartz oscillator is connected to the movement of a 72-pole tachometer built into the flywheel to control the speed difference. A belt is connected between the outer circumference of the flywheel and the motor shaft, and the capstan shaft speed is quartz-locked with a high precision of 1/10,000.It uses a large flywheel of 800g and 110 mm diameter and is supported by long life shield bearings (25 ~ 55 micron).The eccentricity with the 6.5 mm capstan and the alignment of the axis are adjusted to less than 1 micron, and it can cope with changes in the thickness of the tape itself and tape elongation with time.Equipped with linear tape length counter.The conventional drive method of the tape counter was a main gun that counts the tape speed by the angle type with the tension arm on the take-up reel side. The N4520/N4522 are equipped with a guide roller that monitors the tape speed linearly. As the tape runs along with the tape, a pulse generator connected to the shaft sends out a number of pulses proportional to the length of the running tape. This count is displayed on the tape counter.By automatically controlling the reel motor on the supply side while monitoring the pulse frequency and the angle of the tension arm, the tape tension and speed are always kept constant.Equipped with a pulse count type fluorescent digital display tape counter.A solid type FSX Sendust head with excellent wear resistance and high S/N ratio is used for the recording and reproducing heads.Solenoid operated feather touch type operation button is used for the operation part.It is a direct change type with built-in electronic circuit for tape protection.Equipped with a mixing function, SOS recording and echo recording / playback are possible.Low distortion rate recording is possible with the pilot tone filter built in for FM air check.The bias / equalizer can be adjusted.

A record player developed as a player system that brings out the performance of its own cartridges.A gyro-poise turntable is used for the turntable.The Gyro-Poise system uses a magnetic suspension that uses magnetic repulsion to raise the turntable and eliminate bearings and springs.The fixed magnet that makes up the gyropoise is suspended from the chassis by a spring. A tone arm is attached to one end of the T-shaped metal bar that supports the magnet. The two stage suspension system suppresses vibration from the outside.Uni-Poise tone arm is used for the tone arm part.This arm uses a single point support with theoretically the lowest friction, and the twist of the horizontal balance, which is a drawback of this method, is solved by using the entire outer circumference of the bearing as a pre-calculated balancer.The FA145J uses XUV/4500Q, and the FA112J uses XV-15/1200E.In both cases, the matching between the arm and cartridge is calculated at the design stage, and each cartridge is adjusted in the factory.There are only three types of controls : 2-speed switching, motor ON/OFF, and cue control.The needle pressure can be adjusted by the slide weight on the straight arm, and the anti-skating can be adjusted by the scale at the base of the bearing.In order to reduce the load on the shaft point, the armrest that locks at the front of the arm is eliminated, and a structure that lightly adsorbs with a magnet while keeping the balance is adopted.The dust cover is removable.

sections.overview: A cassette deck with improved overall performance by adopting a two motor mechanism and a highly stable cassette hold system.A 2-motor system is used for the mechanism part, and dedicated motors are used for play (Rec) and FF/Rew respectively.The Play (Rec) motor uses an electronically controlled DC motor (built-in generator) with less torque ripple and vibration, while the FF/REW motor uses a DC torque motor that achieves both high-speed winding and stability, enabling stable tape travel and improved durability of the drive.In order to take advantage of the upright hold mechanism, a double-link tape holding mechanism has been adopted, which not only securely fixes the cassette, but also allows easy attachment and detachment with soft touch.In addition, the use of six blades for the reel shaft eliminates play between the reel and hub, ensuring stable tape travel.A fully open tape transport mechanism facilitates cleaning and maintenance around the head and pinch roller. This mechanism uses a large acrylic cassette door and is designed to allow 100% direct viewing of the cassette.The head uses a ferrite solid head with excellent magnetic characteristics.This head is a hyperbolic type with low head wear and high mirror surface accuracy. As a result, sound skipping and level fluctuation due to adhesion of dust, etc. are small, and recording compensation by the recording amplifier can be minimized, so the problem of high-frequency distortion due to excessive compensation is suppressed.In the preamp section, an NPN3-stage direct head amplifier is used for the equalizer amplifier and microphone amplifier. By applying low-loss NFB over a wide band, excellent high-frequency characteristics are realized.Equipped with an independent switchable tape selector with two levels of bias and two levels of equalizer.It is equipped with a large level meter.Also equipped with a peak indicator using LED, quick response to instantaneous excessive input is possible.The Dolby System is built in as a noise reduction system.When Dolby is on, the indicator lamp lights up and you can check it.Equipped with a memory stop on/off switch with an operation indicator lamp that is convenient for heading out.Turn this switch on to store the start point (000) on the tape counter. If you rewind the tape after playing or recording, the tape will stop at the position one step before the start point (999).By using the separately sold timer together, it is possible to start recording your absence or playing the alarm clock.By solenoid driving, the stop lever can be skipped from any mode to the next mode.Electronic control circuit is used to protect mechanism and tape.Equipped with a rear illumination lamp with a tape end marker line that shows the remaining amount of tape at a glance.A full auto-stop mechanism with a non-contact rotation detection circuit that uses a Hall element for the detection circuit of the tape end is adopted.

sections.overview: Stereo cassette deck in pursuit of operability.With an emphasis on the sense of operation, large self-illuminated operation buttons are concentrated in the center of the front panel. The LED lights on each button with a light touch and the driving mode can be confirmed by light.A dedicated electronic servo motor is used to drive the head base to achieve an extremely quiet vertical motion while reducing damage to the head. The ejection is also a motor drive system that uses the rotational power of this motor to drive the head base.It is equipped with functions such as a PMS function that allows you to repeat one song (music repeat) or find the beginning of the song you want to listen to, and an auto rewind / memory play function linked to the counter.It is also equipped with REC mute and timer standby mechanism.Equipped with the Dolby HX System, which is compatible with a wide range of music sources and greatly improves the high-frequency characteristics of Chikara Dainyu.Uses Sendust head for the head.The drive train uses a DC servo motor for the capstan and a DC torque motor for the reel.

sections.title: PIONEER-EXCLUSIVE Pioneer
sections.overview: In order to bring out the full performance of metal tape, research has been carried out focusing on the head and the stereo cassette deck has been successfully mounted with metal tape position.The recording / reproducing head uses Sendust alloy to prevent magnetic saturation even in metal tapes with high MOL (maximum output level) in the high-frequency range, so that there is no sound quality degradation due to head saturation, and distortion at high input is prevented.Because metal tapes have a high coercive force, it is difficult to erase sound once recorded. In order to achieve sufficient erasing characteristics, we have developed and adopted a newly designed ferrite erasing head. We have also adopted a double-gap structure to obtain a strong magnetic field.In order to prevent the head from generating heat, the core is attached to a mounting base that also serves as a heat sink with high thermal conductivity.Equipped with a high-torque DC servo motor, the capstan shaft is processed with high precision, and rotation unevenness is reduced by a large flywheel and twin belt system.It is equipped with a Dolby system that adopts newly developed IC.The recording amplifier uses a recording amplifier with a wide dynamic range and excellent linearity.It uses a level meter that covers a wide range of -20dB to + 8 dB, and is equipped with a five level peak indicator that displays the peak level of the recording source in five levels (0, + 2, + 4, + 6, + 8 dB).It uses the Pioneer Music Select System (PMS) and automatically detects and plays back the head of a song when you want to skip the current song and move to the next song, or when you want to listen from the intro again.It is also equipped with REC mute which can create the interval between songs necessary for PMS to detect when recording.It is equipped with various functions for tape play such as memory stop and memory play mechanism, mixing of line input and MIC input, cue & review, output level control, absence recording mechanism, etc.Metal, STD/CrO2Equipped with 3-stage switching tape recorder of Fe-Cr.STD and CrO2Switches automatically depending on whether there is a detection hole in the tape.

sections.title: PIONEER-EXCLUSIVE Pioneer
sections.overview: A stereo cassette deck equipped with a third meter that can be used with three functions.Equipped with 3 independent meters that can be used separately : dynamic level meter, bias meter and peak meter.The dynamic level meter is designed so that it fluctuates slightly in the low range and considerably in the high range.When recording, in general, the distortion tends to increase as the level increases in the low frequency band, and tends to saturate in the high frequency band. However, since conventional meters cannot read the frequency component of the input signal, recording at a higher level may cause high peaks in a source that contains many high frequencies, and distortion increases in a source that contains many low frequencies.The dynamic level meter allows you to set an appropriate recording level that matches the frequency component of the recording source.When the bias meter is used, the amount of bias can be checked with the meter, and the bias variable volume can be set to the proper recording bias suitable for the tape to be used. This can be used for various types of tapes and provides better recording characteristics.The peak meter acts as a peak meter (Lch + Rch) with a fast response speed during playback.The drive section is equipped with an electronically controlled DC-motor with a built-in generator with stable rotational performance. In addition, it is equipped with a large flywheel with large inertial mass. The capstan with high roundness and high surface accuracy is driven by a flat belt. This improves the accuracy of the drive section thoroughly and ensures excellent rotational performance.The Dolby System is used as a noise reduction system.Equipped with a tape selector with automatic tape switching mechanism for CrO2 position.When a CrO2 position tape is attached to the Tape Selector, both the Bias / Equalizer switch automatically to the CrO2 position, and the Bias switch to the standard value for each tape, allowing fine adjustment while watching the Third Meter.Equipped with a memory stop mechanism.It uses a timer standby mechanism that enables you to record your absence and play an alarm.Uses a large indicator.By using a separately sold rack mount adapter, it can be mounted on an EIA-standard rack.

sections.overview: This stereo cassette deck inherits CT 910 technology.A 3-head system has been adopted for the head section, and by pursuing both recording and playback characteristics, sound quality that cannot be obtained with a 2-head system using a dual-head recording / reproducing head has been obtained.A combination head using Sendust alloy is used for the recording head and reproducing head, and the parallelism of the gap is kept constant by packaging it in a case with high precision, and there is no worry of azimuth shift and crosstalk.The mechanism hole uses a closed loop dual capstan system with two capstans to keep good head touch and prevent level fluctuation and drop-out.The drive section uses a 2-motor system, with an electronically controlled DC motor with a built-in generator for constant speed operation and a DC high torque motor for fast forward operation.Equipped with an ATLC mechanism that instantly removes tape slack when the cassette half is mounted.Equipped with an FL level meter, it covers a wide range of -20 to + 8 dB, and it is easy to confirm by displaying two colors : blue for less than 0 dB and orange for more than 0 dB.This FL level meter can be switched between an average meter, which responds to the same level as a normal VU meter, and a peak meter, which has a fast attack time, enabling reliable level monitoring for a wide range of sources.Equipped with bias adjustment mechanism, recording utilizing characteristics of the tape is possible.Uses a soft push type direct change operation button.The operation buttons can be preset and can be linked with the timer to record your absence or play an alarm.It uses a full open loading system, making it possible to mount the tape securely. It also makes it easy to check the tape running condition and label, and to perform maintenance of the head.Also equipped with a dust protector to protect the head housing.Equipped with a monitor switch, you can monitor by listening to and comparing the sound of the source and tape during recording.Equipped with a CrO2 position automatic switching mechanism.Also, STD and Fe-Cr tapes can be manually switched.The Dolby System is installed as a noise reduction system.

sections.overview: A stereo cassette deck developed based on the design philosophy of the CT 920.The recording and reproducing heads are made of Sendust alloy, which has excellent distortion factor characteristics and high-frequency characteristics at high input, ensuring a wide range and an S / N ratio of 69 dB. In addition, the combination type prevents characteristic degradation due to azimuth deviation.In addition, a special alloy erasing head for small windows with high erasing performance is adopted for the erasing head, and it can handle metal tapes with high holding power.The mechanism uses a closed-loop dual capstan system to keep the head touch always in good condition and to suppress the fluctuation of the tape tension and the generation of modulation noise.In addition, an electronically controlled DC motor with a built-in generator (for constant speed) and a DC high-torque motor (for fast forward) are used in the drive part to reduce uneven rotation and obtain excellent durability.Equipped with an ATLC mechanism that removes tape slack when the cassette half is mounted.Wide range 2 color FL level meter of -20 to + 8 dB is adopted, and it corresponds to the peak component of music which changes rapidly.The response instruction is a two step switching type of average and peak.Uses a soft push type direct change operation button.In addition, since it can be preset, you can record the absence by combining with a timer sold separately.Using a monitor switch, recording status can be checked in real time.Equipped with a bias adjustment mechanism.Equipped with a Dolby system.

sections.title: PIONEER-EXCLUSIVE Pioneer
sections.overview: Stereo cassette deck equipped with ribbon sendust head and Auto BLE system.Ribbon Sendust Combination Head is used for the head part.By laminating 11 sheets of ribbon sendust, which has been thinned to 50 microns thick, this head suppresses the generation of eddy current loss, which is a problem with metal-based heads, and improves the high-frequency characteristics. The fasciation of ribbon sendust is reduced to 11 sheets.In addition, it is a combination type that can set the optimum gap width for each recording head and reproducing head, and prevents azimuth deviation.Equipped with an Auto BLE system that can adjust the recording according to the characteristics of the tape.In the Auto BLE system, the built-in microprocessor performs 4-bit arithmetic processing to match the recording bias, recording level (tape sensitivity), and recording equalizer to the characteristics of the tape, enabling optimum recording.When the tape is loaded and the Auto BLE button is pressed, the adjustment is completed in 10 seconds, the tape is automatically rewound to the start position and the recording standby state is set.The mechanism uses a closed-loop dual capstan system to improve the head touch by keeping the tape tension constant and to suppress drop-out, level fluctuation, modulation noise, and flutter components.The drive part uses an electronically controlled DC torque motor with a built-in generator and a DC high torque motor to ensure high stability.In addition, a dedicated electronic servo motor is used to drive the head base to minimize damage to the head by performing an extremely quiet operation even when the head base moves up and down. In addition, a motor drive system that uses the rotational power of this motor is used to eject the head.A centralized display board is used for the display section, and LEDs display the tape running status, level meter, type of tape, and ON/OFF of Dolby NR System.Equipped with 2-color LED level meter with excellent response speed.Equipped with a timer standby mechanism.Equipped with a REC mute function.Equipped with a 3-position tape selector compatible with Norml, CrO2 and Metal.Equipped with a memory stop mechanism.Equipped with output adjustment volume with click.The Dolby System is installed as a noise reduction system.

sections.overview: 3-head stereo cassette deck.It uses a 3-head system with separate heads for recording, playback, and erasing. This keeps the gap parallelism of both heads constant and prevents azimuth deviation and crosstalk. sections.overview: Stereo cassette deck equipped with ribbon sendust head and Auto BLE system.The head part uses Ribbon Sendust Combination 3 heads.The Ribbon Sendust Head uses Pioneer's unique technology to make a thin strip of Sendust to 50 microns and has a laminated structure of 11 sheets. This thin fasciation suppresses the generation of eddy currents and prevents the degradation of high-frequency characteristics. Moreover, the bias efficiency is improved to about twice that of the conventional Sendust Head, and excellent performances are obtained.In addition, in order to obtain excellent channel separation, the ribbon sendust head takes into account the shielding effect against leakage magnetic field. For the core spacer where both left and right channels are adjacent, non-magnetic high-conductive material with high electrostatic shielding effect and permalloy shield plate with excellent magnetic shielding effect are adopted. The sound quality is enhanced by double shield combining the electrostatic shield effective for high frequency and the magnetic shield for low frequency. In addition, the structure between both channels is provided with an appropriate distribution angle, and the channel separation is further improved by high-precision core processing technology and deep gap design.The recording and reproducing heads are a combination type in which the optimum gap can be selected by comprehensively analyzing the frequency characteristics, distortion, and sensitivity of each head. By setting the gap width to 0.8 micron for the reproducing head and 2.5 micron for the recording head, the performance of each head is brought out, and sound quality degradation due to azimuth shift and fluctuation of the tape touch is also suppressed.It is equipped with an Auto BLE (Auto Bias Level Equalizer) system to bring out the performance of the tape.In the AutoBLE system, a 4-bit microprocessor automatically searches for the optimum recording bias, recording level (tape sensitivity), and recording equalizer for each tape and adjusts it to ensure the best recording.For tuning, the AutoBLE unit sends a command to the mechanism control circuit to enter the recording mode. Then, the 1 kHz oscillation signal is selected and supplied to the recording head via the recording amplifier. At the same time, the recording bias is also supplied to the recording head with the 1 kHz oscillation signal superimposed on the 1 kHz oscillation signal via the variable bias circuit. The recorded test signal is taken out by the reproducing head and supplied to the rectifying circuit of the AutoBLE unit to create a loop for recording and playback.The automatic adjustment starts with the setting of the bias. In this method, the bias current is varied in 16 steps while recording a test signal of 1 kHz, and the optimum peak bias amount is detected with a high accuracy of   0.5 dB from the reproduced level. The reproduced signal supplied to the rectifying circuit of the Auto BLE unit is converted to a DC voltage, which is then converted into a digital value to determine the maximum reproduced level of the microprocessor.When the bias amount is set, adjustment of the optimum recording level is started. At this time, the test signal is 1 kHz. The recording current is changed in 16 steps, and the reproduction output level of both channels is set to the specified level of 0 dB.When adjusting the recording equalizer, the microprocessor selects a test signal of 10 kHz and adjusts the compensation amount of the recording equalizer in 16 steps to create a Furatto.During adjustment, the LED on the front panel blinks, and when adjustment is finished, it is automatically rewound to the start position and the recording standby state is set.The mechanism uses a 2-motor closed-loop dual capstan system, with a quartz PLL DD motor for capstan drive and a coreless motor for reel drive.In the closed-loop dual capstan system, the tape is sandwiched between two capstan and pinch rollers on both sides of the head, so that the tape tension is always kept constant and good head touch is obtained. This reduces the modulation noise caused by drop-out, level fluctuation, and tape vibration.A centralized display board is used for the display section.This centralized display board uses LEDs to indicate the level meter, 4-digit electronic counter, signal route, Auto BLE operation, tape type, Dolby NR system ON/OFF, etc.The level meter is equipped with a fast-response 16-segment wide-range 2-color LED peak level meter with a display range of -30 to + 10 dB and an auto-reset peak hold function of approximately 2 seconds.Equipped with a memory stop / play function.Equipped with a timer standby mechanism, and by connecting a timer sold separately, it is possible to record absence and play an alarm clock.Equipped with a Rec mute mechanism.Equipped with a bias manual variable function.The Dolby System is installed as a noise reduction system.Equipped with a 3-position tape selector of Norml, CrO2, METAL.

sections.title: PIONEER-EXCLUSIVE Pioneer
sections.overview: This is a stereo cassette deck that aims at the highest quality by using the Auto BLE system and the 3-head system that uses the world's first ribbon sendust head.It uses a 3-head system with a recording / playback combination head using Ribbon Sendust, which was developed for the first time in the world, and an erasing head using a special alloy.The ribbon Sendust head is manufactured by an ultra-rapid cooling method in which molten center dust is ejected from a nozzle under appropriate conditions and directly extended through a roll. By this method, Sendust, which is limited to 0.2 mm ~ 0.3 mm with the conventional technology, has been successfully reduced to a thin band of 50 ? m at a stroke. Moreover, by molding this ribbon Sendust into 11-sheet laminate structure and suppressing the generation of overcurrent, the degradation in the high-frequency range is remarkably improved and excellent high-frequency characteristics are realized.In addition, this ribbon Sendust head has a high SN ratio and wide dynamic range design taking advantage of the high magnetic permeability of Sendust itself, and bias efficiency is about twice as high as that of conventional Sendust heads.The gap width of the reproducing head is set to 0.8 ? m in order to achieve both high frequency characteristics and high sensitivity. We succeeded in forming a narrow gap without sacrificing sensitivity by taking advantage of the characteristics of ribbon sendust.The recording head the recording head has a gap value of 2.5 ? to maximize the frequency characteristics and sensitivity during recording. By taking advantage of the high saturation magnetic flux density and high sensitivity, sound quality is improved.The Ribbon Sendust Head fully considers the shielding effect against the leakage magnetic field, and uses a shield plate made of non-magnetic high conductive material with high electrostatic shielding effect and permalloy with excellent magnetic shielding effect as the core spacer where both the left and right channels are adjacent. The sound quality is improved by double shielding.In addition, the channel has a structure with an appropriate distribution angle between both channels, and the channel separation is made excellent by high precision core processing technology and deep gap.For the erasing head, we have developed a special alloy with high saturation magnetic flux density and excellent abrasion resistance. We use a semi-double gap structure for the front core. In addition, we combine it with a ferrite back core to realize a compact and high-performance erasing head.In addition, the front core made of this special alloy is laminated with 21 sheets of 0.1 mm thin plate, so temperature rise due to eddy current loss is small, and high erasing performance of over 76 dB (1 kHz, metal tape) is obtained.It uses a newly developed AutoBLE system (Automatic Bias Level Equalizer Tuning System) that automatically detects the recording bias, recording level, and recording equalizer on the tape used by the 6-bit arithmetic processing of the microprocessor and sets it with high precision.When adjusting the recording bias, regardless of the position of the tape used, the amount of bias current at which the sensitivity of the tape is high and distortion is reduced is selected and set to the optimum value.When adjusting the recording level (tape sensitivity), the recording level is changed so that the recording and playback levels are the same, and the optimum value is set so that the curve of the code is symmetrical in encoding even when the Dolby system is in operation.Recording equalizer adjustment automatically detects the high-frequency characteristics of various types of tapes, and adjusts the recording equalizer to the optimum value so that all bands are flat.The AutoBLE System has a built-in memory function that stores up to nine bias level and equalizer adjustment values, which can be recalled when necessary. It also detects tape selector mispositions and faulty tapes, and alerts you with an error message.The AutoBLE unit uses a microprocessor (PD 4005) developed by Pioneer for 6-bit arithmetic processing to adjust the bias level equalizers and various associated controls.In the process, when the AutoBLE key is pressed, the AutoBLE unit sends a command to the mechanism control circuit to enter the recording state. Then, the 1 kHz oscillation signal is selected and supplied to the recording head via the recording amplifier. At the same time, the recording bias is also supplied to the recording head after being superimposed on the 1 kHz oscillation signal via the variable bias circuit. The recorded test signal is taken out by the reproducing head and supplied to the rectifying circuit of the AutoBLE unit to create a recording / playback loop.The automatic adjustment starts with setting the bias. The bias current is varied in 64 steps while recording a test signal of 1 kHz. The optimum peak bias amount is detected with a high accuracy of   0.2 dB from the reproduced signal. The reproduced signal supplied to the rectifying circuit of the AutoBLE unit is converted to a DC-voltage, which is then converted into a digital quantity. The microprocessor determines the maximum reproduced level. This peak bias value is detected twice for both Lch and Rch, and the average value is obtained. Therefore, compared with the method of determining with only one channel or only one peak bias value, high reliability is achieved.Once the bias is set, the next step is to adjust the optimum recording level, again using a test signal of 1 Hz and varying the recording current in 64 steps so that the playback output level of both channels is set to the specified level of 0 dB.When adjusting the recording equalizer, the microprocessor selects a test signal of 10 kHz and changes the compensation amount of the recording equalizer in 64 steps to flatten the frequency response.When all these adjustments have been made, the microprocessor instructs the tape to automatically rewind to the point before the adjustment was started and enters the recording standby state.The AutoBLE system's adjustment status is indicated by three LEDs, one for the recording bias, one for the recording level, and one for the recording equalizer. The LEDs are designed to blink during adjustment and remain on when adjustment is complete.In addition, three LEDs flash simultaneously to warn of errors due to incorrect position of the tape selector, etc.A built-in memory back-up battery maintains the memory of the microprocessor during power-off, power failure, unplugged or unattended recording.The capstan motor uses a quartz PLL D. D> coreless motor. The magnet (6 poles) attached to the rotor and the stator (9 coils) face each other in a planar manner. This realizes a high starting torque of 180g-cm.In addition, because the DC-motor uses a permanent magnet that does not use an iron core for the rotor, there is no magnetic unevenness, no microvibration due to cogging or torque ripple, and the flutter components that are particularly harmful to audibility are greatly reduced. Moreover, it adopts a direct drive system in which the rotation of the motor is the rotation of the capstan as it is. Unlike a system in which the capstan is driven via a transmission mechanism, the performance of the coreless motor is stable as it is for tape running.In addition, the capstan uses a 3 mm diameter thick shaft type. Even with the same direct drive system, the rotational speed of the motor can be further reduced. This reduces rotational unevenness and vibration caused by motor shaft runout and greatly improves mechanical durability.The servo mechanism uses a quartz PLL that samples and holds the reference signal of a crystal oscillator with a high precision of   0.004% or less.The speed detection mechanism of the motor itself employs a highly accurate all-round integration method, in which an AC signal is generated by a 60-pole magnet attached to the entire circumference of the rear surface of the capstan motor rotor and a low-impedance print pattern coil with the same number of poles facing the magnet. The AC signal is then integrated over the entire circumference. By this method, the accuracy of the quartz PLL is further improved and noise reduction is achieved.In addition, Pioneer has adopted a contact-free switching mechanism using a Hall element originally developed by Pioneer for the switching of the magnetic pole of the motor realizes quiet and smooth rotation.Equipped with a pitch control mechanism that can vary the pitch during playback by   6% (auto cancel during recording)Quartz PLL The drive power of the D. D. capstan motor is supplied to the flywheel for driving the sub-capstan through the transmission belt, and the tape is run by two capstan in a closed-loop dual capstan system.Modulation noise caused by tape vibration during tape travel is cut off from within the loop, enabling high-quality recording and playback.In addition, the rotation speed of the sub-capstan side is slightly slower than that of the D. D. capstan, and uniform tape tension is continuously applied in the loop. In addition, the recording / playback system and Lch/Rch are clearly separated from each other and the signal flow is arranged straight to prevent internal signal degradation and interference between signals.The signal from the reproduction head is directly connected to a low-noise DC reproduction amplifier using a dual FET without using a capacitor. Furthermore, coils, which cause sound quality degradation, are eliminated from the reproduction amplifier.Pioneer's original NEW cassette stabilizer is used to suppress vibration of the cassette half.A special resin stabilizer is placed on the front side of the cassette half and a special rubber stabilizer is placed on the back side. When the cassette half is attached, the arm hooks the frame by the rotation of the motor-driven side cam gear the motor-driven side cam gear, pulls it back, and the stabilizer presses it firmly from both sides.As a result of this anti-vibration measure, the wow and flutter components in the wide band due to vibration are greatly reduced, and in the vibration test to the cassette half, the speed of vibration attenuation is four times that of the case without the stabilizer.In order to completely eliminate vibration and resonance in the deck body, honeycomb structures such as copper plated honeycomb chassis, large honeycomb plated honeycomb chassis, large honeycomb insulators, and honeycomb center stays. sections.overview: This is a reference W cassette deck with a strengthened power supply and complete vibration-free and resonance-free design in order to respond to the sound quality of digital sources.Unlike noise reduction systems such as Dolby B and C, both decks are equipped with Dolby HX PRO, which expands the high-frequency range.Dolby HX PRO is a system that prevents the self-bias phenomenon, in which the high-frequency signal itself functions as a bias when recording a source with many high-frequency components such as digital sources, and improves the high-frequency characteristics by always recording with an appropriate bias. It detects the high-frequency signal flowing in the recording head, controls the bias current according to the increase or decrease of the signal, and greatly improves the high-frequency characteristics.In addition, it is equipped with Dolby B and C, and can be used in combination with Dolby HX PRO to further improve sound quality.It is equipped with a cassette stabilizer to suppress vibration of the cassette half caused by motor rotation vibration or external vibration / sound pressure, to realize stable driving, and to realize clear sound with less modulation noise.A special rubber stabilizer is set on the receiving side of the main body, and a special resin half pressure is set on the cassette holder. When the cassette holder is closed, this stabilizer firmly holds the cassette half from both sides.In addition, by adopting a double-lock mechanism that locks the entire cassette holder from both sides, and thorough vibration absorption, vibration characteristics with less peaks are achieved.In order to suppress the vibration of the deck body, we focused on the power transformer, which is one of the vibration generating sources. We installed a casted power transformer that uses a cast iron transformer case with high rigidity, high internal loss, excellent vibration damping characteristics, and almost no resonance frequency. This eliminates the noise characteristic of transformers.In addition, we have adopted a honeycomb chassis with high rigidity that greatly reduces resonance and a large honeycomb structure insulator that cuts vibration from the outside. Through these measures, we have taken thorough anti-vibration measures to eliminate adverse effects on sound quality.In order to realize a power supply unit that can quickly follow sudden fluctuations in music signals, a high-speed active servo regulator is mounted that instantaneously stabilizes power supply voltage fluctuations due to load fluctuations by high-speed servo.As a result, the frequency analysis of power supply voltage fluctuation is improved by approximately 50 dB at the basic frequency of 1 kHz, and performance is improved by 320 times. In addition, high-frequency characteristics are also greatly improved.In addition, oxygen-free copper (OFC) is used for the power transformer winding and power cord to control polarity, and copper plate is used for heat radiation plate to improve sound quality.The recording / reproducing head uses a low-impedance high-performance head that uses oxygen-free copper wire for the winding.Each part is carefully examined through a thorough trial listening, and only are useful for improving sound quality are carefully selected and used.We use oxygen-free copper wire cords with polarity indication to improve conductivity and reduce non-linearity distortion, casted transformers using oxygen-free copper wire for transformer winding, copper-foil styrene capacitors to reduce DC resistance and inductance, gold-plated terminals with high conductivity, and electrolytic capacitors for large-capacity audio.The center of the front panel is equipped with a large FL display that combines a level meter with peak hold, a 4-digit electronic counter, and various indicators to indicate the operation status of the deck.Equipped with a 4-digit electronic counter with automatic switching between deck I and II that automatically displays the counter of the deck on the operating side when the cassette half is put in and out.It is equipped with a parallel recording function that can record one source simultaneously to the tapes of Decks I and II.It is equipped with twin recording re-quick reverse & relay recording function which enables continuous recording of 3 hours. sections.overview: A three head cassette deck equipped with a digital processing system.A digital processing system is used for signal processing inside the deck.In this method, the music signal read by the playback head is converted into a digital music signal, and the subsequent signal processing is done by digital processing with little degradation, thereby suppressing degradation caused by high-frequency correction and level correction.In addition, it is equipped with a Legato link conversion, which is also installed in CD players. It reproduces music signals in the audible band above 20 kHz by estimating them from signals within the audible band and 1/f characteristics, and realizes wide-band playback up to 40 kHz.Digital noise reduction is installed in the digital circuit.In this circuit, the audio frequency band is divided into multiple bands by a digital filter, and the hissing is separated and removed by increasing the level difference between the music signal and noise, thereby achieving an S/N ratio of 90 dB when the Dolby NR is on.This digital noise reduction does not need to be encoded at the time of recording, and is capable of high S/N playback on tapes recorded on other decks or in the past.Equipped with digital FLEX (Frequency Level Expander).This function is used for tapes that are muffled due to degradation of high-frequency sound quality. This function automatically adjusts the high-frequency level to the 1/f characteristic so that even tapes with poor high-frequency characteristics can be played with clear sound.Equipped with a digital XD (Extended Dynamic Range) FLAT System.With this circuit, the recording and playback frequency characteristics can be tuned to a flat level by digital processing with one touch according to the tape to be used. By checking the high-frequency recording characteristics of the tape to be used with a computer and carrying out bias control that is optimal for the tape, higher precision correction capability and a wide dynamic range in the high-frequency range can be obtained.The digital input terminal allows recording from digital devices with an optical output at a sampling frequency of 44.1 kHz. The T-D7 also has a digital input terminal on the front.In addition, it is equipped with a digital sync function so that recording starts automatically when a music signal is input.Equipped with digital ALCA (Auto Level Control with Tape Analysis) function.When recording with digital input, the recording level can be automatically adjusted to the optimum level. The peak and initial recording levels are set based on the bias and sensitivity analysis of the FLAT SYSTEM and the high-frequency and high-level recording capability analysis, and the recording level is set according to the input signal. Thus, even tapes with different characteristics can be recorded at the appropriate recording level.Manual operation is required for analog input.The Z-concept has been adopted to reduce waveform distortion and pursue accurate signal transmission.The T-D7 employs three technologies : a stayable detection based on the Z-concept, an accurate transmission, and a jitter-free conversion.A cassette stabilizer, digital tension servo and, and a wing chassis are used for Stable Detection.The cassette stabilizer is equipped with a special stabilizer of approximately 70g on the receiver side of the main body to effectively hold the cassette half with a soft touch. This reduces the influence of motor rotation vibration, sound pressure, and external vibration, and realizes stable driving and clear sound with less modulation noise.In the Digital Tension Servo, the microcomputer controls the voltage of the reel motor according to the size of the wound diameter of the tape, and the tape is wound at the appropriate tape tension. This improves the wow flutter at the beginning of the winding of the tape, which has tended to be unstable in the past.In the wing chassis, the shape of the bottom plate of the power transformer mounting part and the cassette mechanical mounting part is devised. By effectively releasing vibration to the outside from the insulator, the circuit board is isolated from the rotational vibration of the power transformer and motor.The Accurate Transmission uses a high-speed active servo regulator that consists of a transformer winding dedicated to the amplifier in the amplifier power supply circuit. This prevents deviation in dimensional accuracy and parallelism between parts, and improves stability and reliability to withstand the use of large No. 10 reel.In addition, the mechanical parts are laid out as a unit by block to ensure high maintainability.A 4-pole / 8-pole 2-speed hysteresis synchronous motor and a 100 mm   large flywheel are used to drive the capstan, and a 6 mm   straight shaft with less than 0.2 ? of roundness is used for the capstan.The reel drive is equipped with a special 6-pole inner rotor induction motor from Shinkai that combines eddy current type characteristics with induction type large starting torque with low heat generation. sections.overview: A universal player developed as a reference player that brings out the potential of DVD audio to the maximum.For the D/A conversion, a 192 kHz / 24-bit D/A converter developed jointly with Barr Brown is used for all channels. For the two main channels, two 192 kHz / 24-bit D/A converters are used as differential mode to reduce common-mode noise by mutually canceling each other.A digital filter compatible with the 192 kHz high-sampling frequency of DVD audio was jointly developed with NPC and incorporated into the digital filter.In order to achieve high sound quality, it is equipped with a pure audio clock reference function that switches the crystal oscillator according to the sampling frequency of the disc to be reproduced.The crystal oscillator is switched between 44.1 kHz (44.1 kHz, 88.2 kHz, 176.4 kHz) and 48 kHz (48 kHz, 96 kHz, 192 kHz), and the non-selected oscillator is turned off to supply an accurate clock and improve sound quality.It is equipped with a CD Digital Direct function that transmits the CD via the shortest path without going through the DSP section when playing back the CD, preventing signal degradation completely.The power supply section uses an R-core power transformer for audio circuits. In addition, the layout is completely separate from the power supply section so that noise from servo circuits and digital circuits does not interfere with the audio section.The R-core transformer is characterized by low leakage flux, which is a source of noise in the player.High-bit ICs are used for all audio channels. Using a unique algorithm developed from wide-range technology, the smooth waveform of the original sound of digital signals recorded with 16 bits of quantization is estimated and re-quantized to 24 bits.A low-impedance PX capacitor is used in the main unit of the digital section to reproduce clear, flexible, and high sound.In addition, a custom-designed power capacitor with thorough anti-noise measures is installed to eliminate minute noise from the power line.The video off function (Auto/on/off) is used to turn off the power and ground of the video circuit during non-visual source playback. In addition, by processing everything in the digital stage, mutual interference of signals is suppressed and high sound quality is achieved.Video film is usually 24 frames per second, and DVD-Video movie software is 24 frames per second, which is the same as this movie film. Information on all 525 scanning lines is written on one screen and stored on a disc.In order to reproduce this progressive system image, it is equipped with 2-3 pull-down system "Pure Cinema Progressive Scan Circuit".For film materials such as motion picture software, frames are inserted into the original source based on 2-3 processing information in the telecine process to realize more natural and film-like progressive images. For discriminating between video signals and noise, appropriate parameters are set for each of the three signals of luminance [Y], color difference [Cb], and [Cr], which constitute the video, and noise is detected with high precision.The video digital signal read from the disc is processed by a fine-focus digital filter built into the new video quality enhancer VQE3. By upsampling the 4 : 2 : 2 video signal recorded on the disc to a 4 : 4 : 4 signal with high precision, the resolution of the video signal is increased and noise is suppressed.In addition to the existing "YNR", "CNR" and "Detail" functions, new parameters such as "Progressive Motion" and "White Level" are incorporated into the image quality adjustment function.It stores the image quality settings for 15 DVD discs in flash memory and automatically recalls the settings the next time the disc is played. By this, it can be used simply and straight to bring out the unique taste.Moreover, a linear envelope D/A converter is mounted, and in order to keep the error of D/A conversion low, the left and right MSB are adjusted independently to reduce the 0 cross distortion of each channel.The digital filter uses an 8 fs LSI with an operation word length of 20x22-bit to enhance fidelity.CD direct construction is used to minimize the signal path.In addition to the simple and straight layout, the digital servo circuit reduces the number of parts to reduce interference between signals. The power supply circuit also minimizes the transmission path and balances the   power supply to eliminate interference with the signal flow.A bifilar winding is used to improve the balance accuracy between the   voltage of the power supply and the output impedance of the power supply by simultaneously winding the + and - wires into the winding for the audio circuit of the power supply transformer, thereby enabling stable driving.In addition, 4 independent windings, 4 independent power supplies and 7 regulators are adopted to prevent mutual interference.The honeycomb chassis, which is highly effective against low-frequency external vibration, is covered with an ultra-fine pile of electrostatic bristles. This reduces reflection from high-frequency floors and fine vibration of the honeycomb chassis surface.In addition, by adopting side wood, resonance elimination and high rigidity of the whole cabinet are enhanced.It is equipped with an auto program edit function in which the microcomputer automatically programs according to the order of songs when the tape time is set, a computer program edit function in which the microcomputer automatically programs the order of songs according to the tape time, and a time fade edit function in which you can specify the desired time with the 10 key button and it automatically fades out at that time and becomes a pause.It is equipped with a time location function, and by specifying the place you want to listen in the performance time, it automatically searches and starts the performance.Equipped with a display on/off switch to suppress noise generation.It is equipped with a program random play function in which the microcomputer randomly selects the order of all songs and plays them.It also has a music window function that automatically plays your favorite phrases one after another.Equipped with a deck sync function for one touch tape editing, it can be used with Pioneer's cassette deck with CD-DECK sync mark.

sections.title: PIONEER-EXCLUSIVE Pioneer
sections.overview: This is a CD player that inherits the high sound quality technology of the PD 3000 and further improves sound quality by thoroughly simplifying it.In order to minimize the power loss and prevent the influence of others, CD direct construction is adopted, and the layout is simple and straight along the signal flow from the pickup to the lineout.First of all, the printed circuit boards for digital / servo and analog circuits are separated independently. Moreover, with low impedance grounding, the sealed PCB (double-sided board), which provides an effective shielding effect against jumping from digital to analog, is used for digital, analog, and power supply. In addition, the analog board is designed to be as short as possible from input to output. At the same time, the symmetrical structure for left and right independence is adopted.This CD direct construction reduces the interference between signals.In the power supply circuit, the transmission path is minimized and the   power supply is parallelized. The power supply board is directly connected to the power supply line of the analog board.The digital filter uses a 20-bit operation 18-bit output digital filter.The sampling frequency of 44.1 kHz is increased eight times to 352.8 kHz, and a Butterworth third order low-pass filter with excellent phase characteristics and frequency ripple is used in the analog stage.The D/A converter employs a real 18-bit D/A converter with independent configuration on the left and right sides. It performs 18-bit operation at all levels from large input to Oire power, eliminating interference and phase shift between channels.We have also adopted a linear envelope system (glitch less type), a unique technology of Pioneer, to improve the accuracy of D/A conversion and reduce 0 cross distortion by correcting the upper bit error to an appropriate value.In addition, by double and triple D/A conversion accuracy support such as exclusive winding for D/A converter, exclusive power supply, low impedance guard link, etc., minute level reproducibility is improved.The pickup is equipped with a clean laser pickup developed in-house by Pioneer.By reducing the number of optical components such as collimator lenses, the power loss of the optical system has been greatly reduced. Moreover, the aberration in the optical path has been reduced, making possible a clean and low-distortion pickup.In addition, by adopting a photodetector with a built-in I/V conversion head amplifier that amplifies small signals of several microamperes to approximately 200 mV, in combination with an Accu-Focus system, the occurrence of jitter due to reading errors and disturbance is suppressed.In addition, an engineering plastic pick-up body developed by dividing the pick-up body into approximately 1000 elements and repeating strength analysis has been adopted, enabling precise shape that was difficult with conventional die casting.An A-class push-pull FET buffer amplifier is used for two stages, the lineout of the analog stage and the I/V amplifier stage, enabling more accurate waveform transmission without being affected by the connected load.We have developed and installed a multi-resonance absorber (MRA), which is a vibration-free and vibration-free technology for dealing with unnecessary vibration frequencies over all bands from vibration isolation of pickup handling at minute levels to vibration isolation of PCB (double-sided substrate).As the second base after the honeycomb chassis, a float base was newly installed, and unnecessary vibration is suppressed by floating the circuit board and the pickup.The pickup uses a magnetic disk stabilizer that reduces unnecessary vibration of the disk.In addition, the newly developed linear motor servo mechanism, which generates less vibration, has a low center of gravity structure, and is firmly supported by a high-rigidity, high-internal loss FRP mechanism base, which is mounted on a multi-resonance absorber to eliminate resonance.A 4-mm-thick aluminum panel is used for the front panel, and a double-structured aluminum top bonnet is used to eliminate resonance and increase rigidity of the bonnet.The system is also supported by copper plated honeycomb chassis and large honeycomb insulators.The power transformer employs a large capacity transformer with a laminated top core structure that has a core size of approximately three times or more of the required capacity and reduces magnetic distortion, vibration, and leakage flux. This transformer employs a bifilar twist winding that improves the balance of output voltage, reduces noise and vibration, and reduces stray capacitance.In addition, four independent windings, four independent power circuits / A conversion, digital and display components, we have adopted four independent windings, four independent power supply circuits, and seven regulators. In addition, the audio circuit has a discrete push-pull regulator that exhibits excellent transient response characteristics against load fluctuations. This realizes a high-precision clean power supply.The power cord uses an OFC extra-thick 4-core power cord with   polarity indication.It is equipped with a clean microcomputer that operates only when the operation key is pressed and prevents scanning noise.In addition, scanning noise when the display is off is taken into consideration, and a display off switch is installed to suppress noise generation.
