sections.title: PIONEER-EXCLUSIVE Pioneer
sections.overview: A reference model CD player developed under the technical concept of Real Transmission Design with the theme of "expressive power of music".It is equipped with an 18-bit 4 x oversampling digital filter. By calculating the sampling frequency and performing 4 x oversampling, unnecessary high-order noise is moved to the high-frequency range. It is removed with a low-order discrete analog low-pass filter with slow characteristics.As a result, excellent phase characteristics and low distortion audio characteristics are obtained.The D/A converter is equipped with a real 18-bit twin D/A converter. By increasing the quantization level from 16 bits to 18 bits, we have succeeded in reducing quantization noise to 1/4.It is equipped with the Accu-Focus system, the pickup technology used in the Laser Vision Player LD-S1.The photodetector is divided into four parts for focus servo control. The laser beam that hits the photodetector moves across the photodetector along the direction of the pit travel, causing a time lag between the leading signal and the trailing Yukinobu, resulting in a phase difference in the high-frequency range.The AcFOCUS system delays the preceding signal and matches the phase with the following signal to obtain an RF signal with less reading errors.Newly developed pickup is mounted on the pickup part.By using a high-magnification (7.5 times) finite objective lens without the need for a collimator lens as in the past, we have achieved a stable optical path with a margin in the optical path length. In addition, by increasing the thickness of the half mirror as much as possible and designing the angle of incidence as large as possible, we minimize distortion caused by external forces, reduce harmful aberrations in the optical path, and improve the quality of the optical signal.The latest IC technology is also applied to the photodetector, and the buffer amplifier is integrated in the same IC to realize a signal system that is stable against disturbances. In addition, analysis technology using a large computer is utilized to mold the pickup body with resin to reduce the use of adhesive, which reduces reliability.The power supply section uses a twin power transformer that completely separates the servo / digital power supply and the audio power supply from the transformer itself. In addition, the OFC extra-thick 4-core power cord that separates the core wire from the base of the power plug reduces the subtle influence (wraparound) from the servo circuit and the digital circuit to the audio circuit. In addition, the audio transformer uses OFC bifilar winding and silica sand resin impregnation that suppresses vibration.For audio circuits, we have adopted a discrete push-pull power supply circuit that uses high-precision components such as constant current diodes to stabilize the power supply and suppress fluctuations in the power supply voltage. In addition, we have adopted a remote sensing method that detects changes in the voltage at the load end, feeds back the voltage, and controls the voltage, greatly reducing the effect of pattern impedance from the power supply circuit to the load end.The audio circuit uses a large circuit board of 140x300mm, on which parts are arranged in an appropriate pattern layout independently and symmetrically on the left and right sides.In addition, a double-sided circuit board is used to enhance the shielding effect, and the structure is completely separated from the servo system circuit to eliminate mutual interference.An A-class FET buffer amplifier is used in the analog circuit to realize stable waveform transmission that is not affected by load fluctuation of the power supply, mutual interference of each circuit, load of the pre-stage and post-stage amplifier.The conventional digital signal circuit had separate clock circuits for the decoder, D/A converter, and system control microcomputer. However, in the PD 3000, the D/A converter, digital filter, decoder, and system control microcomputer are synchronized by the clock. This prevents the generation of beats due to interference of multiple clocks.In order to protect the pickup from unnecessary vibration, non-resonance lamisert mechanical base is adopted.The mechanical base supporting the pickup is made into a double structure, copper plating is applied to the base of the pickup side, and it is molded with special resin. This greatly improves the vibration damping characteristics, and at the same time eliminates the effect of magnetic strain.In order to eliminate as much as possible the effects of unnecessary intermittent vibration and flux generated by the power transformer, an isolated transformer base is set outside the player.Ultra thick aluminum angle and solid brass insulator are adopted, and the transformer block is floating structure.The chassis has a honeycomb shape that greatly increases rigidity. The 1.2 mm thick steel plate provides excellent vibration damping characteristics. The entire chassis is plated with copper to achieve the same effect as two metals bonded together with copper plating, greatly reducing unnecessary vibration and magnetostriction.Pioneer's vibration analysis technology vibration analysis technology, we have developed a disc stabilizer to improve sound quality by suppressing disc resonance. In particular, the PD-3000 uses a vertical clamp structure to further improve disc mounting accuracy, and a magnet catch system without mechanical contact between the disc stabilizer and the clamper that supports it to completely suppress unnecessary disc vibration.In order to protect the optical system mechanism from external vibration, it is floated from the chassis. It uses a low center of gravity coaxial suspension made of special rubber and spring with excellent damping characteristics. It is fixed by ceramic support columns with high rigidity and high internal loss.A large insulator with high vibration damping characteristics is used for the insulator, and the honeycomb shape is molded with resin to increase rigidity.The analog output terminal uses independent gold plated pin jacks on the left and right to minimize contact resistance and provide mechanical strength as well as the effect of the gold-plated terminal that is resistant to aging.We also use high-grade components for audio, such as resistors and capacitors, for repeated trial listening.The pickup is driven by a linear motor system with excellent response speed.In addition, the spindle motor is equipped with a high-torque brushless D. D. motor with three times the starting torque of conventional motors.The tray section is made of special resin with high specific gravity to improve weight and accuracy. At the same time, the sliding section is made of metal bearing metal, combined with the wire drive system to realize smooth and quiet loading operation.Built-in functions include a memory backup function that stores the program when the power was turned off last time, a time fade edit function that automatically fades out according to the tape time, a music window that automatically plays specified phrases in and out, a one touch fade function, variable fade time, and auto space.Equipped with a changeover switch that stops the operation of unused circuits, it can cut off noise sources from unused circuits. In addition, the headphone circuit operates only when it is plugged into a jack. In addition, an FL off switch is also equipped to prevent scanning noise when the FL indicator is turned on.

sections.title: PIONEER-EXCLUSIVE Pioneer
sections.overview: A reference CD player developed by combining Pioneer's proprietary laser and digital technology, servo technology, and non-resonance technology.Equipped with 8 fs real 18 bit direct linear conversion.First, the 8 x oversampling digital filter uses a high-precision LSI with an operation word length of 20x22bit to improve the calculation accuracy. In addition to obtaining high-precision data, the sampling frequency is shifted up 8 times to 352.8 kHz, increasing the density of quantized data and reducing the load on the analog filter.In addition, the D/A converter uses the handpicked Pioneer Super Version of the one package real 18 bitLSI one package real 18, especially with regard to linearity and low-level distortion.In addition, by using the linear envelope method to adjust each bit to an appropriate value one by one, high-precision D/A conversion is achieved by converting not only MSB, which has a high importance of pit errors, but also 2 sb, 3 sb, and 4 sb to minimize errors.This greatly reduces the distortion caused by 0 cross distortion and bit error.In order to minimize the signal path, a CD direct conversion is adopted, and the signal path from the pickup to the output terminal is minimized and each circuit block is arranged properly.For this reason, the main circuit is laid out at the shortest distance along the signal flow, such as by placing the optical system mechanism in the center. Moreover, the wiring materials are also made as short as possible to minimize exposure.In order to make CD direct construction more thorough and effective, digital and servo, analog circuit board and power circuit board are separated independently. Moreover, analog circuit board adopts full monoconstruction of Lch and Rch from the digital data stage in pursuit of homogeneity of Lch and Rch, reducing interference between signals.In addition, it uses a sealed PCB (double-sided substrate) that achieves low impedance grounding and provides effective shielding against digital noise. In addition, low-impedance 70 ? m ultra-thick OFC (oxygen-free copper) substrates are used for Lch/Rch analog substrates and power supply substrates.The pickup is equipped with an in-house developed clean laser pickup with improved laser efficiency.By reducing the number of optical components such as the collimator lens, the power loss of the optical system is greatly reduced compared with conventional pickups, and the aberration in the optical path is also reduced, enabling more accurate signal pickup.A built-in I/V in I/V conversion head amplifier. The laser beam that bounces off the pit surface is converted into an electric signal of several microamperes by the photodetector. In the clean laser pickup, the photodetector has a built-in I/V amplifier and is amplified to approximately 200 mv order, so that a signal resistant to disturbance noise can be sent out.In order to obtain highly accurate RF signals from pit signals, we have adopted an Accu-Focus system.When a four part photodetector for focus servo receives a laser beam, a phase difference occurs due to the time difference between the preceding signal and the following signal, causing a disturbance in the synthesized RF signal. In the Accu-Focus system, a delay circuit delays the preceding signal to match the phase with the following signal.As a result, a high-output RF signal with few read errors can be obtained.The power transformer is a twin power transformer configuration in which analog circuits and digital / servo circuits are completely separated to prevent mutual interference between analog and digital / servo circuits.In particular, we have adopted bifilar twist windings made of OFC wire for the windings of transformers for audio circuits, increasing the balance of   voltage and output impedance of the power supply to the level of   2 transformer system, and improving driving performance in the low-frequency range.In addition, a 4-core OFC cord is used for the power cord, and the analog circuit and digital / servo circuit are independent from the power plug to prevent the inflow of digital noise from the power supply.Moreover, to prevent vibration and induction noise generated by the power transformer from being transmitted to the main body, the transformer is mounted on an isorated base, which is an extremely thick aluminum angle separated from the main chassis. Moreover, the isorated base floats with the main body and is supported by special brass legs.The power supply unit uses a push-pull power supply system.Current control elements are installed in parallel so that the power supply voltage can be stabilized by controlling the current control elements when the load current suddenly changes. In addition, high stability is achieved by increasing the number of discrete components and introducing high-quality sound devices. This suppresses fluctuations in the power supply voltage and improves the transient response characteristics. In addition to realizing low impedance, the harmonic distortion of the power supply is also kept low.In addition, a 2-transformer, 4-part, 19-regulator, low-impedance 70 ? m ultra-thick OFC (oxygen-free copper) substrate is used to prevent interference between blocks.A class A operation FET buffer amplifier is used in all stages after the D/A converter. By reducing the load of each stage and reducing the output impedance of the amplifier as a whole, the analog section is not affected by capacitance components such as low-pass filters which become the load of the amplifier.By using Class-A operation, fluctuation of power consumption during operation can be reduced, and low distortion factor is realized.The spindle motor of the disk drive mechanism is equipped with a high-torque coreless D. D. spindle motor with a starting torque of 65g/cm. In addition, the spindle diameter is extremely large (4.5 mm), making it resistant to load fluctuations and providing stable disk drive performance.In addition, a high-speed linear motor with fast tracking response is used for the pickup drive to realize accurate tracing and high-speed access with an average of 0.5 seconds or less.Taking note of the adverse effect of disc resonance on sound quality, we have adopted a vertical clamp type disc stabilizer that improves mounting accuracy with the disc.In addition, it employs a magnet catch system without mechanical contact between the stabilizer and clamper, which thoroughly reduces unnecessary vibration of the disk and ensures smooth rotation.Lamisert mechanical base is adopted as the mechanical base supporting the optical mechanism.This is made by molding two sheets of steel plate with special resin. Furthermore, by plating the steel plate on the pickup side with copper, vibration damping characteristics are improved and the influence of magnetic strain is eliminated.Also, this mechanical base is fixed to a ceramic support called ceramic mechanical support via a coaxial suspension, which is a special rubber and spring integrated coaxially, and blocks vibration from the chassis.The chassis uses a copper-plated hybrid honeycomb chassis, an evolution of the honeycomb chassis.First, the honeycomb chassis is plated with copper to achieve excellent vibration control and reduced magnetic distortion. In addition, superfine pile is electrostatically implanted on the floor side of the honeycomb chassis to suppress high-frequency reflection from the floor and minute vibration on the chassis surface. This enables total control from unwanted vibration with large amplitude to minute vibration.Large-size honeycomb insulators made of special resin molded into a honeycomb shape are used as insulators.It is equipped with a clean microcomputer that starts scanning only when the operation key is pressed to reduce noise. In addition, it is also equipped with a display-off switch that turns off the display when it is not necessary, paying attention to the slight scanning noise that occurs when the display turns on.In addition, it is equipped with a digital analogout change-over switch that stops the operation of unused circuits and prevents noise contamination.The front panel uses a lacquer style panel made of extra-thick extruded aluminum material.It is equipped with 2 systems of digital out which is coaxial with light.It is equipped with a time location function that can locate in units of 1 second in a stop state.

This eliminates the need to use a high-order low-pass filter and realizes a low distortion factor with small phase rotation up to the high frequency band of 20 kHz.In order to prevent the slight vibration of the disc itself, which adversely affects the performance, the material and shape have been improved, and a new disc stabilizer with newly developed special resin has been adopted on the surface of the material.In addition, by using a ball-aligning disk stabilizer composed of four ball bearings, the rotational axis of the disk stabilizer is automatically aligned with the rotational axis of the disk table. This eliminates the misalignment of the rotational axis while maintaining the necessary play of the disk stabilizer.A linear servo system has been adopted to further improve the basic characteristics of the pickup, eliminate unnecessary resonance and crosstalk of the actuator, and prevent sound skipping by appropriate servo characteristics and gain control.A newly developed small-size pickup is used for the pickup part.It uses a new type actuator and has a structure in which the lens base, which is measured while ensuring sufficient secondary moment of section, is supported by a beryllium copper spring with a special hardened surface.This spring has a waveform shape that takes into consideration the vibration dynamics. It efficiently drives the center of gravity of the movable part with a simple magnetic circuit and follows the pit together with the servo circuit.In addition, the magnetic circuit is supported by a base with high internal loss, making it resistant to external vibration.In order to achieve sufficient rigidity and compact shape, the body is box-shaped and thin-walled precision aluminum die-cast is used.A pure transmission system has been adopted in pursuit of high-purity transmission.The digital part reduces unnecessary vibration of the disk due to the disk stabilizer and eliminates the adverse effect of external noise on the digital signal.In the audio section, a low-noise low-output impedance regulator is placed close to the audio circuit on the PCB to supply each block circuit with reduced impedance rise.In addition, the use of IC common to L and R is eliminated, and L and R symmetrical straight pattern is adopted.Digital signal processing performed by multiple LSIs is processed by a single master clock to prevent jitter components from being included in digital signals and beats between signals, thereby minimizing the influence on servo circuits and audio circuits.In addition to the digital servo system, audio system, and FL display system, the power supply section uses a 4-circuit independent power supply with a separate transformer for the D/A converter.In addition, the power transformer is attached to the sub-chassis, and the floating structure itself is supported by four insulators to reduce vibration caused by the power transformer.High rigidity is achieved by incorporating honeycomb ribs in the chassis.In addition, copper plating is applied to reduce magnetic strain.In addition, in order to protect the optical system mechanism from external vibration, the center of gravity is designed to be lower than the support part of the mechanism.As a result, unstable lateral vibration is reduced and more stable signal reading is possible.The insulator is made of material with high rigidity and high vibration damping rate.In addition, the optical system part that avoids vibration is equipped with audio insulation that only floats the copper plated screw are used.It is equipped with an auto program edit function. This allows the use of a low-pass filter with a loose characteristic, and realizes low-distortion audio characteristics with little phase rotation up to high frequencies.The D/A converter uses a glitch less type twin D/A converter.This eliminates the need for a deglitch circuit and enables a simple circuit configuration. This greatly reduces the vibration generated during disc rotation.The chassis uses a honeycomb chassis with structural strength increased by honeycomb ribs. sections.overview: A CD player developed by inheriting the technical ideas of PD 3000.The PD 8070 uses a core material that has more than three times the required capacity of 15 va for the transformer, and the power supply section is reinforced so that it can provide a stable power supply without affecting parts such as servo systems and audio systems.In addition, the audio and D/A sections are equipped with bifilar twist transformers to increase the output voltage balance and reduce noise, vibration and stray capacitance. As a result, the analog filter of the next stage can be used with gentle characteristics, and audio characteristics with low distortion factor are obtained over the entire band.The D/A converter uses a Glitchless 16-bit twin D/A converter that performs D/A conversion by Dynamic Element Matching (DEM) method and eliminates glitch noise.This simplifies the circuit structure for higher sound quality and improves channel separation and S/N ratio by making the left and right independent twin structure.Similar to the PD 3000, it uses an Accu-Focus system that improves the accuracy of the RF circuit that converts laser light into electrical signals.The pickup section is equipped with a newly developed pickup developed by analyzing polymer materials using a large computer and analyzing technology such as mounting simulation.In addition to the highly reliable pick-up body, the photodetector unit integrates six small buffer amplifiers into one chip to realize a stable signal form against disturbance and enable accurate signal reading.It adopts a floating structure in which the optical system mechanism is lifted from the chassis.In addition, we have developed a ballast and base that reduce the occurrence of unstable lateral vibration by lowering the center of gravity of the mechanical chassis from the support part of the mechanism, and fix it on a ceramic mechanical support with excellent vibration damping characteristics.As a result, the stability of the optical system mechanical part is increased, and the structure is resistant to both external and internal vibrations.We have further improved our original disk stabilizer to prevent unnecessary vibration of the disk, and adopted a magnet clamp type that can fix the disk stabilizer and disk table with the attraction force of a magnet.This new mechanism allows the disk to rotate without contact between the stabilizer and the clamper arm supporting the stabilizer. It greatly reduces vibration generated during disk rotation and effectively blocks the path through which unwanted vibration is transmitted to the pickup.The chassis uses a honeycomb chassis with structural strength increased by honeycomb ribs, and in addition, by copper plating treatment, magnetic strain is greatly reduced.In addition, since it is in the same state as when two metals are bonded by plating treatment, resonance points can be dispersed, and excellent vibration damping characteristics are obtained.An insulator molded into a honeycomb shape is used for the insulator, which efficiently absorbs external efficiently absorbed.It is equipped with a change-over switch that stops the operation of the circuit that is not being used. sections.overview: A CD player that embodies the concept of pure transmission by introducing advanced technologies.A disk stabilizer is used to reduce unnecessary vibration of the disk.The pickup uses aspherical objective lenses and compound lenses to reduce transmission loss of laser power.In addition, the drive unit adopts a focus parallel drive mechanism and cross parallel suspension system to obtain accurate and highly sensitive focus and trace performance.By holding these optical mechanisms in the precision die-cast body, it is resistant to disturbance.A linear servo system is used to prevent sound skipping caused by scratches or dirt on the disc.Taking advantage of the advantages of the 3-beam tracking system, we control the servo amount appropriately so that the leading beam detects scratches and dirt that are different from those of the pit train at the front, and the pickup does not follow the scratches and cause track jump.It employs a method that synchronizes digital signal processing by multiple LSIs with one master clock.This prevents jitter components from being included in digital signals and beats from occurring between signals, minimizing the influence on servo circuits and audio circuits.The audio circuit employs a digital filter, eliminating the need to use a low-pass filter with steep characteristics. As a result, low-distortion characteristics with little phase rotation are obtained up to the high frequency band of 20 kHz.We have adopted a pure transmission system to achieve higher purity transmission.The digital circuit is clearly separated from the analog circuit, and the digital part reduces unnecessary vibration of the disk due to the disk stabilizer and eliminates the adverse effect of external noise on the digital signal.In the audio section, a low-noise low-output impedance regulator is placed close to the audio circuit on the PCB to supply each block circuit with reduced impedance rise.In addition, the use of IC common to L and R is eliminated, and L and R symmetrical straight pattern is adopted.In order to produce stable sound, an insulator with high rigidity and high vibration damping rate is adopted.In addition, the optical mechanism, which avoids vibration, is made into a floating structure, and audio insulation is adopted to reduce external vibration.The power supply for servo, digital and audio systems is a twin power transformer that is completely separated from the transformer itself.This reduces the influence of the servo and digital circuits on the audio circuit.In addition, high-purity OFC windings are used in the Orient Core material for power transformers for audio circuits, and OFC wires are used for the drawers.We use carefully selected parts for high-purity transmission.Glass case electrolytic capacitor, OFC power cord, fast recovery diode, copper-foil styrene capacitor, FOC connection code (gold-plated plug), brass cap carbon resistor, etc. are used. In addition, OFC lead wire and OFC bus bar are used for audio circuit.In particular, all resistors used for audio circuits are within a tolerance of 1%. This doubles the output level and provides audio output with excellent SN ratio and distortion factor.The D/A converter consists of two packages, one for the left and one for the right, and the other for the complementary application.In this method, two input normal data and input inverted data are handled per package, and their outputs are added differentially. sections.overview: A turntable mechanism type CD player with Legato link conversion S.The digital circuit is equipped with newly developed Legato link conversion S.In the Legato link conversion, the components of 20 kHz or higher, which are not recorded on CD, are estimated from the waveform of the original signal based on 1/f attenuation characteristics and reproduced.In addition, the Legato link Conversion S expands on this idea by adding an independent harmonic generation circuit that generates harmonic components. Based on the attenuation characteristics estimated from the original sound, harmonic components above 20 kHz are also generated and added together with the time axis.This improves the response to harsh sounds and eliminates unnecessary ringing.The mechanism section is equipped with a unique CD turntable mechanism.In the conventional tray method, the clamping area for supporting the disk is as small as   32 mm, and there are various problems in suppressing the excessive vibration of the disk. sections.overview: This CD player was the first to adopt a unique turntable system based on the concept of no vibration and no resonance disc developed in the development of disc stabilizers.In the CD turntable system, a pickup and a spindle motor are installed on the top of the disc to hold the entire disc from the bottom. Therefore, the disc is placed on the turntable with the pit surface facing upward. The disc rotates together with the turntable, and the pickup on the top of the disc reads the pit.This mechanism is not only affected by external vibration and sound pressure, but also by the large inertia unique to the CD turntable mechanism, it is possible to suppress unnecessary vibration even when the rotational state changes due to a disc with a sled.In addition, the moment of inertia of the turntable is approximately three times higher than that of the conventional one. It also works advantageously against torque ripple and cogging. Combined with the spindle motor with a starting torque of 65g ? cm, it is robust against load fluctuations and provides highly stable drive performance.As a result, the generation of jitter in the read signal due to vibration and surface blur is reduced by approximately 15%.We have adopted an in-house developed Clean Laser Pickup.By reducing the number of optical components such as collimator lenses, the power loss of the optical system is reduced, and aberrations in the optical path are also reduced, making it possible to read a clean and low-distortion pit signal.In addition, it uses a photodetector with built-in I/V conversion head amplifier to amplify a weak signal of several ? A to the order of approximately 200 mV, enabling transmission that is less affected by disturbance noise.A high-precision engineering plastic body is used for the pickup body. By dividing the pickup body into approximately 1000 elements and performing strength analysis, a high-precision and precise shape is realized.The pickup drive is equipped with a silent linear motor servo mechanism with excellent response and low vibration.In addition, in order to rotate the CD turntable with large inertia mass, the spindle motor is equipped with a large brushless hole motor with starting torque of 65g ? cm. In addition, it is combined with an extra-thick shaft of   4.5 mm, so that the drive performance is strong against load fluctuations and stable against rotational speed fluctuations from the inner circumference to the outer circumference.In order to obtain high-precision focus servo, the photodetector is divided into four parts. However, when receiving laser light, a phase difference occurs between the leading signal and the trailing Yukinobu signal, causing a disturbance in the synthesized RF-signal.To solve this problem, we have adopted an Accu-Focus system. By delaying the preceding signal with a delay circuit to match the phase with the following signal, we can obtain an RF signal with less signal reading error.The D/A converter uses an 8 fs digital filter and a left-right independent bit stream 1-bit DAC.New Bit Stream The 1-bit DAC has only one electronic switch and one current source, and the analog quantity is expressed by the on/off of one electronic switch. This eliminates the problem of the error of the resistor and the difference of the operation timing unlike the multi-bit DAC. Therefore, it has excellent linearity and in principle, there is no non-linearity or 0 cross distortion.In addition, while multi-bit DACs express analog signals in terms of vertical amplitude width (pulse height), 1-bit DACs express them in terms of horizontal time axis (coarse and dense waves of pulses), so it is called PDM (Pulse Density Modulation) method. In response to digital data input, pulses are generated at a high speed of tens of thousandths of a second, and analog signal waveforms are converted into coarse and dense waves of pulses.In the 1-bit DAC, noise shaping is performed to reduce requantization noise caused by bit compression. In the PD-T07, over-sampling as high as 192 fs is performed at the pre-stage, and the signal is sent to the third order noise shaper to suppress the influence of out-of-band noise.A system clock as low as 16.93 MHz is used as the system clock necessary to control all operations of the 1-bit DAC to suppress the effect of jitter.Attention is also paid to the application, and an independent oscillation circuit is provided, and anti-vibration and anti-magnetic processing are applied.Lamisert mechanical base is adopted to protect the optical mechanism from vibration from the outside.This is made by molding two sheets of steel plate with special resin, and copper plating is applied to improve vibration damping characteristics and suppress the occurrence of magnetic strain.This mechanical base is mounted on a mechanical chassis via a coaxial suspension with special rubber and springs, and the lower turntable base is also mounted via a coaxial suspension. The float structure prevents external vibration from the chassis.Using direct construction, each circuit block is laid out simply and straight along the signal flow, and the shortest signal path is realized.In addition, the digital / servo and audio circuit boards are separated to prevent mutual interference. In addition, a sealed PCB (double-sided circuit board) is used for the digital and analog circuit boards to provide an advantageous shielding effect against noise jumping from the digital to the analog circuit boards. In addition, the analog circuit boards are also connected at the shortest distance from the input terminal to the output terminal and have a symmetrical configuration.The audio circuit after D/A conversion uses a class-A operation FET buffer amplifier. By reducing the output impedance, the influence of the load of the connected amplifier is reduced. In addition, by using class-A operation, fluctuations in power consumption during operation can be reduced, the influence on other circuits is reduced, and a low distortion factor is realized.The power transformer is a twin power transformer for digital / servo circuits and analog circuits.In addition, the transformer for the audio circuit has a bifilar winding, and by increasing the balance of output impedance and inductance, the + side and - side power supply are supplied under the same condition, contributing to sound quality improvement.In addition, the four parts of servo / digital, servo drive, and audio + and - are independently rectified to eliminate mutual interference. In particular, the audio power supply uses a discrete push-pull power supply to provide a power supply with low output impedance and strong resistance to load fluctuations. In addition, the left and right independent power supplies are used for the DAC. The power supply for the servo drive is separated into one for the turntable and another for other drives. By stabilizing each power supply, the influence of motor and actuator operation is eliminated.Newly developed multi-layer honeycomb chassis is used for the chassis.This chassis is based on a honeycomb chassis made of BMC (Bulk Molding Compound), which has high internal loss and excellent vibration resistance and strength. Steel plates and cushioning materials with excellent electromagnetic shielding are layered to achieve high rigidity and excellent vibration resistance. In addition, the PD-T07 is plated with copper to reduce magnetostriction and improve vibration resistance.In addition to the large honeycomb insulator that absorbs external vibration, a fifth insulator is installed in the center of the chassis to ensure vibration control and weight balance and support the center mechanism.A cushion material with excellent damping properties is attached to the thick extruded aluminum bonnet to eliminate resonance.The power cord is a 4-core cord that separates the core wire from the power plug for the servo system and analog system only.In addition, it uses OFC (high-purity oxygen-free copper).We use carefully selected items such as capacitors and resistors for audio.In addition, the circuit boards and parts are shielded so that high frequency waves do not escape from them and affect other circuits. In addition to the full-face sealed servo board and the use of glass-epoxy double-sided boards for audio circuits, capacitors and wiring materials are also treated uniquely to prevent noise.A balanced output terminal is provided so that it can be connected to an amplifier with a balanced input.It is equipped with a clean microcomputer that operates only when the key is pressed, and it cancels weak scanning noise.In addition, it is equipped with a display off switch that suppresses noise generation when lighting.Equipped with a digital / anlogout changeover switch.

sections.overview:
* Limited production of 2,700 units  220,000 (released in 1996)

This is a limited model CD player that was developed by gathering the wide range technology of pioneer who pursued high quality digital sound.It is equipped with Hi-bit, Pioneer's original technology.In order to estimate the waveform of the original sound from the d-eta stored on the CD, we focused on the small-level signal less than the number of quantization bits. We requantized 16-bit data in the CD format to 24-bit data, and expanded the dynamic range to 120 dB, the maximum amount that can be perceived by the human ear, while reducing quantization distortion.It is equipped with Legato link conversion S, and the waveform of the original signal is estimated and reproduced based on 1/f attenuation characteristics for the component of 20 khz or more which is not recorded on CD.In addition, an independent harmonic generation circuit has been added to the overtone. Based on the attenuation characteristics estimated from the original sound, overtone components above 20 kHz are also generated. By adding these components together with the time axis, the playback band is expanded to 50 kHz, while eliminating unnecessary ringing.The D/A converter section, which converts 24-bit data reproduced by the Hi-bit Legato Link Conversion S into analog data, is equipped with a newly developed wide-range DAC.By integrating two multi-bit DACs with the same characteristics into one chip, eliminating 0 cross distortion and glisziness, and widening the frequency band to 50 kHz, more faithful analog conversion is realized.The newly developed magnetic barrier substrate coated with magnetic material on the circuit board is used to suppress generation and propagation of digital noise.In addition, the digital / servo and audio boards are separated independently to prevent noise generation and propagation within the set.A specially designed high-quality part "Great Supply" is used for the rectifier condenser, and a twin power transformer for digital & servo and analog circuits is installed to prevent noise generation due to interference of circuits.In addition, the power supply circuit independently rectifies 5 parts of digital & servo, servo drive, D/A converter, audio + and - by means of a 5-part, 13-regulator to prevent interference between the power supply and the circuit. In addition, an independently developed discrete low-impedance power supply circuit is used for the analog output to prevent impedance increase and external noise in the power transmission line.It is equipped with a clean laser pickup developed in-house.This pickup reduces power loss by eliminating optical components such as the collimator lens, and realizes signal folding with low distortion.A class A FET buffer amplifier is installed in the audio circuit after D/A conversion to prevent signal degradation.A large brushless hole motor (high starting torque 65g ? cm) is mounted on a 4.5 mm diameter extra-thick shaft / spindle motor.It adopts a multi-layered honeycomb chassis with excellent vibration control, and uses a lamisert mechanical base molded with special resin and overlapping different metals for the mechanical base.In addition, a floating structure has been adopted to improve vibration control and vibration isolation.Equipped with a unique CD turntable mechanism that reduces unnecessary vibration of the disk.Moment of inertia is improved by about 3 times by supporting the disk from the bottom to the whole surface.It uses direct construction with the shortest signal path, connects analog circuits in the shortest distance, and is shielded by copper-plated steel sheet.It is equipped with Computer Program Edit which changes the order of songs to minimize the remaining time of the tape just by setting the time of the tape with the remote control, Time Fade Edit which automatically fades out to a pause state when the tape time is specified, and Auto Program Edit which judges how many songs can be recorded and records the last song without interruption when the tape time is specified.Wireless remote control is included.

sections.overview: A CD player with a Legato link conversion in addition to a CD turntable system.For natural CD playback that is closer to the original music signal, it is equipped with Legato link conversion.Legato Link Conversion captures music signals on the time axis and connects music signal data smoothly over time. Based on the signal recorded on a CD, the signal is connected using a function curve set to approximate the original music signal, thereby obtaining a waveform close to the original music signal with less ringing.By realizing waveform transmission with excellent impulse response, frequency components of 20 kHz or higher corresponding to 1/f attenuation characteristics can be reproduced, making soft and natural music playback possible.The mechanism section employs a CD turntable mechanism with a pickup and spindle motor moved upward. This allows the disc to be held from the bottom to the entire surface, reducing unnecessary vibration.The moment of inertia of the turntable is three times larger than that of the conventional system, and it is resistant to load fluctuations and realizes stable rotational performance.The D/A converter uses a high-speed pulse flow D/A converter developed independently.This D/A converter reduces the requantization noise by operating the noise shaper at a high oversampling frequency of 384 fs. By increasing the oversampling frequency, the noise shaper order can also be used at a low second order, reducing the effect of out-of-band noise and analog low-pass filters on sound quality.In addition, by operating the master clock at a low clock frequency of 16.93 MHz, the effect of jitter is minimized.This D/A converter also increases the duty ratio, which is the on/off timing ratio of the 1-bit output, from 50% to 100%. This doubles the output level and provides audio output with a high SN ratio and low distortion.We have adopted an in-house developed Clean Laser Pickup.This pickup uses fewer optical components and less aberration in the optical path to improve laser efficiency and realize low-distortion signal reading. In addition, it uses a photodetector with built-in I/V head amplifier and an accurate focus system to reduce the effects of reading errors and jitter. The pickup body uses a high-precision engineering pickup body.The audio circuit uses a class-A operation FET buffer amplifier. The low-output impedance reduces the influence of the load of connected equipment. In addition, the class-A operation reduces the fluctuation of power consumption during operation and realizes a low distortion factor.In order to completely eliminate vibration and resonance that adversely affect sound quality, newly developed acoustic shell construction has been adopted. By making the shape rounded like a shell, it has high rigidity and excellent vibration resistance.The underbase on the bottom has a shell shape with a loose R and is protein coated. This shell shape has the effect of diffusing sound pressure inside and outside. The side chassis and both side panels on the upper part of the mechanism are also shell-shaped to eliminate parallel surfaces that tend to generate standing waves as much as possible.In addition, the two underbases have a solid structure in which a copper plated 2 mm thick steel plate is placed on the bottom of the underbase via a 20 mm thick extruded aluminum beam. In addition, a space is secured between the two underbases, and the wiring material from the power transformer for audio is passed through the bottom and connected to the upper audio circuit board from the closest point to the upper audio circuit board. We also pursue direct construction to minimize signal path.We have also adopted a metal-machined shell-type insulator to absorb external vibrations.Equipped with three independent transformers for digital & servo, analog and D/A converters, and a 6-part, 15-regulator power supply circuit to separate six parts for digital & servo, servo drive, D/A converter, audio +, - and FL to eliminate mutual interference.A newly developed discrete power supply is used for the audio circuit, and for the D/A converter, a rectifier circuit and an independent stabilizing power supply circuit are used from a dedicated transformer to eliminate the influence of other power supplies.The power supply for the servo drive is independent for the turntable and for other drives to ensure stability, and the digital output is also a dedicated power supply.A brushless hole motor with a starting torque of 65g ? cm is used for the spindle motor that supports the turntable system. Combined with a   4.5 mm extra-thick shaft, it realizes stable rotational performance that is resistant to load fluctuations.In addition, the pickup is driven by a silent linear motor servo mechanism to realize high speed access.In order to prevent vibration from being transmitted to the board and power supply, we are making the disk drive and mechanism vibration-free and resonance-free.In addition to the silent chassis, which covers the entire mechanism and improves vibration resistance, the lamisert mechanism base, which is molded with special resin by overlapping two different metals, and the turntable base is mounted on the mechanism chassis via coaxial suspension and has a double float structure, reducing unnecessary vibration from inside and outside.Equipped with a balanced output that is not easily affected by external noise.Uses an OFC4-core power cord with polarity display with separate core wires for digital & servo and analog only.Aluminum panel stabilizer with increased rigidity and vibration resistance is adopted.Equipped with a display off switch to prevent scanning noise. Also equipped with a clean microcomputer (for backup).Equipped with digital / analog change-over switch (for backup)Non-magnetic gold plated RCA output jack is used.Also, OFC (oxygen-free copper) is used for the analog circuit board.

sections.overview: This CD recorder was commercialized in pursuit of ease of use and reliability for commercial use.It is equipped with a digital fs converter newly developed by Pioneer, and realizes compact integration by high-integration single-chip IC using Pioneer's original conversion method.The digital source with sampling frequencies of 48 kHz and 32 kHz can be converted to 44.1 kHz without changing the digital source, enabling direct digital recording.You can use CD-R discs that conform to the Orange Book, a unified standard for CD-R discs.Since it is compatible with existing CDs, recorded CD-R discs can be played by ordinary CD players.The input system is equipped with digital Route 3 and two analog systems including digital AES/EBU format input for professionals. The output system is equipped with input / output terminals for two digital systems and two analog systems.The A/D converter for analog input is equipped with a 1-bit A/D converter, and the D/A converter is equipped with a New bit stream type 1-bit D/A converter.The digital and analog circuit blocks are separated independently so that the analog circuit is not affected by the high frequency of the digital circuit.Each part is made of carefully selected high-quality parts.In order to realize recording characteristics compatible with CD, an isolated servo mechanism is installed.The linear motor that drives the pickup has a floating structure in which the magnet and coil are separated independently, the magnet is fixed to the chassis, and the pickup mechanism is free in three dimensional direction.In addition, the mechanical base has a viscoelastic floating structure that blocks vibration from the chassis, and at the same time, the vibration transmission to the pickup is reduced by the vibration control mechanical chassis structure with dissimilar metals bonded together.In addition, a high-precision ZMP (0 moment point) drive is adopted. By matching the drive point of the linear motor with the center of gravity point of the pickup, unwanted moment generation is prevented, and the response band is expanded for faithful tracking.In order to obtain the high precision and laser power required for accurate recording of input signals, a newly developed high-power pickup is adopted.The high-rigidity, high-precision, and thin-type structure prevents unwanted resonance of the carriage and guide shaft.The spindle motor uses a brushless motor with high torque and excellent reliability.  5 mm is used for the shaft, and combined with a large magnetic disk clamper that generates high inertia, excellent response and high rotational accuracy are obtained.To further improve accessibility and searchability, a high-thrust linear motor is employed.In addition, by adopting a two stage servocontrol system consisting of linear motors and pick-up actuators to improve tracing response, excellent tracking characteristics are obtained.Equipped with a variable step digital fader that can independently set the fade-in and fade-out times from 1 second to 15 seconds in 1-second steps.Equipped with an auto track number recording function, it automatically detects between songs and records track numbers automatically.Equipped with skip functions such as Elias Kip, which selects unnecessary parts of a song by time, and Track Skip, which selects unnecessary tracks by track number and skips them.It is equipped with a pre-bias playback function so that you can confirm and play back the last part of the recorded part with one touch when you record additional sound.Built-in recording capacity display function and recording level peak margin display function to prevent recording errors.Wireless remote control is included.

sections.overview: The MD deck pursues high sound quality and high function to enjoy MD as audio.It is equipped with Audio-Signal Reactive Control-System (ASRAC SYSTEM), an audio compression technology evolved from ATRAC.The ATRAC, an MD format audio compression method, the input signal is divided into three frequency bands, and then the data is organized and compressed based on the minimum audibility characteristics and masking effect before recording. However, this uniform masking method has limitations in reproducing the subtle nuances of music.The ASRAC SYSTEM uses DSP technology to analyze the frequencies of input signals in real-time and control them so that the optimum masking characteristics for the input signals are always selected in each band. In addition, by allocating more data to the bands that contain a lot of music signals during compression, sound data that has been organized until now can be compressed and recorded without being truncated. This increases the expressive power of music in the sense of hearing and enables more faithful recording of subtle nuances.Discs recorded with the ASRAC SYSTEM are compatible with other MD decks, portable MD, MD-car stereos, and other MD players.Equipped with Pioneer's original digital NR.Digital NR automatically detects the noise level contained in the input signal in real time and cuts only the hissing without degrading the sound quality. This enables recording and playback of relatively noisy input sources, such as reprinted CDs, cassettes, and broadcast signals from analog sources, with less noise.Digital NR can also be used to play discs recorded on other MD decks, so you can enjoy low-noise playback.This function supports 44.1 kHz sampling for digital recording.Pioneer's original Legato link conversion is installed for the first time as an MD deck. It reproduces the frequency component of 20 khz or more, which is cut in the format of digital recording, up to 40 khz, and realizes natural music playback closer to the original sound.Pioneer's original design philosophy, Z-concept, has been introduced in pursuit of improved signal reading accuracy, accurate signal transmission, and accurate signal conversion.The MJ-D7 uses an Accurate Servo Circuit based on the Z-concept to eliminate unnecessary high-frequency noise in the disk drive rotation control section, thereby eliminating the influence of high-frequency noise and realizing a stable circuit.We have also succeeded in shortening signal transmission paths and improving signal conversion accuracy.Equipped with a digital REC volume, it is possible to adjust the recording level of the music signal (+ 12 dB to -48dB) even when the digital source is connected digitally.This enables digital recording of CDs of various levels at the same level, and Pioneer's advanced technology minimizes the loss of sound quality caused by level adjustment.It is equipped with a synchronous REC function. If you want to record only one song, such as a single CD, you can record one song synchronously, or record all songs synchronously until all songs are finished. Both digital input and analog input can be set with one button.Equipped with a recovery REC function, you can record backward from the REC pause state to the part 2 seconds before.By using this function, if you release the REC pause within 2 seconds after the start of the song you want to record in air check, etc., you can record clearly from the beginning of the song.The input terminal is equipped with two optical digital systems, one coaxial digital system and one analog system, and the output terminal is equipped with one optical digital system, one coaxial digital system and one analog system.With a built-in sampling recorder, it is compatible with various sources as a master recorder.3-pole AC inlet extra thick cord is used for the power cord.It is equipped with functions such as time slip, monaural long recording, katakana / alphabet / number name input, move, undo, erase and combine.It is equipped with a name clip function so that names (disc names and song names) that have already been entered can be memorized and copied to other songs as many times as you want. To protect copyright, names contained in a play-only MD cannot be copied.It has a medley playback function.This function fades out the end of a song and plays all songs continuously like a medley of one song while connecting the songs smoothly.Equipped with a timer fade-in function, you can start a performance by gradually increasing the volume from a small sound when playing a timer using a commercially available timer.Wireless remote control is included.

sections.overview: A DAT deck equipped with a broadband (HS : High Sampling) mode capable of 96 khz high sampling.It uses a wide-band mode with a frequency of 96 kHz, twice that of conventional 48 kHz sampling. With this mode, the range is expanded to ultra-high frequencies and the smooth sound characteristic of the wide-band mode is obtained.In the wide-band mode, the signal processing LSI, capstan motor and drum motor operate at twice the speed of the standard mode, enabling recording and playback at frequencies exceeding 40 kHz. In the wide-band mode, the recording time is halved because the tape runs at twice the speed.(The wide-band HS mode has the same function as the WIDE mode of the D-07, and the name has been changed.)In order to get closer to the original signal waveform, a legato link conversion is installed.This system performs digital signal processing based on the signal recorded on the tape and connects the data with a smooth function curve to obtain sound reproduction close to the original before recording on the tape. It also estimates the original signal before recording and reproduces sound of 20 kHz or higher according to the 1/f attenuation characteristic to achieve more natural sound reproduction.The long duration (LP) mode allows twice the recording time of the standard (SP) mode for analog input recording and digital input recording with a sampling frequency of 32 kHz. This enables continuous recording for up to four hours on 120 minute tapes.Uses a high-output AT head.It is an all-track structure head with 20 ? m uniform track processing in the track trace direction. Glass is welded on both sides of the head to ensure abrasion resistance. In addition, a special polishing process is applied to the gap to realize a stable tape touch.The newly developed 1-bit wide-range linear A/D converter and high-speed pulse flow 1-bit D/A converter are used in the conversion section. The 1-bit method has excellent linearity and is free from non-linear distortion and 0 cross distortion in principle. It reduces conversion errors in minute signals and improves linearity.It is equipped with a TOC function that records information such as program time and length of each song at the beginning of the tape.This function enables DAT to manage information such as the total number and time of songs, the song time of each song, the start time of each song, and the remaining time of the recorded part.It is equipped with high-speed AI search and subcode application functions. It reads subcode information recorded on the tape to learn the song number and the starting position of the song, and realizes high-speed AI search up to about 300 times (about 600 times for LP) by using this information.You can also record and erase various time information, a start ID that indicates the beginning of a song, a skip ID that is convenient for skipping a part you do not want to listen to, a pole number information, and an end ID that indicates the end of recording.At the beginning of each song (start ID part), you can store up to 60 characters of data such as the name of the song, the performer, and notes. The data can be recorded either on the remote control or on the console. The recorded information is scrolled on the counter display when each song starts.Equipped with a CD-Q code sync start ID recording function, start ID can be automatically recorded based on the track number and index in the CD-Q code data transmitted to the D-05 through the digital interface when recording digital input from CD.To eliminate adverse effects caused by clock signal fluctuations, we have adopted a clean clock circuit that separates the clock signal from both audio and digital signals.As a result, the oscillation itself of the clock that controls the system is cleared, and S/N and distortion factor are improved by driving independently.The chassis uses a honeycomb chassis with excellent vibration damping characteristics. The midship structure with the drive mechanism in the center improves the weight balance and suppresses vibration and resonance.In addition, in order to effectively suppress the vibration of the cassette half, it is equipped with a cassette stabilizer unique to Pioneer. The cassette half is sandwiched by special rubber at the top and bottom, and is further pressed by resin at two places on the left and right, so that the cassette half is firmly fixed.Equipped with the last memory function, the AUTO ID on/off and input switching status are recorded even when the power is turned off.We use carefully selected parts in order to respond to broadband.

sections.overview: A DAT deck with 96 kHz high sampling and legato link conversion.In order to record and play back high-frequency components exceeding 20 kHz, we have developed a wide-mode for high sampling by increasing the sampling frequency from 48 kHz to 96 kHz, which is twice the conventional frequency. As a result, the recording and playback frequency has reached 44 kHz, which is twice the conventional frequency. To achieve this technology, we have doubled the tape speed, increased the drum rotation speed from 2,000 rpm to 4,000 rpm in wide-mode, and doubled the head amplifier bandwidth from 4.7 MHz to 9.6 MHz.* The ones recorded in the wide mode cannot be played back in the conventional standard SP mode or long-time LP mode, and the playback time in the wide mode is half of that in the SP mode.With Legato Link Conversion for natural over-20kHz music playback even in standard mode.Legato Link Conversion is a technology that brings the frequency components of natural sounds and music closer to the original signal waveform. It performs digital signal processing based on the signal recorded on the tape and connects the data with a smooth function curve, making it possible to reproduce sounds closer to the original before recording on the tape.In addition, by estimating the original signal before recording and reproducing the sound at 20 kHz or higher according to the 1/f attenuation characteristics, more natural sound reproduction is achieved.The A/D converter is equipped with an 18-bit multi-bit converter and a dither circuit to reduce non-linear and 0 cross distortion.The D/A converter is equipped with an originally developed high-speed pulse-flow D/A converter, which operates at an extremely high oversampling of 256 fs for smoother and more natural sound reproduction.The system clock employs a clean clock circuit that supplies audio and digital signals separately. By driving the oscillation itself of the clock that controls the system independently, the SN ratio and distortion factor are improved.The head is equipped with an AT (All Track) head.In order to respond to the high speed head rotation in the wide mode, precision technology has been put into it. It has an AT structure with 20 ? m uniform track processing in the track trace direction. In addition, glass is welded on both sides of the head to improve abrasion resistance, and special polishing processing is applied to the gap to improve tape touch stability.We have reduced the impact of vibration by using panel stabilizers with rubber vibration isolators to reduce vibration around the front panel, cassette stabilizers to securely hold tapes and prevent sound quality degradation due to vibration, honeycomb chassis to support mechanisms and circuits, large insulators, and hood vibration control structures.It is equipped with a character recording function (character pack) that allows you to record your favorite information such as song title and title. At the beginning of each song (start ID part), you can record up to 60 characters of your favorite information such as song title, performer's name and source title. Data can be recorded either on the remote control or on the main body.The recorded information is scrolled on the display at the start of each song and can be displayed again by pressing the button while the song is playing.It is equipped with a CD-Q code sync start ID recording function. When recording digital input from a CD, the start ID is automatically recorded based on the track number and index in the CD-Q code data transmitted to the D-07 through the digital interface. In addition to the conventional detection of the replacement of each song with two second silence, the start ID can be recorded without any silence between songs.This eliminates the recording error of the start ID due to the fade-in and fade-out portions.It is equipped with a Table of Contents (TOC) function that records information such as the total number of songs and the total time of the tape, the playing time of each song, the starting time of each song, and the remaining amount of recording space at the beginning of the tape.Equipped with digital faders, fade in and fade out functions for digital input recording, playback, analog input recording, and playback.In addition, the operation functions at the time of playback include random play, in which a microcomputer randomly selects and plays music based on TOC information, time skip, in which a desired time is skipped forward or backward from the current position, one point memory, in which the microcomputer memorizes the point on the tape when a button is pressed and plays that point with one touch, and fine cue / review, which is convenient for recording the start ID and tracking.In addition to the standard SP mode, it is equipped with three modes : a wide mode capable of recording and playback in a wide band up to 44 kHz, and a long-time LP mode with a maximum of 4 hours (when using 120 minutes of tape), which is advantageous for air check of satellite broadcasting and FM broadcasting.We use carefully selected parts to respond to the demand for broadband.

sections.overview: Based on the D-07, this DAT deck is equipped with Legato link conversion S and further improved sound quality.For recording and playback in the ultra-high-frequency range exceeding 20 kHz, it is equipped with a high-sampling (HS) mode in which the sampling frequency is increased from 48 kHz to 96 kHz, twice that of the conventional one, enabling recording and playback in a wide band up to 44 kHz.The maximum recording time in High Sampling mode is 1/2 of the conventional Standard (SP) mode.It is equipped with Legato link conversion S.In the conventional Legato link conversion, the waveform of the original signal was estimated and reproduced based on the 1/f attenuation characteristic for the component of 20 kHz or higher. However, in the Legato link conversion S, an independent harmonic generation circuit is added for overtones. The overtone component of 20 kHz or higher is generated from the attenuation characteristic based on the estimation of the original sound, and the reproduction band is expanded by adding it together with the time axis.When playing back digital sources such as CDs, it is equipped with a DAC mode that allows you to use only the D/A converter function with the newly developed Legato link conversion S. This mode converts the input digital source into an analog signal with a 20 kHz or higher component and outputs it.An 18-bit multi-bit converter is used on the A/D side, and a dither circuit is incorporated to suppress non-linear distortion and 0 cross distortion.In addition, the D/A side employs a multi-bit DAC that eliminates the generation of 0 cross distortion by a unique method. In this method, two 20-bit DACs with exactly the same characteristics are integrated into one chip, and + and - region waveforms are independently D/A converted. At that time, the conventional 1 LSB level difference is expressed by the presence or absence of 1 LSB compensation current, not by inversion of all bits including MSB. In principle, the generation of 0 cross distortion is eliminated, and reproducibility and linearity of small signals are improved.The head is equipped with a high-output AT head with precision technology for high-speed head rotation in high sampling mode.It is an all track structure with 20 ? m uniform track processing in the track trace direction. Glass is welded on both sides of the head to ensure high abrasion resistance. In addition, a special polishing process is applied to the gap to realize a stable tape touch.We take thorough anti-vibration and anti-vibration measures, including a panel stabilizer with anti-vibration rubber that suppresses microvibration around the front panel, a cassette stabilizer that securely holds tapes and prevents sound quality deterioration caused by vibration, a honeycomb chassis that supports mechanisms and circuits, and a large insulator and bonnet anti-vibration structure.Copper plating is applied to the chassis, mechanical base, and rear panel to reduce high-frequency impedance and noise.At the beginning of each song (start ID part) is equipped with a character recording function (character pack) that can record up to 60 characters of favorite information such as the name of the song, the name of the performer, and the title of the source.The recorded information is scrolled on the display at the start of each song and can be displayed again by pressing the button during the performance.It is equipped with a CD-Q code sync start ID recording function. sections.overview: The reference DAT deck reduces mutual interference by adopting a midship mounting mechanism in which each part is independent.The audio circuit board and digital circuit board are separated to the left and right, and the mechanism part is placed in the center to clarify the separation of each unit. The power transformer also uses a twin transformer that supplies energy to the audio and digital circuits independently.This ensures the independence of each unit from power supply to layout, and reduces the mutual interference between circuits.Both the A/D side and D/A side use 1-bit converters, so there is no problem of conversion error due to resistor error, and there is no non-linear distortion or 0 cross distortion in principle.The D/A converter A converter is equipped with twin original high-speed pulse-flow D/A converters that operate with high oversampling of 256 fs and provide finer and smoother output.In order to eliminate the fluctuation of the system clock, which is important for the 1-bit system, the signal processing section and the audio section each have their own clocks. In addition, we have newly developed a Clean Clock II circuit that combines a clock jitter suppressor circuit that captures the data transmitted from the signal processing section to the audio section and the transmission clock with the audio section's own clock, and a lithium tantalate oscillator to improve the sound quality.The head is equipped with a high-output AT head.Based on Pioneer's precision technology, this head adopts an All Track structure with 20 ? m uniform track processing in the track trace direction. In addition, to improve abrasion resistance, glass is welded to both sides of the head and special polishing processing is applied to the gap to realize stable tape touch.Also, by increasing the reproduction output level by 2 to 6 dB, signal reading with low error rate is made possible.Vibration is reduced by adopting a high-rigidity flat chassis for the mechanism part and by using a resin material with a high vibration isolation effect for the vibration source.In addition, vibration is absorbed by adopting a cassette stabilizer structure in which the cassette half is held from the top and bottom by special rubber and the cassette is held from the left and right by resin to fix the cassette.Information such as the program time of the source and the playing time of each song is recorded in the first position of the source, and it is equipped with a TOC (Table of contents) function in which the source can be enjoyed like a CD.With this function, you can manage the source such as total number of songs and total time of the source, playing time of each song, starting time of each song, remaining time of the recorded part, etc.Since the TOC information is recorded simply by recording the end ID and renumbering the TOC, various operations can be performed by using this TOC function.It is equipped with an AI search function that utilizes the TOC information recorded at the beginning of the tape. It can search at a speed of approximately 300 times (approximately 600 times for LP) at the fastest speed. In addition, even if the tape does not have TOC information recorded on it, the program number is read by running the tape and the position is memorized by the microcomputer, making it possible to perform high-speed searches similar to those based on TOC information.Equipped with digital faders, fade in and fade out function both during digital input recording, analog input recording and playback.In addition, as operation functions during playback, it is equipped with functions such as random play, which selects and plays music at random based on TOC information, time skip, one point memory, fine queue / review, etc.Equipped with LP mode capable of continuous recording / playback for up to 4 hours (when using 120 minutes of tape).It is equipped with a digital meter that displays the recording level as it is after A/D conversion, and accurate level management is possible.A 2mm-thick chassis with high rigidity is used for the bottom panel. In addition, vibration is absorbed by a large insulator, and panel stabilizers with rubber vibration isolators are used to suppress small vibrations around the front panel.High quality is achieved by carefully selecting high-quality sound parts.

sections.overview: In addition to the 4fs18bitA / D converter and 8fs20bitD / A converter, a dither circuit is installed on the DAT deck for high sound quality.A 4fs18bitA/D converter for the recording side and an 8fs20bitD/A converter for the playback side were installed for the first time in the DAT for high-precision signal processing.In addition, both the A/D and D/A converters are L/R-independent configuration, eliminating phase shift between channels and preventing distortion and noise.It is equipped with an A/D side dither circuit developed by a unique method applying the dither technology used in professional digital sound recorders.This circuit adds a dither signal outside the audible band to the analog input signal, performs A/D conversion, and then removes the dither signal with a digital filter to enable conversion with excellent linearity. It reproduces a more faithful signal by dispersing and averaging conversion errors caused by 0 cross distortion at a minute level.For high-quality source recording, a line-straight switch is installed.By turning the switch ON, the signal can be input to the A/D converter without passing through the input volume and the 5th low-pass filter. This minimizes the signal path and reduces phase distortion.The audio circuit board uses twin monoconstruction for improved separation. The recording / reproducing and L/R circuit blocks are divided into four sections. The placement of parts and the length and routing of wires are symmetrical to eliminate interference between each circuit block.In addition, the spacing between the input / output pin jacks is taken into consideration in the terminal layout to improve channel separation.In order to achieve high sound quality, the printed circuit board for audio uses double-sided boards made of single-sided solid earth foils to provide shielding effect and greatly reduce noise. In addition, the ground line on the board uses bus bars made of 1 mm thick extra-thick oxygen-free copper plates to reduce the impedance of the ground and improve the rigidity and sound quality.In addition, it is designed with high sound quality to every detail, and selected capacitors and resistors are used.The head is equipped with a high-power AT head developed by integrating Pioneer's original advanced precision processing technology. This head features an AT (All Track) structure with 20 ? m uniform track processing in the track trace direction.In addition, glass is welded on both sides in order to improve abrasion resistance, and special polishing is applied to the gap which is the entrance of the signal to realize more stable tape touch.Furthermore, by increasing the playback output level by 2 dB to 6 dB, it is possible to read signals with high precision and low error rate.The mechanism uses a highly rigid flat chassis made of 1.6 mm thick material.In order to prevent the generation of strain due to bending process, this steel plate has been specially processed into a flat structure to reduce unnecessary vibration generated by the mechanism.The mechanism and power transformer, which are sources of vibration, are fixed to an isolated chassis independent from the main chassis.In addition, the isolated chassis is grounded with a dedicated zinc die-cast insulator and mechanically separated from the audio unit mounted on the main chassis to eliminate the adverse effects of unwanted vibrations.In order to suppress vibration of the cassette half, Pioneer's original cassette stabilizer is mounted.By sandwiching the cassette half with special rubber at the top and bottom and pressing it with resin at two places on the left and right, the cassette half is firmly fixed and the double anti-vibration structure realizes the stable running of the tape.Large honeycomb insulators and copper-plated honeycomb chassis are used to prevent harmful external vibrations from being transmitted to the mechanism and each circuit.The power transformer uses a large power transformer consisting of a bifilar OFC winding with separate windings for audio and digital circuits.
