sections.overview: Pioneer's first DAT deck.In order to ensure that the input and output waveforms are identical, an oversampling re-independent double digital filter configuration, which was not used even in professional PCM recorders, is employed.By operating the D/A converter at twice the normal sampling frequency on the playback side, the digital filter reduces the load on the analog low-pass filter in the latter stage and improves the frequency characteristics, distortion factor, and group delay characteristics. In the conventional digital filter, only an analog low-pass filter with steep attenuation characteristics was used for A/D conversion during recording, so the distortion and phase delay of the analog filter caused considerable distortion and distortion in the music signal. The D-1000 is equipped with a digital filter on the recording side to achieve low-distortion sound quality with excellent phase characteristics up to the high frequency range.The D/A converter is equipped with an oversampling glitch less D/A converter.In conventional resistive ladder-type D/A converters, it takes time to stabilize the analog output after the digital data is input to the D/A converter due to variations in the response of each switching. As a result, a glitch, a type of noise, occurs in the output.The D-1000 solves this problem by speeding up the operation of the D/A converter and improving the sound quality by realizing a simple signal path that does not go through the digricher by making it glitch less.In addition, the use of independent D/A converters on the left and right sides eliminates the phase difference between the channels.The audio circuit board uses twin monoconstruction.In this configuration, the recording / playback and L/R circuits are divided into four sections, and the arrangement of parts and the length of wires are symmetrical to eliminate interference between each block.In addition, noise is greatly reduced by grounding one side of the audio printed circuit board. In addition, bus bars made of 1 mm thick oxygen-free copper plates are used for power supply lines and ground lines on the circuit board to reduce ground impedance and increase the rigidity of the circuit board.All condensers and resistors are made of high-quality sound components.Metalized polyester film capacitors with non-inductive OFC lead wires are used as coupling capacitors for analog signal paths, and OFC lead wires and gold-plated brass cap mold carbon film resistors are used as signal resistors.In addition, oxygen-free copper wires are used for signal wiring.The slide volume is the same as that used in professional mixing consoles, enabling fine adjustment of recording levels and greatly improving the separation characteristics at high frequencies.A newly developed cassette stabilizer is installed to suppress tape vibration and ensure stable operation.In the cassette stabilizer, vibration is suppressed by sandwiching the cassette half with special resin material from above and below.In order to reduce vibration from the outside, a large solid brass insulator with excellent vibration damping characteristics is adopted.In addition, the insulator is firmly secured to the double chassis with oxygen-free copper washers and copper-screws to eliminate vibration.It uses a copper-plated chassis to greatly reduce magnetic distortion, which adversely affects sound quality, and shields the digital circuit to prevent unwanted interference from the digital circuit, creating a clear separation between the digital and analog circuits.The power supply is composed of 7 independent 2-transformer power supplies that separate the digital and analog systems, eliminating interference from the digital system to the analog system.The analog transformer has a 2-winding power supply configuration that is strong enough to handle large load fluctuations, and oxygen-free copper wires are used for the windings and lead wires. The digital transformer also has a 5-winding power supply configuration that uses oxygen-free copper wires for stable power supply.The circuit board that makes up the entire power supply circuit is made of copper foil with a thickness of 70 ? m, twice as thick as the normal one, to reduce impedance.Pioneer's original linear skating mechanism is adopted for the deck mechanism part, and combined with high rigidity shaft and linear bearing, excellent quietness and reliability are obtained.In the linear skating mechanism, the deck mechanism is incorporated into the cassette and can be operated while monitoring the tape running condition. In addition, operability is improved by the auto lead-in function, which automatically mounts and skates just by inserting the cassette, and the auto lead-out function, which allows the cassette to be ejected with one touch.The motor section employs a 4 dd mechanism using two drum motors, capstan motors and reel motors. High reliability is achieved by a high-precision digital servo system and a highly stable tension speed control system.Equipped with a peak margin indicator, it is possible to make appropriate adjustments for digital recording that will cause sudden distortion when the level meter exceeds 0 dB (maximum quantization level).Equipped with a digital drive peak meter that displays digital signals directly as bars.By directly driving the meter with a digital signal, it enables accurate level monitoring during recording. The meter is Oatley set with a peak held for approximately 3 seconds.Both digital and analog inputs can monitor extremely accurate recording levels, and the maximum digital signal level can be read even when the signal is emphasized, so there are no recording errors.It is equipped with the easy operation function using subcode which is unique to DAT deck.Equipped with an auto ID recording function, you can automatically record the start ID and program number that indicate the beginning of the track during recording. You can also cancel this function.In addition, the manual ID recording function allows you to set or erase a start ID or skip ID anywhere you want.Equipped with a Oatley number function, you can record by adding to a tape that has been recorded up to a certain part, or automatically organize the number of songs after adding or deleting the start ID manually.Equipped with a program number setting function, you can freely set the program number at the start of recording.It is equipped with one shot direct music selection function, and you can play the desired music just by specifying the program number and pressing play button.Equipped with skip playback function, you can skip unnecessary parts and play (with cancel function)Equipped with a guiding operation function, the that unrecorded parts can be recognized during playback, fast-forward or rewind.Equipped with an emphasis ON/OFF function.Music signals generally have fewer high-frequency components than sections.title: PIONEER-EXCLUSIVE Pioneer
sections.overview: An FM/AM tuner equipped with a D. D. (Digital Direct) decoder developed with Pioneer's tuner technology.Pioneer has developed and adopted its own D. D. decoder to digitally detect and demodulate signals and to completely eliminate distortion and noise generation.This circuit is a simple method in which a signal converted into a 1.26 MHz pulse by a pulse converter is sent directly to a multiplier for L/R separation, and the signal is multiplied by a 38 kHz subcarrier made from a 19 kHz pilot signal. Since the FM signal remains a digital signal after the pulse converter until the output, deterioration of the S / N ratio and distortion are suppressed.There is also no need for filters that can cause signal loss or distortion.The resulting subcarrier is a clean sine wave that does not adversely affect the audio signal, so it can produce a clean, high-purity signal.This D. D. decoder takes note of the principle of a tuner that multiplies an FM signal (analog signal) and a subcarrier (square wave) for demodulation. It was born from the bold idea that if you multiply an FM signal into a pulse wave and a subcarrier into a sine wave, the result will be the same. This method realizes excellent characteristics such as SN ratio, distortion rate, separation, and various interference rejection capabilities.The parts are carefully selected to improve the sound quality.First of all, the D. D. decoder is completely LC-filterless from pulse conversion to output to eliminate distortion caused by the LC filter itself.In the low-pass filter section of the final stage, an active filter with sharp characteristics is used in place of the conventional passive filter using coils to prevent deterioration of sound quality caused by coils, etc.We have also developed and adopted a low-distortion semiconductor capacitor for the high-frequency section, as well as a copper foil styrene capacitor and a fast recovery diode with good rectification characteristics.In addition, oxygen-free copper wire is used for wiring.A linear front end is used for the front end to improve RF intermodulation characteristics.It uses a twin varicap tuning element and a unique balance hold capacitor system to achieve high reception performance.We are also working to improve the RF intermodulation characteristics by using IDMOS FET with improved characteristics as an RF amplifier.In addition, a newly developed FET balanced mixer has been incorporated to achieve high stability and to improve the ability to eliminate interference such as image interference.Taking note of the fact that the difference between the frequency on the antenna side and the oscillation frequency on the local side causes distortion and degrades sound quality, we have installed a newly developed tracking oscillator circuit in order to maintain a linear relationship between both frequencies and suppress distortion.MOS FET is used in parallel for the first stage amplifier of the IF to obtain high gain and high SN ratio.In addition, a crystal oscillator circuit is adopted for the oscillation circuit of the frequency conversion section (converted to 1.26 MHz by the second local oscillator) when sending signals to the D. D. decoder after the detection stage. This circuit improves stability and SN while eliminating drift due to environmental changes such as temperature and humidity.In addition, two stage switching of the IF band is adopted to always obtain the highest quality.In the conventional quartz synthesizer type PLL circuit, the reference frequency was set at 12.5 kHz, and the sound quality was deteriorated as residual noise in the audible band. However, by setting the reference frequency to 25 kHz using the original pulse swallow method and moving it out of the audible band, the cause of residual noise is eliminated.Static control method is adopted for digital control signal transmission method.In general, in order to simplify the transmission of complex signals, a dynamic control method was adopted in which multiple pieces of information are transmitted on a single signal line. sections.overview: An FM/AM digital synthesizer tuner with improved interference rejection capabilities such as improved RF intermodulation characteristics.A linear push-pull front end composed of a twin varicap and newly developed ID MOS FET is adopted for the front end part.The tuning element varicap has been said to have a narrow dynamic range because the element itself tends to become saturated due to the tuning of the diode element compared with the varicon tuning. However, by adopting a twin varicap in the tuning part, the dynamic range is greatly improved and input characteristics equal to those of the varicon are realized.In addition, a newly developed ID MOS FET with 8 dB higher element characteristics is adopted for the RF amplifier, which is a push-pull configuration.As a result, the dynamic range is improved.A quartz synthesizer system is used to capture FM broadcasting stations by applying the accuracy of quartz.The local oscillation frequency is locked by comparing the phase of the divided local oscillation frequency with the reference frequency made by the crystal oscillator.In addition, by adopting the pulse swallow method, the reference frequency, which was 12.5 kHz in the past, is increased to 25 kHz, and by moving it out of the reproduction band, there is no anxiety that the reference frequency remains in the signal line and becomes noise.The detection circuit uses a pulse counting method that pulses FM signals and processes them digitally and accurately.As a result, excellent linearity can be obtained over a wide range, so low distortion factor and high SN ratio can be achieved. In addition, the distortion factor characteristic does not deteriorate in low and high frequencies due to linear detection.In addition, a linear multiplier is used for the second mixer circuit and a push-pull oscillator is used for the second local circuit to suppress the generation of beats.Pioneer's original direct-through MPX circuit is used in the MPX section that separates the L and R stereo signals.The structure is such that the signal itself does not pass through the active element, the necessary signal is output as it is, and the unnecessary signal is grounded. By this structure, the noise component and nonlinearity of the transistor itself, and the restriction of the input level are not affected, so the stereo signal with low distortion factor and high SN ratio can be obtained.Equipped with 6 preset functions for each FM and AM.It is equipped with AM/FM wide / narrow switching circuits that can be used for sound quality and selectivity according to radio wave conditions.It has a built-in last one memory function that allows you to receive the same broadcasting station when you turn the switch on again after turning it off.The back-up power supply circuit instantly receives the stored broadcasting stations.Equipped with Rec level check function.

Unlike the meter method which has a high saturation point, it enables more accurate tuning by correctly indicating the signal strength.There are two types of output terminals, fixed and variable.FM and AM are independently provided for the variable output level control.Equipped with an FM muting circuit that suppresses unpleasant noise during tuning and detuning.It is equipped with a multi-path terminal. sections.overview: FM/AM tuner with PLL circuit in MPX section.The FM front-end uses a dual-gate MOS FET for the two stage RF amplifier and mixer stage.Since the dual-gate MOS FET with a low noise figure is used, the practical sensitivity is improved, and the interference rejection capability is improved by the tuning circuit using 5 series variable capacitor.The local oscillator circuit of the TX 910 is equipped with a buffer circuit. Even when stations with high electric field strength are adjacent to each other, the buffer circuit works to prevent the lead-in phenomenon.The IF section uses a monolithic IC instead of conventional transistors. The circuit consists of three single-stage differential ICs and one 3-stage differential IC, providing high stability and limiters.In addition, various characteristics have been improved by combining with wide-band ratio detection.The filter element is composed of a ceramic filter (4 pieces of 2 elements) with less phase distortion and sharp selectivity characteristics.This reduces distortion in a wide range within the pass band and improves MPX separation.A PLL circuit is introduced into the MPX section.The MPX demodulation signal obtained by the PLL circuit is a square wave whose phase always matches that of the pilot signal. Therefore, when it is passed through a double-balanced differential demodulation circuit, the leakage of the demodulation signal is canceled out and hardly appears on the output side, and the leak carrier is small even as it is, and the distortion generated during demodulation is minimized.Also, since there is no SCA beat interference, the SCA filter can be omitted, which greatly improves the high-frequency separation.A part of 19 kHz derived from the PLL is used to guide the signal to another phase comparator, which detects the magnitude of the pilot signal and guides the 38 kHz demodulated signal to the demodulation circuit only when the broadcast being received is stereo. When the signal is mono or when the stereo broadcast transmission is too weak for practical use, the circuit is automatically switched to mono and the indicator flashes simultaneously.The ICPA 1310 has a built-in PLL circuit, a double-balanced differential demodulation circuit, an indicator circuit, and auxiliary circuits such as automatic switching.It is equipped with a low-pass filter that cuts the 19 kHz pilot signal and the 38 kHz carrier leak during MPX demodulation. This filter eliminates adverse effects such as beat interference and intermodulation during FM recording.The muting circuit can be switched between two operation levels.The first stage is used to cut out inter-station noise during channel selection, and the second stage is used to receive only strong stations.In order to perform accurate muting operation, MOS IC and IC developed exclusively for muting are adopted. In addition, pop noise is suppressed by double action combining lead relay.It is equipped with a pulse noise suppressor that cuts out the pulse noise caused by Radio noises from automobiles and motorcycles.It detects both AM noise, which occurs when the limiter is receiving a weak station, and FM noise, which cannot be removed by the limiter circuit, and operates in either case, so it works effectively over a wide range of electric field strength and noise types.Equipped with a signal meter whose linearity is improved by the AGC circuit, it is not saturated even in a strong electric field region.In the AM tuner section, a frequency number line type varicon is also used for the AM section to make channel selection easier. In addition, a one stage synchronous RF-amplifier using a 3-row varicon is used to increase interference rejection capability.In addition, stability and reliability are improved by adopting a high-integration IC. Each amplifier stage is equipped with a sufficient AGC to keep the detection output constant and suppress the occurrence of distortion due to saturation at strong input.The mixer stage employs a balanced type mixer to improve spurious characteristics.There are two types of output terminals, fixed and variable.The output level of the variable terminal can be adjusted independently by FM and AM.We use a Darlington OTL amplifier as an amplifier for headphones.Volume can be controlled on the front panel.It is equipped with a multi-pass terminal, and the best point in the antenna direction can be easily determined by connecting a stereo display SD-100 or an oscilloscope.

sections.overview: This FM stereo tuner is equipped with a photo-logic system and quartz lock synthesizer to improve the tuning accuracy.It uses a quartz synthesizer system that reliably receives frequencies every 100 kHz by applying the accuracy of quartz.There is no drift due to temperature change or humidity change because the local oscillation frequency is locked by comparing the phase of the divided local oscillation frequency with the reference frequency made divided local oscillation frequency.It uses a photo-logic method. sections.overview: An FM stereo tuner that employs a beatless pulse count method.The detection circuit employs a pulse count method that pulses the FM signal and processes it digitally. This method is linear detection and does not degrade the distortion factor characteristics especially at low and high frequencies.In addition, to take full advantage of the advantages of this pulse counting method and obtain a higher SN ratio, we have adopted a double conversion method in which the IF frequency of 10.7 MHz is reduced to the second IF frequency of 1.26 MHz and then detected. In order to solve the problem with this double conversion method double conversion method, we have adopted a linear multiplier for the second mixer stage and a push-pull oscillator for the second local stage.In addition, a DC servo circuit is used from the detection output to the MPX output for a direct connection system without a coupling capacitor to reduce the effect of the capacitor on sound quality.The front-end section is a push-pull configuration composed of 7 series varicon and DD MOS FET (double diffused FET).As a result, a large dynamic range can be obtained, which leads to a decrease in practical sensitivity. Moreover, various interference rejection capabilities such as RF intermodulation characteristics are greatly improved.In addition, a balanced mixer using a DD MOS FET improves the RF intermodulation characteristics.The IF section adopts two stage switching between Wide and Narrow.The Wide IF circuit consists of a low-distortion SAW filter and a ceramic filter with flat group delay characteristics and low distortion factor. The Narrow IF circuit has three additional narrow-band ceramic filters and two additional limiter ICs to improve selectivity.The MPX section uses a direct-through MPX, so that the signal itself does not pass through the active element, the necessary signal is output as it is, and the unnecessary signal is grounded.As a result, the distortion factor and S / N ratio are improved because there are no effects such as transistor noise components, nonlinearity and input level limitation.In consideration of sound quality, a coreless low-pass filter that does not use magnetic materials is adopted.As a result, the third order distortion caused by the magnetic material is reduced to approximately 1/10 to 1/30 compared to the conventional one.It is equipped with a touch sensor servo lock. When you turn the tuning knob and release the knob when the pointer reaches the desired broadcasting station, the frequency is locked at this tuning point.The dial indicator consists of three LEDs running : a green LED lights up near the broadcasting station, the center LED lights up red at the proper tuning point, and the LED turns green when the tuning knob is released to indicate that the frequency is locked.Equipped with a meter that switches the deviation / Multipash with a switch.Equipped with Rec level check and auto blend function.

sections.overview: A high-end FM stereo tuner designed for truly high-fidelity FM reception.A 7-row varicon dedicated to FM is adopted for the front end part.This seven link varicon is combined with three dual-gate MOS FETs and has a three stage configuration of single -, double - and triple-tune for high selectivity. At the same time, double - and triple-tune are used in unique ways, such as L-coupling for double-tune and C-coupling for triple-tune, with a gain deviation of less than 0.5 dB over the entire receiving band.In addition, the sensitivity is increased by using a FET that is specially SN selected.It adopts a Phase Locked tuning method using APC (Automatic Phase Control) which adopts a unique sampling and holding method.The APC samples the oscillation frequency from the local oscillator with pulses every 100 kHz obtained from a single crystal oscillator, and feeds back the voltage change obtained by detecting the phase shift to the local oscillator. The local oscillator always oscillates at an accurate frequency in increments of 100 kHz. Thus, the oscillation frequency from the local oscillator does not change linearly with the rotation of the dial, but changes every 100 kHz just like when many crystal oscillators are switched sequentially.With this method, there is no oscillation in fractions of 100 kHz or less, so that there is no slight mistuning. When the dial stops rotating, the local signal is locked at that frequency, so that there is no drift.Equipped with signal strength meter and lock meter.When a broadcast is received, the hands of the lock meter point to the center to indicate the tuning point, and when the best center tuning point is obtained, the lock indicator lights red to indicate correct reception.Two types of circuits with different selectivity characteristics are built into the IF stage. In addition, two types of detectors, narrow band and wide band, are prepared. The selectivity characteristics and this detector can be switched simultaneously according to the radio wave condition, and the circuit can be used properly.This switch is integrated with the muting switch in consideration of practical usability.As a wide-band detector, we have developed and installed a delay-type ultrawide-band linear detector.This detector has a bandwidth as wide as 6 MHz and has excellent characteristics because of its high detection efficiency.Before the output of the detector is input to the MPX stage, in order to prevent beat interference from adjacent stations at a distance of 200 kHz, an anti-birdie filter that cuts unnecessary high-frequency components is adopted, so that no unnecessary waves are mixed into the MPX stage.The MPX section uses PLL (Phase Locked Loop) system.The PLL is a loop circuit that corrects the deviation of the demodulation signal while comparing the MPX demodulation signal produced inside the tuner so that it always stays in phase with the pilot signal sent from the broadcasting station. Stability is improved compared with the conventional system.The TX tx 9900, the IC used is carefully selected in terms of SN and distortion to further enhance the completeness of the PLL circuit. In addition, a low-pass filter with sharp high-cut characteristics provides a high carrier-leak suppression ratio and a flat frequency response in the playback band.A 2-stage switching muting circuit using a relay is adopted.Level 1 suppresses noise at the time of detuning and suppresses noise between stations. Level 2 also suppresses broadcast waves with a weak signal level and allows only high-level signals to be received.In consideration of practical usability, it is combined with the selector switch for the selectivity characteristic. For narrow points, you can choose muting off or 1, and for wide points, you can choose muting 1 or 2.It is equipped with an MPX noise filter to cancel high-frequency noise that tends to occur when receiving stereo signals in weak electric fields.Two output terminals, variable and fixed, are and fixed.Equipped with output terminals for multi-path observation.Equipped with 4-channel MPX terminal.

sections.overview: This is a 10 cm cone type full-range unit that pursues sound quality with a well-balanced playback band and good positioning characteristic of full range.The diaphragm uses a wet press cone with sufficient consideration of shape and material.In addition, urethane foam edge with excellent linearity is used for the edge.The balance of the vibration system is maintained by pulling out the lead wire symmetrically.Uses highly rigid titanium for the center cap.Aluminum die-cast frame is used for the frame.By adopting a pure copper cap for the pole piece, current distortion generated in the magnetic circuit is reduced.By adopting a perforated pole, the pressure in the magnetic circuit when the cone paper vibrates is reduced, and linearity in the low range is improved.Magnet with 90 mm diameter is used for the magnetic circuit.

sections.overview: This is a 20 cm cone type full range unit that uses carefully selected materials and thoroughly pursues the effect on playback sound.The cone uses a shallow curved cone to achieve excellent directional characteristics and sound mid-range reproduction. In addition, an acoustic damping agent is applied to suppress split vibration in the middle and high range.Waveform Cross Edge is used for the edge.A ferrite magnet with a diameter of 140 mm is used for the magnetic circuit, and a pure copper cap is used for the pole piece to reduce distortion.The voice coil uses aluminum ribbon wire with has undergone alumite insulation treatment.Compared with conventional voice coil wires, this voice coil has less space between the voice coils and has higher conductor occupancy rate in the magnetic circuit, resulting in higher efficiency.The center cap is made of duralumin. In addition, a special braking process is applied to the inside to suppress split vibration in the high-frequency range.Aluminum die-cast frame is used for the frame.Mounting bracket is attached.

sections.title: PIONEER-EXCLUSIVE Pioneer
sections.overview: 38 cm 3-way compound speaker unit.The PAT-38X is a 3-way speaker consisting of three units with completely independent voice coil and magnetic circuit.The structure consists of a hollow center pole in the Woofer's magnetic circuit and Woofer's cone paper in the Scoker's horn, and the Scoker's magnetic circuit is attached to the rear end of the speaker.The tweeter is mounted by a bridge at a position slightly offset from the central axis of the woofer.For the cone paper of the woofer part, Cross Edge cone (a piece of cone paper with a separately made cloth edge attached to the edge part) is used, and special damping agent is applied to the edge part, which lowers the lowest resonance frequency and reduces distortion in the low range.Aluminum wire is used for the voice coil, and special hardened conductive paint is applied to prevent disconnection.A horn type is used for the mid-range and high-range.A polyester resin film is used for the diaphragm.The pole and yoke are designed so that the unbalance of the magnetic flux distribution is minimized after the magnetic flux distribution is precisely measured, and the driving force applied to the voice coil is always constant to reduce distortion.By adopting a damper with a circular corrugation, the stability of center holding is improved, and the generation of distortion due to the nonlinearity of the damper is reduced.The frame and yoke cap are coated with baking paint, and the top of the yoke cap is made of transparent plastic material so that you can see the midrange diaphragm and the front and back of the speaker center axis.It comes with a specially designed 3-way network.In this network, L, C and attenuators are combined in a single metal case that is baked and painted gray, and the attenuation of each band is 12dB/oct.For the connection with the dedicated network, W is for woofer, S is for squaker, and T is for tweeter.The standard position of the attenuator is the fourth position from the MIN position for the squaker and the third position from the MIN position for the tweeter.

This is a 25 cm woofer is also used in Exclusive model2251.The diaphragm is made of natural pulp that has been aged, laminated with a special film on the surface, and coated with a unique damping paint. This diaphragm, combined with a 30   half-top angle ribbed shape, realizes natural sound reproduction.The magnetic circuit is an internal magnetic type using an alnico magnet which can reduce the second harmonic distortion in principle.By designing with allowance in the magnet operating point, the sensitivity decrease due to demagnetization at high power is kept low.In order to stabilize the transmission of driving force, the yoke and plate of the magnetic circuit are integrally molded by a special casting method. In addition, the center pole is also screwed to the yoke, increasing the rigidity of the magnetic circuit by approximately four times.

sections.title: PIONEER-EXCLUSIVE TL-1601A
sections.overview:
70,000 (around 1991)  80,000 (around 1993)  90,000 (around 1999)  126,000 (around 2005)

A typical 40 cm cone type woofer unit of TAD (Technical Audio Devices).It is also used in model2401twin and model2402 which Pioneer announced as exclusive brand.The diaphragm is made of wood pulp, which has a natural sound. By applying a special aging treatment, it is tough and hardly deteriorated. It has a characteristic that the waist of the diaphragm does not come off by a large input.In order to obtain the durability that is indispensable for professional use, it is consistent with the concept of DRS (Dynamic Response Suspension). In addition to setting sufficient crosstalk in the vibration support system, high stability against lateral vibration is ensured.In addition, the vibration support system, which greatly influences the response and resolution of reproduced sound, has been thoroughly studied, and the initial motion sensitivity and input-to-amplitude linearity have been greatly improved.The Alnico magnet is used for the magnetic circuit, and the distortion generated over the whole band is suppressed to a low level.By adopting an edge-wise voice coil and using the aluminum die-cast frame and magnetic circuit itself as a radiator, stable performance is shown even in long-term use.

sections.title: PIONEER-EXCLUSIVE TL-1601B
sections.overview:
85,000 (around 1991)  105,000 (around 1999)  147,000 (around 2005)

Based on TL 1601 a, this 40 cm cone shaped woofer was developed to respond to professional use in the digital source age while keeping the basic performance as it is.In addition to inheriting the features of TL-1601a, such as tough and lightweight cone, corrugation type cloth edge coated with special damping agent, and aluminum die-cast frame, a higher level of input resistant design has been introduced.This design further pursued the design concept of maintaining high performance up to high input power. The maximum input power is increased to 500W by such methods as providing ventilation holes in the voice coil bobbin, forced air cooling through the opening holes in the frame and the center hole of the magnetic circuit.The magnetic flux density of 12,400 gauss has been obtained by further upgrading the magnet material. The output sound pressure level of 97.5 db has been achieved by adding this high magnetic flux density magnetic circuit to the vibration indication system and long voice coil with good linearity.The signal input path has also been improved. By installing a large vise type connector, it is possible to use a very thick speaker cable. In addition, a low-impedance OFC (oxygen-free copper) Kinshi wire is used to transmit input signals straight to the voice coil.Compatibility is improved by making the external dimensions exactly the same as TL-1601a.

In addition, the pole piece has a special shape to obtain the symmetry of the magnetic flux and is fixed securely with bolts.By adopting an Alnico magnet for the magnetic circuit and making it an inner magnetic type, the second harmonic distortion is suppressed and sufficient magnetism prevention performance is ensured.The vibration system is composed of pulp corn with special aging treatment, cloth edge with high age stability, and damper with high linearity, and exhibits excellent response even in the case of Oire force.In addition, the 23 mm long voice coil realizes low-distortion bass even at the time of Chikara Dainyu.Consideration is given to suppress parasitic resonance such as 9-piece division of alnico magnet and drilling of holes in voice coil bobbin.

sections.overview: A ribbon tweeter that inherits the know-how accumulated in the PT-R7A and can be added to an existing speaker system as a super tweeter.A built-in network with a crossover frequency of 10 kHz and attenuation characteristics of 12dB/oct.Therefore, by simply connecting the PT-R5 as it is, it is possible to improve the energy characteristics above 10 kHz.Ultra-high-frequency playback at 120 kHz is achieved by using an ultra-lightweight diaphragm, a feeding system with significantly reduced inductance, and a matching transformer with low-loss design.The feeding method is a unique method developed by Pioneer, in which two copper plates on the outward and homeward paths are held in close contact with each other through thin insulation, and the ribbon and copper plates are placed as close to each other as possible in a balanced manner. This eliminates the magnetic flux generated by each conductor and greatly reduces inductance.In order to transmit the excellent vibration of the ribbon directly to the air, it is a short horn design taking advantage of the merits of the direct radiator.It also has a direct connector that passes through the built-in network.

sections.title: PIONEER-EXCLUSIVE Pioneer
sections.overview: A ribbon-type tweeter unit that realizes ultra-high frequency reproduction.Since the vibrating part itself is the driving part of the ribbon speaker, a very light vibration form can be constructed.The PT-R7A uses an ultra-lightweight diaphragm with a mass of 0.009g. By making the mass of the diaphragm itself equal to the mass of the air that the diaphragm moves, the transient characteristics are enhanced with good efficiency without waste.As a result, flat playback is possible up to 120 kHz.The diaphragm has a rigid ribbon made by molding 9 micron ultra-thin aluminum foil into a continuous hexagonal pyramid, and by molding it into a shape that does not become a straight line when cut vertically, horizontally, or diagonally, it has a strong structure that does not worry about bending.As a result, the piston motor cortex range of the ribbon is expanded, and excellent power linearity is secured from minute input to large input.The magnet uses Alnico 7 with a magnetic flux density of 7,400 Gauss to ensure high density and uniform magnetic flux distribution, greatly improving transient characteristics, and realizing high efficiency at the same time.A low-inductance power supply system has been adopted that greatly reduces the inductance up to the ultra-high frequency range.This reduces the generation of slight inductance in the feed section and improves the high-frequency energy characteristics.The matching transformer employs a multi-layer sandwich winding of copper foil with a broadband, low-loss design, and a permalloy core with linear initial permeability characteristics.Comes with a stand base that can be set directly in the cabinet.

sections.title: PIONEER-EXCLUSIVE Pioneer
sections.overview: Beryllium ribbon tweeter developed by improving ribbon tweeter PT-R7A.The entire surface of the diaphragm is in the same phase and receives the driving force more uniformly.Since the vibrating part itself is the driving part, an extremely light vibration system can be constructed without waste, and the diaphragm is easy to move and achieves excellent linearity.Beryllium, which is the lightest and most rigid material of the diaphragm for the ribbon, has been adopted to realize high efficiency and high input resistance.In addition, the ribbon is formed into a regular hexagonal pyramid pattern by a unique manufacturing method. Since the cut surface does not form a straight line in either the vertical, horizontal, or diagonal direction, it has a strong structure that does not worry about bending. In addition, a large compliance edge is provided at the end of the rigid part of the ribbon, and it is sandwiched by silicon elastic body to realize accurate piston motion.The magnet uses Alnico 750.The magnetic flux density of 7,400G. ensures uniform magnetic flux distribution and greatly improves transient characteristics.A low-inductance power supply system has been adopted that greatly reduces the inductance up to the ultra-high frequency range.This reduces the generation of slight inductance in the feed section and improves the energy characteristics in the high frequency range.A matching transformer with a wide-band, low-loss design using multi-layer sandwiched winding of oxygen-free copper foils is adopted.High resolution has been achieved by adopting a permalloy core with linear initial permeability characteristics.The terminal is gold-plated.In pursuit of sound quality, it uses a protective circuit with a fuse in the oxygen-free copper cap.Comes with a stand base that can be set directly on the cabinet.

sections.overview: This is a high-quality stereo control amplifier that has been hand-made for each product. In addition to the circuit structure that has been worked out through repeated measurement and listening based on the essence of audio, almost special specifications have been developed and adopted from various mechanical parts to individual transistors.The circuit configuration is designed with special emphasis on dynamic characteristics such as transient characteristics and rising characteristics.The equalizer circuit has a high voltage design of 140 v to ensure a high allowable input, and employs high precision circuit elements to achieve excellent precision.Canshield transistors and glass epoxy boards are also used to ensure long-term reliability.The Phono2 and AUX3 jacks have built-in level controls, making it easy to adjust the level difference with other positions.In addition, the impedance of the Phono2 terminal can be switched, so that the impedance can be selected according to the cartridge used.Volume uses a 22-contact attenuator type.When combined with a 3-position attenuator of 0, -15, or -30dB, it is possible to adjust the volume with the attenuation as indicated on the display and without any left-right linkage error.In addition to the Bass and Treble main control that increases and decreases the low and high frequencies around 1 kHz, the tone control is a twin-tone control that is equipped with the SUB control that exclusively controls the ultra low and high frequencies.The filter is a 2-stage switching type of high filter 8kHz/12kHz and low filter 15Hz/30Hz.15 Hz uses CR and 12 kHz uses LC for 12dB/oct passive attenuation. 30 Hz and 3 kHz are active by electronic circuits and have 18 dB / dB / oct.There is a headphone jack and level control inside the front lower subpanel.By turning off the output switch, you can also listen to the sound through the headphones only.An electronic muting circuit using a reed relay is built in to eliminate the clicking sound when the switch is ON / OFF to prevent the generation of unpleasant noise.All of the knobs are carved out of pure aluminum material, and the switching torque of the number of switches is constant, giving it a luxurious feel.Attached are measured values for each unit, ensuring reliability and high performance through complete quality control.

sections.overview: A stereo preamplifier designed with advanced technology and carefully selected parts for beautiful sound.The equalizer circuit has a high voltage design of 140 v to ensure a high allowable input.The volume uses a 22-contact attenuator type 4-connected volume.It is controlled at two places, the top of the flat amplifier and the last stage of the amplifier, and residual noise is reduced.All parts and wiring materials are of special specifications, and capacitors are made of Mylar, Sticon, Electrolytic, and VII.In order to minimize distortion, oxygen-free copper wire is used as wiring material.The substrate is a 140 ? m thick copper foil glass epoxy substrate.While conventional glass epoxy boards were used by attaching 35 ? m copper foil, we have adopted 140 ? m copper foil, which is four times larger than conventional ones, in order to reduce DCR (direct current resistance) and inductance in the board.In order to ensure stable performance and reliability, all input / output terminals and assembly terminals are gold-plated to greatly improve the conduction characteristics.In the past, nickel plating was applied to the base layer in order to stabilize the plating. However, since nickel is ferromagnetic, distortion caused by hysteresis occurred.The newly developed pin jack used for C3a has been plated on a non-magnetic base material with stability equal to or better than that of nickel to prevent distortion and obtain stable contact performance.The power cord is double-insulated, high reliability and large capacity (15A) power cord.In addition, the core wire of the power cord is colored white and black, and the connection with the AC plug is managed to unify the polarity.The connection code uses a oxygen-free copper wire as the material and a gold-plated plug made of non-magnetic material as the pin plug to minimize the occurrence of strain in the connection code. The connection code structure is different from the conventional coaxial structure in that it uses a star quad system in which opposing core wires of the signal wire are twisted together to reduce inductance. In addition, the signal wire is completely shielded by a conductive polymer material and braiding.As a result, it is possible to transmit high-quality signals with low distortion and low loss.

A control amplifier with module amplifier structure.Equipped with a transformer for MC cartridges to support MC cartridges.In the Exclude C5, spiral ribbon Sendust is used for the core material of the transformer. It is used as a large core material to increase the regenerative capacity.In addition, two oxygen-free copper wires with diameters of 0.25 mm are used in parallel for winding to reduce DCR (direct current resistance). In addition, transmission characteristics are greatly improved by tightly winding the wire around the core without using protective insulation such as resin.A monoconstruction structure is adopted in which all the input / output section, amplifier section and power supply section are divided into left and right channels.In particular, the power supply section is equipped with four power transformers, two for the left and right channels, and two for the right and left channels. These transformers are divided into two for the equalizer amplifier and for the flat / buffer amplifier, and the rectifier circuit is also independent of each other. This multi-power supply system eliminates mutual interference. We are also equipped with a dedicated power transformer for relay control. We are pursuing the concept of one stage, one circuit and one power supply.In addition, a 6-core power cord is used to completely separate the L/R, relay control and AC outlet.All amplifiers of three blocks of one channel are modularized.Each circuit is based on a 280 ? m thick oxygen-free copper foil glass-epoxy board and composed of high-quality discrete component. These are hardened with high-density epoxy and stored in a carbon-filled conductive plastic case. The equalizer is also a module with the same structure.These measures prevent vibration from the outside and parts themselves, suppress distortion, prevent sound quality degradation due to electromagnetic waves, and improve the durability and thermal stability of parts.The main volume uses a unique 40-point attenuator that has been further improved based on BTS' strict specifications.The control elements are made of carefully selected carbon resistors, all of which are contained in a brass case. In addition, copper-containing solder is used for the junction, silver alloy is used for the contact material, and brass is used for the L/R separator.The control range is 0 to -90dB and -  .The power cord uses a high-quality thick power cord.This cord uses high-conductivity oxygen-free copper for conductors, and is insulated with polyethylene for double insulation structure to eliminate conductor squeal. Carbon is also used for coloring pigments for insulation materials to minimize degradation of sound quality caused by pigments.Furthermore, the 6-core structure reduces mutual interference by independently separating the left and right channels and relay control. Polarity control is also achieved by displaying polarity on the plug.99.99% pure twisted oxygen-free copper wire is used for the signal path wiring material.This material contains only 3 ppm of oxygen, which is an element of copper zincification, an impurity semiconductor, and is reduced to 1/100 compared with general electrolytic copper with purity of 99.95%.In the Exclusive C5, the tone function is released by setting the control knob of each bus / treble to the center position. When the tone control release switch is installed, the tone quality degradation caused by signal line routing is prevented.The rear panel input terminals are arranged symmetrically to prevent interference between the left and right channels.The cabinet is made of natural wood from Brazilian Rosewood.The front panel is hand-made and the control knob is made of solid material, giving it a high interior quality.

sections.overview: In search of true stereophonic, we have applied our technology without fail to create L, which can be called the origin of stereophonic.This is a high-end stereo preamplifier with the aim of "0 stereo transmission error" which reproduces sound from R as homogeneous sound.It uses a completely independent monoconstruction structure from the power cord to the input / output terminals on the rear panel.In addition, we thoroughly analyze the magnetic field, temperature, vibration, etc. inside the set that affect the reproduction of the same left and right by making full use of the latest measuring equipment, and use newly developed parts and layout of all parts of the left and right independently symmetrical type to ensure the same transmission.In addition, various considerations are taken to achieve 0 stereo transmission error, such as simplification of signal path and adoption of in-set remote control system.The magnetic field generated by power transformers and smoothing capacitors affects the transmission circuit, generating inductive noise and degrading sound quality. We have developed a power transformer with a low magnetic flux density, a capacitor that cancels the magnetic field, and other anti-magnetic measures for major components and uniform magnetic distribution within the set.Taking into account the effects of external and internal vibrations of the amplifier, we have developed and adopted a newly developed low-flux transformer and a capacitor (complimentary service capacitor pair) in which the positive side and the negative side cancel each other's magnetism.In addition, anti-vibration and anti-vibration measures such as floating printed circuit boards and an aluminum die-cast chassis with no resonance are implemented.In addition, in order to cope with deformation due to heat of the chassis, we have adopted a chassis with calculated stress and designed the layout of each part taking into account the effects of thermal deformation, etc., to clarify and respond to the effects of mechanical elements on sound quality.Taking into consideration that the characteristics of conductors whose resistance changes with temperature affect sound quality, we control heat radiation and provide appropriate layout of heat source parts to create a temperature environment similar to a constant temperature chamber in order to equalize sound on the left and right sides.In order to ensure the independence of the perfect monoconstruction in which the left and right are completely independent, the volume and function switch also adopt the remote control in the set, and the left and right are clearly separated.The circuit configuration is 1-channel 2-amplifier 2-buffer amplifier configuration.In order to drive the volume and Rec output with low impedance from the input with high impedance, a buffer amplifier is installed between the input selector and the volume, and between the volume and the phase switch. In addition, two flat amplifiers use an amplifier circuit made of aluminum hybrid IC.The power supply section is independent of three transformers for left, right and control. In order to eliminate the influence on sound quality, a power transformer which operates at a low magnetic flux density is adopted from Shinkai. Noise generation is suppressed by setting it to operate at a point with good linearity.In addition, we have developed a new complimentary service capacitor pair that focuses on the magnetic field generated on the plus side and the minus side of the smoothing capacitor and cancels each other, thereby reducing the effect of the magnetic field on sound quality.In order to completely eliminate noise and ensure the purity of the signal from the source, the input circuit uses a separate ground circuit that turns on/off not only the hot side but also the ground side at the same time. This eliminates noise from other equipment coming in from the ground line.Aluminum, which has excellent thermal conductivity and shielding characteristics, is used for the substrate of the hybrid IC used in the amplification part of the flat amplifier, thereby thoroughly suppressing the influence of heat and magnetism, which cause sound quality degradation, on sound quality.The printed circuit board, which is easily affected by vibration, is floated from the holder with dump material of special vibration insulating rubber, and the effect of vibration on sound quality is eliminated.In order to obtain independence of each channel and symmetry of left and right, an in-set remote control system is adopted for switching between volume and function to ensure left and right independence.When the front panel control is operated manually, the volume and function selector switches located at the rear of the set are driven by the motor and set to the desired position.If no operation is performed, the motor-drive generator is turned off and the effect on sound quality is cut off.In order to reproduce excellent sound quality, each part is carefully examined, and 99.99% pure oxygen-free copper shielded wire is used for signal path wiring.In order to supply energy directly to each of the three transformers, a 6-core oxygen-free copper high-quality extra-thick power cord is used.In addition to double insulation, carbon is used as the coloring pigment of the insulation material to cope with the influence of pigments on sound quality.

sections.title: PIONEER-EXCLUSIVE C10
sections.overview: This is a stereo control amplifier designed with low distortion, low noise and ultra-wide bandwidth by completely eliminating magnetic materials that distort sound.The C10 eliminates all magnetic material from the chassis and case to the switch frame and volume cover to minimize distortion due to magnetization.Taking note of the fact that capacitors have a significant effect on sound quality, we have adopted an original capacitor that has been changed from the conventional aluminum case to a resin case. The resin case prevents distortion due to eddy currents, improves impedance characteristics, and reduces distortion.In addition, capacitor elements have been treated thoroughly by reducing ESR (equivalent series resistance) (1/2 of conventional ones), using plain foils, improving impedance characteristics equivalent to film capacitors, reducing distortion (3rd harmonic 15 dB), and using oxygen-free copper wires for lead wires.A unique non-magnetic switch is used for the switches.By using non-magnetic brass for the case of this switch, the generation of distortion is almost eliminated. This eliminates the intervention of magnetic material in the switch part. In addition, the switch part is directly plated with silver on brass, and the movable contact is plated with silver on the phosphor bronze, so the reproduction sound without any sense of distortion is obtained.The pin jack is gold-plated.In general gold plating, nickel plating is applied to the base in order to stabilize the plating. Therefore, due to the influence of the ferromagnetic material nickel, the strain caused by hysteresis is generated. The newly developed pin jack used in the C-10 is coated with a non-magnetic base plating that shows stability equal to or higher than that of nickel to prevent the generation of strain.Oxygen-free copper wire is used for wiring inside the amplifier.The power cord uses a highly reliable 15A large-capacity power cord with double insulation.In addition, the core wire of this power cord is color-coded in black and white, and the connection with the AC plug is managed to unify the polarity.A 140 ? m thick copper foil glass epoxy board is used for the substrate.Conventional glass epoxy boards used 35 ? m copper foil attached to them. However, in order to reduce DCR (direct current resistance) and inductance in the board, we use 140 ? m copper foil, which is four times larger than conventional ones.Equipped with a unique supersonic filter.This filter is composed of an air-core coil with a cutoff at 50 kHz and a resistor, and has a large effect on TIM distortion countermeasures.The wooden case has an oil finish of Andes Rose natural wood.Pin cord for connection is included.This connection code uses a oxygen-free copper wire as the material and a gold-plated plug made of a non-magnetic material as the pin plug to minimize the occurrence of strain in the connection code. In addition, unlike the conventional coaxial structure, the structure of the connection code is a star quad system in which the core wires of the signal wires facing each other are twisted together to reduce the inductance. In addition, the signal wires are made of conductive polymer material and completely shielded by polarization.

sections.overview: A non-feedback stereo preamplifier equipped with a super linear circuit that solves the non-linearity of transistors without using any NFB, aiming at an amplifier with 0 transmission error.In order to obtain excellent characteristics without using NFB, a super linear circuit is mounted.In this circuit, by the action of the current mirror, the non-linearity of the transistor is canceled by the non-linearity transistor of the reverse mode.By using a non-feedback amplifier that does not apply NFB, we have obtained the following advantages : "there is no mechanism for generating TIM distortion," "there is no distortion because phase correction is not required, and frequency characteristics are flat over the entire band," and "stability in the high frequency range is good."In addition, the Super Linear Circuit uses more than 50 elements as modules to improve the reliability, ensure the thermal stability of each element, and provide a shield effect against external noise to improve sound quality.The C-Z1 uses two Super Linear Circuits per channel for the equalizer stage and one for the flat amplifier. A total of six Super Linear Circuits for two channels are used to realize a non-feedback configuration.Since a super linear circuit is basically considered as a current amplifier, its gain is determined by the value of the load resistance. Taking advantage of this feature, the C-Z1 uses a current equalizer with RIAA characteristics in the load, which provides excellent maximum allowable input.Compared with NFB amplifiers, stability of DC voltage at the output point is more important in non-feedback amplifiers.The C-Z1 uses a double-lock ???? regulator that locks the supply voltage of the super linear circuit, which has been stabilized once, into a double stable state in order to suppress the fluctuation of the midpoint voltage.In addition, all coupling capacitors, which cause coloring of sound, are removed, and all stages from input to output are directly connected to improve reliability.In order to prevent adverse effects caused by magnetic materials, we have adopted a non-magnetic structure in which aluminum is used for the chassis, frame, etc.A glass-case electrolytic capacitor is used to improve sound quality by eliminating distortion current caused by signal current and ripple current.The printed circuit board uses glass epoxy, which has high strength and excellent high-frequency characteristics.In addition, the copper foil has a thickness of 140 ? to reduce DC resistance and inductance.Highly reliable oxygen-free copper materials are used for signal wiring.A large capacity double insulated power cord is used for the power cord.Star quad structure connection pin plug cord (oxygen-free copper wire) is equipped as standard.

sections.overview: This digital control amplifier with a built-in digital dividing network was announced as a next-generation reference control amplifier capable of reproducing the high sound quality of DVD audio without exaggeration.All six channels are equipped with 192 kHz / 24-bit D/A converters. The front two channels are equipped with eight D/A converters, one for each of the high and low frequencies for the output of the channel dividing network. These converters enable highly accurate D/A conversion for high sampling.We are also working to improve the quality of D/A converters, 192 khz / 24-bit digital filters, DSPs, and A/D converters.By making the analog audio output board independent of L and R and completely eliminating interference between left and right signals, transmission errors of L and R channels are minimized as much as possible.Equipped with a flexible A/D-D/A system, eight D/A converters are operated with the highest priority on sound quality achieve higher sound quality.Four in parallel for two channel output, two in parallel for low and high frequencies for two channel digital dividing network output, and one in front L and R high and low frequencies for front two channel digital dividing network output (six channels including center, rear, and subwoofer). The remaining four channels are distributed to each channel.In addition, the A/D converter for 6 channels for analog input is parallelized by 3 channels for L and 3 channels for R respectively at the time of normal 2-channel input, thereby improving sound quality and SN ratio.A 96 kHz / 24-bit A/D converter is used for all 6-channel analog inputs. Analog source is digitally converted and controlled by A/D conversion.For 2-channel signals, the A/D-converted signal can be output from the digital output terminal by selecting either 96 kHz / 24-bit or down-converted to 48 kHz / 24-bit by DSP.Equipped with digital tone control function by newly developed 192kHz/24bitDSP.You can control each of the front, center, and rear channels in three bands : high, middle, and low.The volume is a Digital Accurate Control (DAC) volume.The ultra-precision resistance element inside the D/A converter IC is used as a resistance element for volume adjustment, making it possible to operate the ultra-precision resistance element without changing the analog volume sense.As a result, we have obtained many advantages, such as extremely small attenuation error between each channel, less susceptible to vibration, and being able to arrange at an ideal position on the substrate.Equipped with a digital phono equalizer for analog record reproduction.With the newly developed 192 kHz / 24-bit high-speed DSP, the digital phono equalizer (RIAA) operates when the three analog inputs are switched from the line input to the phono input.Equipped with digital noise reduction (DNR), the newly developed 192kHz/24bitDSP greatly reduces the noise contained in the input audio signal without damaging the audio signal.There are three types of DNR capable of amplifying frequencies up to 96 kHz : digital input, analog input, and FM stereo.Includes Legato Link Conversion and Hi-Bit.The newly developed 192kHz/24bitDSP Legato link conversions support digital input at 32 kHz, 44.1 kHz, 48 kHz, 88.2 kHz and 96 kHz. Signals in frequencies that are not recorded in the format are estimated with 1/f attenuation characteristics based on recorded signals, and natural waveforms are reproduced.Hi-Bit requantizes 16-bit digital input data into 24-bit data, enabling expansion of dynamic r-screws.Both functions can be turned on/off.It is the first control amplifier equipped with a digital dividing network and realizes frequency band division with high-precision arithmetic processing of up to 192kHz/48bit.Two types of band-splitting filters are installed : an IIR filter that can freely vary the crossover frequency and attenuation characteristics, and an FIR filter that eliminates phase changes that have been unavoidable in the past. These filters maximize the performance of the speaker system with high-precision level adjustment and a time-alignment function that can adjust the time axis between high and low frequencies.Equipped with digital time alignment function.It can be used with either IIR or FIR digital filters to adjust the time alignment which is important for multi-way speaker systems.A total of 24 sound fields (16 tone controls and 8 speaker configurations) can be set, stored and recalled depending on the item or music genre.You can also name them as you like.The signal path is thoroughly simplified, and separation and minimization of the signal path are adopted for a rational configuration.In addition, digital and analog signals are separated to minimize and simplify the signal path.One super-ring toroidal transformer is used for both digital and analog systems.Two super-ring toroidal transformers with low loss and low leakage flux, which is a source of noise in the amplifier, are completely separated. Furthermore, the transformer is contained in a case to eliminate the influence of noise from the digital system to the analog system.After careful consideration of each element, sound quality is examined through set-mounting, and it is carefully selected from those with excellent high-frequency characteristics.In order to reproduce the high sound quality of DVD audio, attention is paid to the mutual electrical influence inside the amplifier, and each part is separated by copper plated steel plate in the 3BOX-5CHAMBER structure.The chassis, rear panel, shield case, etc. use high conductivity chassis made of copper plated steel plate to suppress high frequency noise.This reduces the potential difference in the chassis and improves electrical stability.A four layer metal plate with excellent rigidity is fixed to the chassis base and made into a penta-layered (five layer structure) to form a stable underbase. Two additional layers of transformer stabilizer made of thick copper-plated steel plate are added to the mounting part of the transformer. In addition, two layers of frame are installed in the front-back direction of the amplifier to secure the chassis strength that is not affected by the sound pressure from the speakers.In addition, brass with excellent damping characteristics is used for the insulator that contacts the outside, eliminating unnecessary vibrations from inside and outside.In addition, it uses a volume knob machined from solid aluminum.The Pioneer Digital Interface (PDIF) is an original Pioneer standard for digital transmission until just before D/A conversion to prevent deterioration of the digital source.Multi-control remote controller is included.

sections.title: PIONEER-EXCLUSIVE Pioneer
sections.overview: An AV control amplifier equipped with direct construction II and clean ground system.Direct Construction II is used to minimize the signal path.To minimize the path, we use relays and electronic switches that take sound quality into consideration, and place the input selector switch and REC selector switch at the shortest position immediately after the signal input section.In addition, the volume is assembled on the same plane as the circuit board by placing it very close to the selector switch, and the distance from the circuit section to the signal output is also minimized. Especially in the direct on mode, the distance from the input to the output is shortened to 50 cm by combining with the proper position of each circuit block.To prevent harmful noise current from adversely affecting the signal path, Pioneer's original clean ground system is installed.The contact points between the circuit and the chassis are thoroughly reviewed and the power transformer and chassis, which are sources of noise, are insulated to prevent noise from entering the signal path.In addition, the connection between the circuit and the chassis is connected at an appropriate point after considering the wiring, and a bypass path is provided to return only the noise current to the noise source.In order to prevent the signals of each block from transmitting through the power supply and interfering with other circuits due to their individual characteristics, we have adopted a luxurious two transformer multi-supply power supply configuration in which the audio system, control system and video system are converted into separate transformers.The power supply for the control system, which tends to generate pulsed noise, and the power supply for the video system, which is responsible for amplification of broadband frequencies including the audio band, are made independent of the power supply for the audio system to completely eliminate interference.The video circuit board is housed in a metal case as a shielding measure in order to prevent interference with the audio circuit by amplifying the wide-band signal even outside the power supply part. Interference is suppressed by a completely separate design arranged to suppress interference even at the distance and position from the audio and video circuit boards to the ground line.In addition, it is equipped with a local power off function that automatically turns off the power of video circuits that do not operate during audio playback, video circuits that do not operate except during record playback, and phono equalizer circuits that are not used except during record playback.In addition, we have adopted a silent operation microcomputer that stops oscillation when no operation is performed for the control microcomputer of the switches. This eliminates as much as possible the cause of sound quality degradation and greatly improves the S/N feeling in actual operation.We use carefully selected parts with particular attention to sound quality.High-precision control and S/N in actual use are greatly improved for the volume, and newly developed motor-driven 4-series volume that realizes smooth movement is adopted.We also thoroughly examine the materials, characteristics, and sound quality of low-noise operational amplifier ICs, capacitors, resistors, substrates, and lead wires.Audio Line 5 and video Line 5 input jacks are installed.Gold plated terminals are used for all input / output terminals, and S terminal is also used for image terminals.You can also use a REC selector, a BGV function to play a CD sound on the video image, and recording on the back.It is equipped with a fixed output to support surround processors.This jack is output at a constant level so that the processor can control the level of each channel and master. It is also compatible with a power amplifier equipped with volume.The output is through when the direct is turned on, and the signal that has passed the balance volume and subsonic filter is output when it is turned off. The output is adjusted according to the output level of the source and the setup time.It comes with a remote controller with a learning function that can store the commands of other remote controllers and summarize their operations.Most of the equipment can be controlled by this remote control, and the color coding and arrangement of operation switches have also been examined to improve usability.Equipment with Pioneer SR mark can be controlled as it is.

sections.title: PIONEER-EXCLUSIVE M5
sections.overview: This monaural power amplifier has been carefully designed based on the concept of "amplifier for getting drunk with music".Returning to the starting point of the amplifier design of "faithfully amplifying the input signal and reproducing it as the output signal", we have developed and installed a new super linear circuit that can obtain characteristics without applying NFB. This eliminates TIM distortion from the root and ensures stability in the high-frequency range.It is a class A power amplifier that in principle does not generate any distortion such as switching distortion or crossover distortion. It adopts a unique power supply system of M5 which has a dedicated power supply for class A bias.By increasing the efficiency of the power supply, there is no excessive heat generation, which is considered a drawback of A class amplifier.All parts and construction are thoroughly examined, and the best parts are developed and carefully selected using the technology that we have.The power transformer is designed to achieve low leakage flux and stable regulation.First, we have adopted a polyester-coated oxygen-free copper wire for the winding, which has a cross-sectional area twice that of ordinary wire. This improves the regulation and reduces the temperature rise of the winding to 1/2. In addition, we have achieved a dramatic improvement in S/N by adopting the toroidal method, which is effective in reducing leakage flux.A non-conductive and non-magnetic resin is used for the transformer case, and silicon carbide powder, which is a radio wave absorber, is mixed into the filler to reduce strain, and the transformer body is floated from the chassis by rubber to reduce vibration.A newly developed film capacitor for pure audio has been adopted in order to prevent chattering and squeal in the mid - and high-frequency range caused by the structure of the film capacitor. The film material is a composite structure of polycarbonate with low tan   (dielectric loss) and polypropylene with high insulation and excellent high-frequency characteristics. This film is wound tightly at low speed and high tension to eliminate wrinkles and stress. In addition, a special winding core and heat-shrinkable resin are utilized to prevent squeal. In addition, a two stage differential amplifier is used to stabilize the DC potential, and a temperature compensation circuit is also taken into consideration. The high stability of fluctuation of 0   0.005 V in the range from -15 ? to + 55 ? is obtained.It is equipped with a protective circuit that combines an electronic circuit with 9 transistors and 11 diodes and a power relay to protect the speakers from internal damage caused by shorting of the speaker terminals and eddy currents caused by internal accidents.This circuit automatically recovers when the problem is resolved and returns to normal condition. sections.title: PIONEER-EXCLUSIVE Pioneer
sections.overview: AV power amplifier equipped with 2ch/4ch switching function.It is equipped with direct construction to minimize the signal path.In direct construction, the input signal goes through a selector in a noise-proof shield case, and then directly from the front section to the main volume unit located at the shortest position controlled by a brass long shaft.The level-adjusted signal is routed to the amplifier at the shortest distance and is output straight to the speaker jack.With a circuit layout designed to minimize the signal flow, the circuit can be as short as 80 cm, minimizing the use of wires, which have been a cause of signal distortion and sound quality degradation.Pioneer's proprietary super linear circuit is used in the power amplifier section to cancel the non-linearity of the transistor.This circuit technology combines the non-linearity of a transistor with another transistor having completely opposite characteristics to cancel each other's non-linearity. This circuit technology brings out excellent low-distortion characteristics.This makes it possible to minimize the amount of feedback in the entire amplifier stage, and reduces the number and capacity of capacitors, which adversely affect sound quality.A clean ground system is used to prevent noise currents generated in the power supply and large current parts from entering the signal path and degrading the input signal.The power transformer and heat sink, which were conventionally simply fixed to the chassis, are installed as a tight insulation structure to minimize the contact points where noise enters, and to separate the path of the input signal from the path where noise enters.In addition, the bypass is set to return to the power supply, which is a source of noise, and the adverse effect of noise current is suppressed by these measures.In order to prevent various internal and external vibrations from shaking the circuit board, leading to circuit instability and causing noise and distortion, we are committed to a vibration-free and resonance-free design.In addition to hybrid chassis with bottom plate and shield case with greatly improved vibration damping characteristics by sandwich structure of different materials of PVC sheet and steel plate, strong and highly rigid structure is constructed by honeycomb heat sink and honeycomb frame with high vibration dispersion and absorption effect and improved strength at the same time.In addition, five insulators are used to directly support the chassis frame.With the same circuit design for each channel, super linear circuit, direct construction and strong power supply, the output power of 120W + 120W when driven by 2 ch and 70Wx4 when driven by 4 ch (both 6  ) is achieved.It is equipped with 2ch/4ch switching function, and the input is 2 systems 3 inputs, and the speaker output is also 2 systems 3 outputs.The input selector functions as a 2 ch, 2chx2, or 4 ch power amplifier.Equipped with an auto output selector for use in combination with a digital surround field processor SP-91D.For example, the SP-91D has surround field control and Dolby Prologic decoding, and the two modes of playback have different output speaker arrangements, such as processing front speaker and center speaker.The Auto Output Selector automatically switches between the processing front speaker and the center speaker when you select the input mode for playback.
