sections.title: PIONEER-EXCLUSIVE Pioneer
sections.overview: A dual-drive amplifier developed in anticipation of the DVD audio age as a culmination of the direct energy MOS FET developed by Pioneer.Equipped with a 4-channel power amplifier, 3-mode speaker drive system can be selected.In separate mode it operates as a 4-channel independent power amplifier, in dual mode it operates as a bi-wired connection to eliminate interference between speaker units, and in bridge mode it operates as a 2-channel high power amplifier with a bridge connection.Equipped with Direct Energy MOS FET developed by Pioneer.Direct Energy MOS FETs have excellent power linearity and low-load drive capability with extremely low energy loss. By increasing the capacity of these power elements and using only selected high-quality products for all channels, operating errors between channels are completely eliminated.In addition, by using a ceramic sheet with extremely low thermal resistance as an insulating material between the large heat sink and the MOS FET, the temperature rise in response to the connection signal input and the instantaneous temperature rise in response to the pulse input are minimized, and the response speed and sound transparency at the time of a large volume input are improved.In addition, a newly developed Z-bias circuit that controls the temperature coefficient of the MOS FET for temperature compensation of the idle current is incorporated, and the drift of the idle current is greatly reduced, and stable sound quality is realized immediately after power is turned on.By further brush-up the wide-range linear circuit which can obtain the necessary gain by the current feedback type one stage amplifier circuit, the complete discrete configuration without using DC-servo or operational amplifier is realized. By keeping the NFB constant from the ultra-low range, clear low-range reproduction is possible.The volume is equipped with a Digital Accurate Control Attenuator that uses ultra-precision resistance elements in the D/A converter to control the volume with high precision. Two input switches and DAC attenuator function allow direct input from a CD player or other device.The DAC attenuator has features such as no linkage error between the left and right channels, no deterioration of SN ratio or separation due to the attenuator position, and no influence of vibration.You can also use the attenuator through function when connected to a preamp.Newly developed low impedance electric field capacitors and thick wires are frequently used for power supply and ground lines, and Ultra Low Instance power circuit with low impedance is adopted to improve the ability to supply instantaneous large current.A left and right independent twin stereo configuration is used from the power supply to the input / output terminals on the rear panel.In addition, by simplifying and shortening the signal path and isolating each block with a shield case, we thoroughly analyze the potential difference inside the chassis, magnetic field inside the set, temperature, vibration, etc., and homogenize the environment.Newly developed thick-walled aluminum extruding material independent on left and right is used for the heat sink.Three brass stays made of solid brass are combined in a hybrid construction to hold heavy objects such as power transformers, electric field capacitors, and heat sinks, thereby increasing component rigidity.In order to protect the input and output terminals from the sound pressure of the speakers, a copper-plated 2 mm thick steel plate is used as the rear stabilizer, and solid brass is used as the insulator to control vibration.The chassis, rear panel, shield case, etc. use high conductivity chassis made of copper plated steel plate to suppress high-frequency noise.In addition, each part is carefully selected, and the sound quality is examined by the set mounting.The power supply section is equipped with a large 355 VA super-ring toroidal transformer to improve low-load drive capability.We have also cleared the power source harmonics regulation, which has been considered difficult for large-capacity toroidal transformers.

sections.overview: AV amplifier equipped with Dolby Pro Logic and 2 surround modes.Equipped with Dolby Pro-Logic circuit developed to effectively enjoy Dolby Surround playback.This circuit reproduces the sound spread and afterglow of Dolby encoded software by a directional enhancement circuit that reproduces the sense of sound movement and speech localization and a modified B noise reduction that maintains the sound clarity of each channel. The reproduced music signal is played back in four channels : L, C, R, and Surround.The VSA 01 also has a front three channel logic mode without a rear speaker.You can choose from three center modes that suit your speakers.Normal mode is suitable for playback of the center channel using a small speaker. You can obtain richer bass by distributing the bass that does not affect the sound localization to the left and right stereo channels.The Wide mode is suitable for center channel playback using speakers equivalent to the front L/R speakers. In this mode, all bass to treble are output from the center channel.The Phantom mode is suitable when the center speaker is not used. The center channel sound is distributed equally to the front L and R. Note that the Phantom mode cannot be selected with the Dolby 3-channel logic.Equipped with a simulated surround mode, you can enjoy a wide range of sound even for monaural recorded audio and visual software.In this mode, the sound field can be further expanded by adding or subtracting the delayed signal from the L + R signal of the monaural source and outputting it to the surround L channel and surround R channel.By adjusting the delay time of the reflected sound, you can experience a variety of sound fields, from the relatively narrow atmosphere of a live house to the sound of a concert hall.It is equipped with a studio mode that allows you to experience surround sound with general audio sources.This mode is more effective with reverberant sources, such as classical chamber music or small clubs of jazz.5-channel all-discrete a 5-channel all-discrete configuration, and all five channels are equipped with independent power amplifiers for surround playback.Equipped with connection terminals for 4 AV input lines and 4 audio input lines.In addition, the sub-woofer pre-out terminal and the center channel pre-out terminal allow for upgrading.Wireless remote control is included.This remote control features an easy-to-operate key layout centered on the frequently used main volume and power ON/OFF buttons, as well as direct functions such as surround mode selection and source selection.

sections.overview: An AV amplifier with a Dolby pro-logic circuit.Focusing on the quality of the Dolby Pro Logic circuit, which is the basis of Dolby Surround, we have achieved digitization of the main circuit.Digital processing includes a directional enhancement circuit to clarify the movement of sound and the localization of speech, and a modified B noise reduction to maintain the clarity of each channel's sound. Digital processing also includes a delay circuit to add sound spread and reverberation to obtain clearer surround sound, greatly reducing degradation during Dolby decoding and enabling more realistic playback.In addition, it is equipped with a 3-channel logic mode in which you can enjoy sound field playback with enhanced realism by adding a center speaker.It is equipped with the pro-logic theater mode to enjoy the sound spread and realism like a theater in the AV room.This circuit uses Pioneer's original sound field control to process the signal extracted from Dolby Encoding Software with a digital processing pro-logic circuit, so that you can enjoy more natural surround sound.It is equipped with a sound field control that you can enjoy adding the sound suitable for the source.This system analyzes the acoustic characteristics of famous halls and theaters around the world using Pioneer's original computer simulation method, and collects the data into a DSP. Six types of sound can be selected : Hall, Jazz, Dance, Church, Theater, and Simulated Surround.You can also adjust the sound field effect with the Effect Level controls to create your preferred surround.All the channels of the power amplifier are discrete.Especially, the front three channels have the same circuit configuration.Pioneer technologies such as direct construction, which shortens the signal path, and 5-leg honeycomb insulator, which reduces external vibration, are introduced.It features an acoustic memory that stores tone control adjustments, a video signal selector that lets you mix sound and video from different sources, and a sleeve function that turns off the power after a certain amount of time.The AV input Line 5, audio input Line 5, 5-channel pre-out jacks, and direct-out jacks for sub-woofers are also provided.A dedicated self-illuminated learning remote controller is included.

sections.overview: An AV control center that uses a Dolby surround system and is equipped with an AV programmable remote controller.The ADM (Adaptive Delta Modulation) digital surround system is used in the surround circuit to achieve higher quality surround sound.The delay component uses an ADM digital delay circuit that is an evolution of an analog delay circuit that uses conventional Bucket Buigate Device (BBD) elements to achieve high S/N and low distortion.By switching the control signal to the digital delay IC, this delay circuit makes it possible to select the delay time of of 15, 20 and 30 ms.You can enjoy three surround modes.Dolby Surround Mode reduces noise by decoding and playing back the program source encoded at the time of recording. Surround signals provide a 15-30 ms delay to the L-R signal and improve S/N through a Dolby B Noise Reduction circuit.Simulated Surround mode is a mode that gives a pseudo surround effect to a monaural program source. You can enjoy surround sound by adding or subtracting the monaural (L + R) signal and the delayed signal and outputting the result signal to the L and R channels.In the Stadium Mode, surround effects are added to the L and R signals. The L-R signal and the delayed signal are output to the surround L channel and surround R channel, respectively. This mode emphasizes the spread of the sound field so that you can enjoy the realistic sensation of being in a stadium.It is equipped with input / output of AV4 system, video 1 system and audio Line 5.It is equipped with functions such as a simulcast function that allows you to enjoy playback and BGV creation by freely combining audio and video, an acoustic memory function that allows you to preset three types of sound quality, an electronic volume that eliminates gang errors and makes it easy to fine-tune the volume, and a large FL tube.The included programmable remote controller CU-AV100 was sold separately and has a learning function. It can control not only Pioneer products but also products of other companies.There are a total of 68 remote control keys, 151 keys for controlling Pioneer products in the initial state, and 154 keys that can be controlled by learning. This has a large capacity.There was an RF modulator for TV sold separately.

sections.overview: The AV control center is based on VSA 900, with 5 amplifiers, Dolby Pro Logic Surround and dual center system to improve sound localization.Equipped with Dolby Pro Logic Surround using active matrix.The built-in directional enhancement circuit (steering logic) greatly improves crosstalk from adjacent channels, and provides sound exchange and a sense of scale that cannot be achieved with conventional surround sound.Equipped with four center channel modes for adjusting the effect by matching speakers, etc.In Normal mode, the signal of 100 Hz or less, which has little effect on orientation, is distributed to the left and right channels, and the signal of 100 Hz or less is cut off from the center channel and output.Wide is a position where all signals from low to high frequencies are output to the center channel, and is suitable when the same speakers as the left and right front speakers can be used.Phantom mode is a position to be selected when the center speaker is not used. The center channel signal is divided into left and right and output.Off is the surround balance adjustment position.In addition to Dolby Pro Logic, surround mode is also installed.Stadium Mode is the most suitable mode for images of large stadiums and other places. You can enjoy a wide range of surround sound with reverberation.Simulated Surround mode simulates the reflection and reverberation of a live house or concert hall. In addition, you can adjust the delay time of the rear channel to adjust the extent of the space.Studio mode reproduces the sound of a studio or a small hall.It uses a dual center system that allows the center channel signal to be output through two speakers.This makes it possible to improve sound directivity and localization by installing center speakers on the left, right, top and bottom of the monitor.The power amplifier consists of five amplifiers, front L/R, rear L/R, and center. By minimizing the signal path, sound quality is improved.Equipped with center output terminal for center woofer.By adopting honeycomb chassis and large insulators, excellent vibration damping characteristics are obtained.It also uses a thick oxygen-free copper power cord that reduces the influence of external noise.Built-in features include test tone keys for CD direct input and volume balance adjustment for each channel, and soundfield memory for storing front balance, rear balance, level, and surround modes.Motor drive electric volume is used for the volume.It comes with an AV program and remote controller with a learning function that can control VTR, TV and audio equipment with a remote controller.

sections.overview: An AV amplifier equipped with a full digital Dolby Pro-logic circuit, DSP sound field control and Pioneer Digital Surround Theater (PDS Theater) mode.Dolby Pro Logic has realized full digital processing of steering logic (directional enhancement circuit), auto input balance, and other circuits that are important for Dolby Pro Logic. With the excellent phase characteristics and noise reduction characteristic of digital, crosstalk and S/N degradation of each channel are suppressed.It is equipped with sound field control function by DSP which simulates sound field.This system uses a computer simulation method to analyze various factors, such as the reflectivity of walls and floors and the distance from the sound source, which form the sound field of famous halls and jazz clubs around the world. The data is integrated into an independently developed 50-bit DSP, which can reproduce sound fields.You can choose from four sound field programs : Hall, Jazz, Disco, and Church. You can achieve your desired effect by adjusting the effect level in 10 levels. In addition, Simulated Surround is also installed, so that you can enjoy a stereo sound field even with software that does not expand monaural.In addition, 5-channel digital tone control using DSP allows compensation for differences in tone between front, center and rear speakers, and control according to settings and preferences.Equipped with PDS Theater mode, the sound field control by DSP and processing to obtain more natural sound field feeling are added to the signal demodulated by full digital Dolby Pro-Logic circuit to obtain sound characteristics and sound field feeling suitable for AV rooms.The amplifier section uses a 5-channel discrete configuration, and the power supply section uses a reverse winding condenser for higher sound quality.In addition, we have adopted non-vibration and non-resonance designs such as direct construction, honeycomb frame, and honeycomb heat sink, which minimize degradation of sound quality by minimizing signal paths.It is equipped with a digital input, and for D/A conversion, a 1-chip real 20-bit D/A converter is installed on the left and right front and center independently.Built-in pre-out terminal and dedicated sub-woofer connection terminal.It is equipped with a base synthesizer circuit that creates a natural deep bass and increases the impact.It is equipped with a VCR1Rec Selector that enables reverse recording independent of the playback source and a Video Signal Selector that allows you to enjoy different images from the selected source.It has a built-in Y/C isolation circuit that allows dubbing from the composite input to the VCR connected to the S terminal.It is equipped with a function backup function that keeps the selector state even during standby.On-screen display is possible.Comes with a multi-function learning remote controller.

sections.overview: A prestige model AV amplifier developed as a reference model of Pioneer.Equipped with a full digital Dolby Pro-logic circuit.In addition to steering logic (directional enhancement circuit), which is important for Dolby Pro Logic, full digital processing has been applied to circuits such as auto input balance and deformed B noise reduction, resulting in greatly improved transmission characteristics and distortion characteristics.In addition, the analog input signal is converted into a digital signal by an A/D converter before being input, which greatly reduces crosstalk between channels and S/N degradation during decoding.It has a unique sound field control function.We analyze sound field data from famous halls and jazz clubs around the world using a computer simulation method, and integrate the data into a 50-bit DSP developed by Pioneer, making it possible to reproduce sound fields.There are four types of sound field programs : Hall, Jazz, Disco, and Simulated Surround. You can enjoy the original Hall effect by controlling the effect level that matches your image. In particular, Simulated Surround can create a stereoscopic sound field even with monaural software.Four digital inputs (optical and coaxial) are installed, and the sound field control and tone control are processed by digital signals. Especially, the digital input of LD sound is processed by direct input to the Dolby Prologic circuit and sound field control for higher quality.The D/A converter is equipped with a 1-chip real 20-bit D/A converter in the front L, R and center independently.5-channel all-discrete configuration is used for the power amplifier section.In the power supply section, the capacitors are wound in the opposite direction to eliminate interference between the capacitors. In addition, we are working to improve sound quality by adopting a direct construction method that reduces sound quality degradation by minimizing the signal path and by reviewing the ground line.Construction has achieved a strong and highly rigid structure by adopting honeycomb frame and honeycomb heat sink along with greatly improving strength by making the floor plate 1.6 mm thick.In addition, panel stabilizers made of vibration-proof rubber have been added to the left and right sides of the front panel to prevent the occurrence of small vibrations around the front panel. In addition, the volume knob is made of solid wood, which is machined out of aluminum, to suppress the sound quality degradation due to resonance.In addition, various high-quality parts are used, including electrolytic capacitors carefully selected through repeated trial listening.It is equipped with 5-channel independent digital tone control in order to correct the sound quality of the speaker and obtain a more natural moving feeling and sound field. The digital method prevents deterioration such as phase distortion and enables accurate adjustment.It is equipped with a base synthesizer function that detects the low-frequency component of the signal and creates a low-frequency half of it.In the VSA-1000D, the operation accuracy is improved in order to prevent interference with the ultra-low frequency component, which was included in some sources, and this interference is eliminated.It is equipped with functions such as a function backup that keeps the selector function even in standby mode, a VCR1REC selector that enables back-side recording independent of the source being played back, and a Y/C separation circuit that does not require connection even when dubbing from the composite input to the VCR1 connected to the S terminal.Equipped with 5 ch pre-out terminal and subwoofer terminal.Self-illuminated wireless remote control with learning function is included.In addition to the self-illumination system and the conventional learning function, the multi-command function that can preset up to seven consecutive operations and call them up with one touch, the remote control input function for television and video, and the simple design with one button and one function have been improved to further improve operability.

sections.overview: A flagship AV amplifier that supports THX Surround EX.Compatible with THX Ultra, it can be used anywhere from space-saving to full-fledged home theater (3000 ft).It is equipped with the THX Surround EX decoder which brings the sound effects of Surround EX, an audio format for theaters, to the living room.This system is a 7.1 ch surround system with two surround back channels added to the conventional 5.1 ch surround system, further improving sound continuity and enveloping impact.With the VSA-D10EX, you can connect surround back speakers by adding an external power amplifier. Surround SURROUND EX-compatible sources allow you to enjoy THX Surround EX 7.1 ch sound, while Dolby Digital 5.1 ch sources can be played back as 7.1 ch by THX Surround EX decoding.It is also compatible with DTS-ES.The decoder uses Cirrus Logic's CS 493292 - CLEP.This DSP chip is compatible with MPEG-2 AAC of BS digital broadcasting, so you can enjoy 5.1 ch BS digital broadcast movies as they are, or enjoy multi-channel broadcast contents as they are.Equipped with advanced theater mode.This function is a sound field mode unique to Pioneer. You can choose the sound field that best suits the style of the living room and the sound taste of the user while retaining the essence of surround formats such as DTS and Dolby Digital.In 7-D theater mode, 2-channel sources such as Dolby surround sound can be played in 7.1 channel multi-speaker surround sound.Equipped with Midnight listening mode, it can improve the sense of presence that tends to be lacking when enjoying movies or music at low volume such as at night.This mode adjusts the frequency response, balance, dynamic range, and other characteristics of the human auditory sense according to volume changes.Equipped with DSP mode, 7 surround modes can be selected.You can also adjust the effect levels in nine levels for Hall1, Hall2, Jazz, Dance, Theater1, and THeater2.Direct Energy MOS-FET is used for each power amplifier for 5 channels.This element has features such as low power loss due to heat generation, high efficiency signal amplification and excellent power linearity, contributing to accurate speaker drive.By selectively using this direct energy MOS-FET, the operating conditions of all channels are matched to minimize differences in sound quality and tone quality between channels.The heat sink is made of aluminum and has a large wall thickness to suppress resonance, so as to provide sufficient heat protection and high sound quality. In addition, thorough noise control measures are taken, such as a copper shield cover with a diode and a power transformer.The input / output terminals are equipped with D4 image terminal for progressive image, component image terminal and S2 image terminal.In the audio system, in addition to the multi-channel (7.1 ch) direct input terminal for DVD audio and newly developed large gold-plated speaker terminal for banana plug, the digital input / output terminal is also equipped in abundance.Direct construction is used for internal construction.This system is based on the idea that the signal path should be as simple as possible. It separates different circuits (digital and analog, video and audio), and arranges parts optimally to minimize the signal transmission path, thereby completely eliminating signal interference between circuits.In addition, the copper foil on the circuit board of the power supply unit is 70 microns, double the normal size, reducing the impedance of the circuit and achieving smoother signal flow.The chassis structure uses a double layered chassis.In this system, the chassis is double-jointed by welding to increase the rigidity of the chassis and reduce distortion. In addition, the chassis and rear panel are copper-plated to reduce impedance and contribute to stabilization of high-frequency potential.Equipped with multi-channel digital noise reduction.Compensates for noise in audio signals from cassette tapes, VTRs, FM/AM tuners, and other devices, making the sound less noisy and easier to listen to.Equipped with an RF demodulator.Each circuit is equipped with a separate and independent local regulator.It uses parts such as high-voltage film capacitors for high sound quality, high-ripple electrolytic capacitors, low-noise bridge rectifier diodes, 70-micron copper foil printed circuit board for power supply, and low-resonance large aluminum extruded heat sinks.Gold plated input / output pin jacks and banana plug-compatible screw-type gold plated speaker terminals are used.The display section is equipped with a 4-stage FL dimmer display.It comes with a 4.5 inch large liquid crystal touch panel remote controller with back light.This remote control operates according to the GUI displayed on the LCD. It is equipped with a macro function that turns on the power of DVD, TV and VCR continuously just by turning on the system power, a flexible macro that allows up to five commands to be added freely, a system-off macro that turns off all systems with one button, and a lock function that prevents inadvertent operation of the train.

sections.overview: Stereo receiver equipped with servo auto-tuning mechanism.Both FM and AM are equipped with an auto-tuning mechanism that only requires one touch button press. The servocontrol enables more precise tuning than manual tuning.The problem with the auto-tuning mechanism was that it was difficult to achieve accurate tuning due to misalignment caused by motor inertia and brush wear.The SX-100S employs a mechanism that stops at the tuning point by utilizing the fact that the positive and negative DC signals (S-curve) obtained from the discriminator become 0 at the tuning point, instead of using the AFC to compensate for this shift.The dial indicator moves back and forth slightly to the left and right before it stops. This is because it keeps track of the precise tuning point. If the signal position deviates during reception due to radio waves, it follows and tunes. Also, as long as the dial indicator moves, the muting is automatically activated so that no unpleasant inter-station noise occurs.This muting is also used as the auto-tuning stop sensitivity level and can be changed further.Manual tuning can also be performed as usual.It is equipped with a Local Station switch. When it is turned on, the sensitivity to stop the dial indicator drops by 20 dB.This allows you to pass through stations with weak radio waves or high noise without stopping, and selectively catch only stations with strong radio waves.If the FM Stereo Station switch is turned ON, only the stereo broadcast transmission can be selected.By using the attached remote control unit, both auto-tuning and volume can be operated from a distance.The FM tuner section combines three FETs and four variable capacitors on the front end, and uses two stages of high frequency amplification. The IF section uses four ICs and two crystal filters with sharp characteristics.3-stage direct connection type using FET is adopted for the tone control.There are two Phono inputs, one of which can be used with an MC cartridge by using a separately sold transformer (PP-402).A preamplifier and a power amplifier can be used separately.

It uses a cascode type for high-frequency amplification and a separate excitation type for frequency-conversion, thereby realizing a front end with excellent S/N ratio, selectivity and stability.The IF amplifier consists of four stages of double-tuning system.The FM multi-circuit employs a switching method and is equipped with an automatic switching mechanism that automatically selects between stereo and mono FM broadcasts.When an stereo broadcast transmission is received, you can check it with the stereo indicator.Equipped with muting circuit, quiet channel selection is possible.It is equipped with a tuning meter that gives a highly sensitive tuning instruction.Equipped with a full-scale NAB characteristic equalizer, the tape head output can be directly connected.In addition, it is equipped with a tape monitor switch that can monitor recorded tapes while recording, and a DIN-compliant one connection recorder / reconnector.The amplifier uses a single-ended push-pull OTL system with 2SD45, a mesa silicon transistor for high-power Hi-Fi.The built-in transistor protection circuit consists of an electronic switch and relay that work in a short time of one millionth of a second. There is no need to worry about breakage of the transistor due to accidental short-circuiting of the output terminal or other operational error.When this protective circuit is activated, a warning lamp lights on the panel to indicate an error.Equipped with a stereo headphone jack.Equipped with a Low-High cut filter.Uses a front panel that has undergone special processing on aluminum light alloy.

sections.overview: This is a stereo receiver that achieves both usability and sound quality.The power amplifier section employs a single-stage differential amplified pure complimentary service OCL circuit using dual transistors with uniform characteristics in   2 power supply system.The equalizer circuit uses a high-voltage low-noise IC with 1 stage differential amplification using   2 power supply system.This circuit limits the RIAA deviation to within   0.3 dB.Low-noise PNP-NPN 2-chip direct connection amplifier is used for the tone control part, and CR type is used for the tone circuit.The control knob for both bass and treble has an 11-point click stop. This control volume is a newly developed center defeat type. When the control volume is set to the center OFF position, the tone circuit is passed in the same way as the tone defeat, and flat characteristics without waviness are obtained.A 6,800 ? Fx2 capacitor is used for the power supply.With a built-in loudness contour, the bass and treble are corrected independently of the tone control knob, and a balanced sound quality can be obtained even in low volume playback.Equipped with two tape input / output terminals.Equipped with a microphone mixing circuit.You can control the volume of the microphone freely by operating the mixing knob.In order to improve sound quality, the circuit is integrated with a large circuit board and the shielding wire for input is eliminated.All input / output terminals and circuits except for the speaker circuit are integrated to prevent degradation of the high frequency band due to the influence of the shield wire.The front-end part of the tuner uses an FET with low noise coefficient and a frequency number line type precision 3-row varicon.The FM-IF section uses a well-established high-integration IC and two stage ceramic filter.The 5-stage limiter also eliminates AM noise.The MPX section uses a PLL system with a high-integration IC.A highly integrated IC is used for the AM tuner section.A large flywheel with high inertial efficiency is used for the tuning mechanism.The height of the panel surface of the SX 555 is equal to that of the cassette deck CT-3, so you can enjoy a unified design.

sections.title: PIONEER-EXCLUSIVE Pioneer
sections.overview: A stereo receiver that employs a pure complimentary service OCL circuit directly connected to all stages.The power amplifier section employs a pure complimentary service OCL circuit directly connected to all stages. This circuit extends linearly to the ultra-low frequency range, which has been interrupted by the reactances of the output capacitor. The very small inductance of the capacitor does not adversely affect the characteristics of the ultra-high frequency range. Moreover, there are no unstable elements such as oscillation caused by the coupling capacitor, so NF is sufficiently applied.As a result, the low-frequency and high-frequency characteristics are improved and a low distortion factor is achieved over the entire band.Pioneer uses its own protection circuit that combines 8-transistor, 10-diode, and relay.In the event of a trouble such as a loss of DC balance at the output stage or an overload such as short-circuiting of the speaker terminals, the electronic circuit detection section immediately catches the trouble and activates the relay to protect the speakers and power transistors.This protection circuit also functions as a power muting to suppress the noise caused by the rush current when the power is turned on.Since it is an automatic recovery type protection circuit, it automatically returns to the operating state when the trouble is solved.It employs a front end of a high-frequency two stage amplifier circuit that combines a four link varicon and FET.The IF section combines an IC and a ceramic filter to obtain sharp selectivity characteristics.It is designed with an emphasis on the Hi-fi reception of the AM tuner. It employs a forward AGC circuit to suppress distortion at strong input, and a ceramic filter is used for the IF section.A wide dial scale is mounted on the panel surface, and a two meter system of signal strength meter and center tuning is adopted.FET is used in the FM muting circuit to eliminate unpleasant inter-station noise during FM channel selection.The FET gate is controlled by a narrow pulse near the tuning point center by stiffening the muting voltage from the S-curve and IF stage.The tone control amplifier uses a 3-stage direct-coupled NF type circuit that uses FET at the first stage. Since the input impedance is high, the S/N ratio does not decrease depending on the volume level and stable characteristics are obtained.The knob is a double type and both Bass and Treble can be controlled independently on the left and right.In addition, since it is a Klix/Kluk? top type, it is possible to reproduce characteristics according to the listening room.It is equipped with an audio muting switch that attenuates the volume by 20 dB with the switch ON.The preamp and power amp sections can be separated by plugging the rear panel.You can configure a multi-amplifier system simply by adding an electronic crossover network and a power amplifier.Equipped with a low filter and a high filter that effectively cut out noise such as motor ground noise and scratch noise.

sections.overview: This is a stereo receiver that pursues performance equivalent to the high class separate type.The power amplifier section uses a pure complimentary service OCL circuit with 1 stage differential amplifier using   2 power supply system.This circuit takes into consideration not only high power but also low distortion factor by using dual transistors with uniform characteristics in the differential section.A 15,000 ? Fx2 large-capacity capacitor is used for the power supply.The equalizer amplifier section uses a high-voltage low-noise IC with one stage differential amplification using   2 power supplies. The RIAA deviation is kept within   0.2 dB by using carefully selected elements such as metal film resistors with an error of less than 1% and styrene capacitors with an error of less than 2%.In addition, high voltages of + 21 v and -19V are applied to the IC used, and the maximum allowable input is 200 mv, which corresponds well to the dynamic range of the record.The control section uses the same low-noise IC for the tone stage as the equalizer section to obtain low distortion and high output.The tone control uses a CR type circuit, and both Bass and Treble are 11-step variable type. Since it comes with a Klix/Kluk? top, it can be accurately returned to its original position even if you turn the knob.A tone circuit OFF switch is also provided to make the tone flat, in which case the tone circuit is bypassed.Attenuator type is used for the main volume.This is a 32-step dB display, and the amount of sound attenuation can be read accurately. Moreover, the left / right linkage error is within 0.5 dB over the range of 0 to -70dB, so there is no worry that the left / right balance will change according to the volume change.Two tape I/O circuits are mounted.Equipped with a low-cut filter.With the built-in loudness contour, you can enjoy powerful sound quality even when playing at a small volume.A microphone jack is mounted on the front panel.If you insert the microphone jack when the function switch is in the Aux/Mic position, the Mic has priority and the Aux is disconnected.The front-end of the tuner consists of a high-frequency amplifier stage with a dual-gate MOS-FET in the first stage and a four series varicon. V is obtained, as well as interference rejection capability and excellent characteristics.The IF section is based on a dedicated high-integration IC, combined with two differential ICs and three 2-element ceramic filters, and uses a circuit configuration with a 5-stage limiter.In addition, this circuit adopts the latest design in which a ratio detection circuit is installed in addition to the IC used at that time, making the distortion factor and SN ratio more advantageous. sections.overview: In order to faithfully pick up the limits of high-fidelity reproduction by delving into basic issues such as low mass, broadband, high trackability, high rigidity, and no resonance in order to faithfully pick up the music signal inscribed on the disc.The left and right channels of the magnetic circuit are independent, and each channel is composed of 3 poles and 2 magnets. The magnets are opposed to each other in the same polarity across the center yoke so that the magnetic flux is concentrated in the center yoke. By this, a larger magnetic flux is generated with a small magnet, and efficient power generation is achieved.The magnet uses samarium-cobalt, which has a large energy product, and is designed to obtain high magnetic flux density in spite of the wide gap. As a result, high magnetic flux density of 10,000 Gauss maximum can be obtained, and linear and efficient power generation is possible from large amplitude of low sound range to small amplitude of high sound range.The total weight of the magnetic circuit for both channels is only 0.9g, which is about 1/4 of that of a conventional MC cartridge, making it possible to make a low-mass cartridge.Micro coils are arranged to correspond to magnets independently on the left and right. The coils have a coreless and bobbinless structure with 99.99% pure oxygen-free copper wires wound in multiple layers.The impedance characteristics are almost constant up to around 100 kHz, and the sound quality is not affected by changes in the impedance characteristics, so a flat playback sound can be obtained.Both the magnet and the coil are structurally separated into the left and right channels, respectively, so that interference between the left and right signals is suppressed and excellent channel separation is obtained.Beryllium is used as a material for the cantilever, and the tapered pipe cantilever is completed by the vacuum deposition method utilizing Pioneer's proprietary precision processing technology.This is different from the one in which thin plates are rounded and joined together. It is directly molded in the shape of a pipe, so that rigidity is increased and effective mass is reduced, mechanical impedance is extremely low, and reliable tracing is possible.The PC-70MC uses a one point support system with a clear vibration support point. The rear end of the cantilever is supported by a suspension wire, a damper is provided to clarify the vibration support point, and a damper is provided to clarify the vibration support point. The vibration in the front-back direction that occurs during tracing is reliably suppressed and stable braking is provided.In addition, taking advantage of the low mass design, the viscous damping of the damper material is set to a minimum to further improve the traceability.In designing the frame, we have developed a method for measuring dynamic mass using data obtained by directly exciting the cartridge body using computer analysis technology, and based on the know-how obtained through this method, we have implemented a non-resonance design.The main body of the PC-70MC is made of aluminum die-cast to suppress resonance. Moreover, the vibration system is fixed directly to the frame where the cartridge is attached to the head shell. Thus, there are no intermediate parts and no resonance is generated due to the structure.In addition, a chuck joint system is adopted in which the vibration system is firmly attached to the aluminum die-cast frame, and the contact point is changed from conventional point contact by screw fastening to surface contact, and adhesion is improved and resonance is prevented.

Belt drive phono motor using DC servo hole motor.The motor is a brushless motor using a Hall element developed by Pioneer.The driving magnetic field of the Cono motor is generated by the current from the transistor circuit that works by switching the Hall element. The magnetic force change to the Hall element is sequentially and regularly performed by a pre-magnetized magnet rotor to obtain accurate rotation.In addition, since it is a low-speed motor that rotates at 10 times the speed of a turntable, vibration is reduced, and S/N and durability are improved.Equipped with a DC servo mechanism, even if rotation deviation occurs, accurate rotation is maintained by controlling driving voltage.This servomechanism consists of a capacitor-type rotational frequency detector and an electronic control circuit that are not affected by changes in ambient temperature or by the magnetic force of the rotor magnet. The capacitor-type detector directly changes the rotational frequency deviation into a change in the oscillation frequency, and the electronic control circuit controls the driving voltage according to the change.A purely electronic system is used for changing the number of revolutions. Unlike the conventional system, there is no need to change the belt, so there is no trouble caused by the belt or its changing mechanism.In addition, each of 33 1/3 and 45 rpm is equipped with an independent fine adjustment knob, allowing the rotational speed to be adjusted within   2%.

sections.overview: Direct-drive phono motor employing magnetic pulse detection system.The drive motor is a brushless high-torque Hall motor using a Hall element.A Hall element is a type of semiconductor that converts a change in magnetic field into an electric current. By applying it to motor-driven switching (magnetic pole switching), vibration and wear due to friction are suppressed, and high S/N and durability are achieved.The servo mechanism uses a frequency control method of magnetic pulse detection.In this system, magnetic pulses from the bottom surface of the magnetized rotor magnet are detected, and the AC signal obtained from the detected pulses is used for automatic control, so that constant speed rotation with quick response can be maintained without being affected by external temperature and humidity.The power supply to the drive circuit and control circuit is provided by a stable circuit with a large current capacity. Moreover, by providing sufficient temperature compensation, stability of rotation against fluctuation of power supply voltage and stability index with high temperature drift and time drift can be obtained.The turntable has a precisely machined inertial mass of 280kg-cm.2Large turntables have been adopted.Stroboscopic lighting is lit by a special waveform shaping circuit and is easier to see than general stroboscopic lighting.The turntable and control part are separated to increase the freedom of installation.It boasts durability that can be used without oil for 10,000 hours.Fine speed adjustment of   6% is possible for each rotation speed independently.There was a special cabinet sold separately.

sections.title: PIONEER-EXCLUSIVE Pioneer
sections.overview: A direct-drive phono motor developed by applying the Hall element developed by Pioneer.By adopting a direct drive system in which the rotation of the motor itself is the same as the number of revolutions of the record, there is no reduction mechanism that causes uneven rotation, and the generation of vibration that increases in proportion to the number of revolutions is reduced.In addition, we have adopted a DC drive Hall motor that applies a Hall element to detect the magnetic field of the switching mechanism. Compared with a mechanical switching mechanism motor using a brush, vibration is less and S/N and durability are improved.The Hall element is a magnetic-to-electric conversion element with a structure in which a potential difference is generated at the output terminal when a current is passed through the input terminal and a perpendicular magnetic field is applied to the input terminal. This is called the Hall effect. An alloy of N-type InSb is evaporated on a cross-shaped substrate, and four input / output lines are provided there. This is a type of semiconductor molded with synthetic resin material.Pioneer has developed a vacuum deposition method and succeeded in rationalizing the production process and increasing the thickness of the ultra-thin film from 30-50 ? m to 0.8 ? m. Moreover, uniform quality improves the performance of Hall elements.In the MU-3000, three Hall elements are placed at the bottom of the stator core for sequential switching.The MU of the MU 3000 consists of a rotor magnet magnetized to 20 poles and a 3-phase wave-wound stator with two pairs of 60-slot windings.Three Hall elements are arranged on a part of the stator side. The Hall elements generate signals to activate the transistor circuit by magnetic field lines in sequence with the rotation of the magnet rotor magnetized with 20 poles. The transistor circuit changes the current supply to each winding in sequence according to the signals to generate rotational driving force.A DC servo mechanism has been adopted in order to obtain more precise accuracy of constant speed.This servomechanism uses the back electromotive force generated in the coil by the rotation of the magnet rotor to control the rotation. Since the back electromotive force increases and decreases in proportion to the rotation, this change is detected and the electronic circuit accurately controls the drive current.33 1/3, 45 rpm speed switching uses a purely electronic circuit.In addition, there is a speed fine adjustment knob that can be adjusted independently for each rotational speed, and it can be freely controlled within   2%.Since it uses a DC motor, it can be used regardless of the power frequency of 50Hz/60Hz.

sections.title: PIONEER-EXCLUSIVE P3
sections.overview:
530,000 (around 1979)  600,000 (around 1981)

In order to extract the sound of a single disc close to the limit and to realize high-fidelity reproduction by eliminating vibration as much as possible, this stereo player system is made by hand one by one by putting all technical know-how into it, eliminating cost constraints and technical compromises.For the phono motor and bearing structure, we have adopted a quartz PLL control system for the linear torque type DD motor with slotless and coreless structure. In addition, we have adopted the SHR (Stable Hanging Rotor) bearing structure with the center of gravity of the rotating shaft set low. As a result, we have achieved rotational performance with rotational unevenness of 0.003% or less and rotational speed accuracy of 0.001%, which is impossible with conventional measurement methods.In the SHR system, the bearing structure is designed to be the reverse structure of the conventional system. First, the supporting point is moved closer to the center of gravity and the conventional bearing section is changed to the rotating side, so that inertia is generated in the bearing section during rotation and lateral pressure is not applied to the shaft. To prevent rattling, the clearance of the bearing is kept to a minimum, and sufficient torque and turntable inertia are set for the load of the cartridge applied to the outer circumference of the turntable.The high torque motor with dual rotor structure using anisotropic ferrite magnet with strong magnetic force realizes high torque (10kg-cm) similar to record cutting equipment.In addition, an inertial mass of 700kg-cm2In combination with the turntable and servo circuit with excellent transient characteristics, excellent starting characteristics (constant speed rotation in 0.3 seconds after the switch is turned on) and load resistance characteristics (equivalent to needle pressure of 1.5 kg) are realized, and stable and high precision rotational characteristics are obtained.The tone arm is equipped with a mass concentration system that concentrates the mass on the rotating shaft and an oil dump adjustment mechanism, in addition to the light equivalent mass of the tone arm.By applying a highly reliable silicone oil brake on the arm shaft, the volume in the low range and the reduction of cross modulation distortion are realized. In addition, the amount of oil dump brake can be controlled according to the characteristics of the cartridge, and the dump can be turned off.For the tone arm part, in order to flatten the mechanical impedance, analysis and trial listening of vibration mode of all parts are repeatedly conducted, and an integrated arm pipe made of carbon fiber with a head shell is adopted.Straight pipe and S-shaped universal arm pipe can be replaced to enable use of commercially available head shell.Equipped with a quick stop mechanism that combines an electronic brake that uses an electronic circuit to apply the force of a motor and reverse rotation, and a mechanical brake that uses a plunger to stop the rotation of the rotor.The motor and tone arm are fixed to a 12 kg weight base made of laminated aluminum and barium sulfate of high density material.In addition, the base is completely floated from the cabinet to prevent sound pressure from the speakers and vibration from the floor. adopting a coaxial suspension system.In order to enable a high howling margin, a triple structure insulator has been adopted.The 25 kg body is supported by an oil dump type piston structure using a 62 mm spring, and special rubber is used to absorb surging of the spring.In addition, since the natural frequency of the insulator is set to 5 Hz or less, which is lower than the natural frequency of the tone arm, a high howling margin is obtained by combining with the vibration isolation structure of the coaxial suspension.The cabinet is designed with a combination of a Brazilian Rosewood natural wood finish cabinet and a tempered glass dust cover to prevent howling.There was a tone arm sold separately because it is equipped with the same arm as P3a.

In addition, we have adopted the SHR (Stable Hanging Rotor) bearing structure with the center of gravity of the rotating shaft set low. As a result, we have achieved rotational performance with rotational unevenness of 0.003% or less and rotational speed accuracy of 0.001%, which is impossible with conventional measurement methods.In the SHR system, the bearing structure is designed to be the reverse structure of the conventional system. First, the supporting point is moved closer to the center of gravity and the conventional bearing section is changed to the rotating side, so that inertia is generated in the bearing section during rotation and lateral pressure is not applied to the shaft. To prevent rattling, the clearance of the bearing is kept to a minimum, and sufficient torque and turntable inertia are set for the load of the cartridge applied to the outer circumference of the turntable.The high torque motor with dual rotor structure using anisotropic ferrite magnet with strong magnetic force realizes high torque (10kg-cm) similar to record cutting equipment.In addition, an inertial mass of 700kg-cm2In combination with the turntable and servo circuit with excellent transient characteristics, excellent starting characteristics (constant speed rotation in 0.3 seconds after the switch is turned on) and load resistance characteristics (equivalent to needle pressure of 1.5 kg) are realized, and stable and high precision rotational characteristics are obtained.The tone arm is equipped with a mass concentration system that concentrates the mass on the rotating shaft and an oil dump adjustment mechanism, in addition to the light equivalent mass of the tone arm.By applying a highly reliable silicone oil brake on the arm shaft, the volume in the low range and the reduction of cross modulation distortion are realized. In addition, the amount of oil dump brake can be controlled according to the characteristics of the cartridge, and the dump can be turned off.The tone arm is made of DRA & alumina ceramics in pursuit of no resonance.It is equipped with a new mechanism, Dynamic Resonance Absorber (DRA), which was developed based on computer analysis technology such as FFT analyzer to understand the vibration characteristics of the tone arm that degrade sound quality. The DRA is equipped with a sub-resonance body composed of a damper with moderate spring properties and a weight, and absorbs vibrations that are opposite to the resonance of the arm. This vibration neutralization function prevents the needle tip from picking up excess components other than the sound groove, and more accurate reproduced sound is obtained.Alumina ceramic is used for the arm material. This material has approximately 3 times the specific rigidity compared to conventional aluminum and reduces resonance.Equipped with a quick stop mechanism that combines an electronic brake that uses an electronic circuit to apply the force of a motor and reverse rotation, and a mechanical brake that uses a plunger to stop the rotation of the rotor.The motor and tone arm are fixed to a 12 kg weight base made of laminated aluminum and barium sulfate of high density material.In addition, the base is completely floated from the cabinet to prevent sound pressure from the speakers and vibration from the floor. adopting a coaxial suspension system.In order to enable a high howling margin, a triple structure insulator has been adopted.The 25 kg body is supported by an oil dump type piston structure using a 62 mm spring, and special rubber is used to absorb surging of the spring.In addition, since the natural frequency of the insulator is set to 5 Hz or less, which is lower than the natural frequency of the tone arm, a high howling margin is obtained by combining with the vibration isolation structure of the coaxial suspension.The cabinet is designed with a combination of a Brazilian Rosewood natural wood finish cabinet and a tempered glass dust cover to prevent howling.A very thick power cord made of highly conductive oxygen-free copper is used for the power cord, reducing losses in wire rod and greatly improving non-linear strain.In addition, by clearly displaying the polarity, the sound quality is improved.

sections.overview:
300,000 (around 1979)  350,000 (around 1981)

A high-end stereo player system announced around the same time as Exclusive P3.As with the P3, in order to pursue the music quality thoroughly, the technical know-how was poured into it and each piece was hand-made.EM-10 is used for the phono motor part.The EM-10 uses a coreless, slotless structure linear torque hole motor that does not cause cocking, resulting in a strong starting torque (3kg-cm).In addition, in order to obtain stable rotation, In addition, in order to obtain stable rotation, a balanced toy type SHR system (Stable hanging rotor) is used for the bearing structure to reduce side pressure applied to the bearing and lower the center of gravity of the rotating part, achieving an uneven rotation performance of 0.007% and a rotational speed accuracy of 0.002%.EA-10 is used for the tone arm.The EA-10 adopts a level variable type oil dump mechanism using reliable silicon oil, which improves traceability and greatly reduces intermodulation distortion that occurs during large amplitude reproduction in the low frequency range.In addition, by rotating the adjustment ring, the damping is turned off so that the horizontal balance can be easily taken accurately.In order to flatten the mechanical impedance of the tone arm, we repeatedly analyze and listen to the vibration mode of every part and use a straight tapered pipe made of carbon fiber that is integrated with the head shell. This reduces the vibration of each part in fine details and enables playback with stable sound quality from MM to MC.To enable the use of commercially available head shells, it is also equipped with an S-shaped universal arm pipe so that it can be used with most cartridges.The cabinet uses a non-resonant slit-type laminated solid board, and a low-center-of-gravity insulator, which is strong against howling and prevents unnecessary vibration for players, is installed from above inside the body.In addition, it is finished with an Andes Rosewood natural wood finish and combined with a 5 mm thick smoked acrylic cloth for a simple design.

sections.overview:
PL-30 :   55,000 (around 1980)PL-30L :   59,800 (around 1980)

A manual type record player that takes advantage of the good unit design as well as the high-grade model.There were 2 types, PL-30 of the normal version and PL-30L with the silent lift-up function.The drive unit is equipped with an SH-rotor type phono motor, similar to the high-grade model.By moving the rotor bearing, which used to be located at the bottom of the motor, just below the turntable, we have succeeded in greatly reducing the wow and flutter, realizing excellent characteristics.In addition, a quartz PLL DC servo Hall motor with a starting torque of 1.3kg-cm is adopted for the motor, and the motor is 330kg-cm.2By combining a large turntable with an inertial mass of 1 g, stability without load fluctuation is realized even under a load of 200g.In addition, three Hall elements developed by Pioneer are used in the magnetic pole switching mechanism of the motor. In addition, fine noise is suggested by requiring micron-order machining accuracy even for fine parts.The turntable uses a turntable sheet with excellent acoustic characteristics.In order to suppress low-frequency resonance caused by warping or eccentricity of records, a silicon oil braking system (capable of on/off operation) is adopted.By pressing the warping knob on the upper part of the arm shaft, the braking fin sinks into the silicon injected into the oil cup, and viscous braking is applied to the arm. Moreover, by cutting the tip of the braking fin (ring shape) at 45 degrees, it is designed to apply appropriate braking in both horizontal and vertical directions.This reduces harmful low-frequency resonance and greatly reduces cross-modulation distortion, which adversely affects the audible band.It uses silicon oil, which has no viscosity change with time or temperature, and is excellent as a braking oil. In addition, by storing this silicon oil in an oil cup made with high precision, it has high reliability without oil oozing out.Uses a die-castable arm base with a stabilizing effect.In addition, a long type arm with an effective length of 250 mm using a high-rigidity aluminum pipe is adopted for the arm. In addition, by adopting a mass concentration system in which the main weight is close to the arm shaft, the moment of inertia of the arm is reduced, and the basic performance of the arm itself is improved before oil braking is applied.In order to suppress vibrations such as howling, we have adopted a high-density cabinet made of carefully selected conifers.In addition, a newly developed large insulator with a low center of gravity structure is used for the insulator that supports the cabinet, making it resistant to external vibrations.By using the separately sold damping adjustment adapter, it can be adjusted at the level of 1 to 5 similar to the PL-70, and it becomes a level braking amount variable arm which can respond to the compliance of any cartridge.When mounting a cartridge with heavy weight (Orthophone SPU-GT type, etc.), it is recommended to use an exchange weight (sold separately).The PL-30L is equipped with a silent lift-up function that realizes accurate and quiet operation.First of all, the arm is raised and lowered using a moving coil system that applies the operation principle of a speaker. It operates without contact with DC voltage.In addition, the end position of the recording groove is detected by non-contact detection using a Hall element mounted inside the arm shaft and a magnet mounted opposite the Hall element.In addition, it is equipped with a pure electronic quick stop mechanism that works in conjunction with a silent lift-up mechanism to stop the turntable instantly.

In addition, this silicon oil is stored in an oil cup made with high precision to prevent oil from oozing out and improve reliability.A heavy weight arm base made of die cast with a stabilizer effect is used for the arm base.The drive section is equipped with an SH-rotor type coreless motor.We have succeeded in greatly reducing the wow flutter by moving the rotor bearing, which used to be located at the bottom of the motor, just below the turntable, and by adopting a coreless structure that does not cause cogging in principle.Starting torque is 1.3kg-cm and further 330kg-cm2By combining a turntable with an inertial mass (including a turntable seat), stability without load fluctuation is realized even with a load of 200g corresponding to 100 tone arms with a needle pressure of 2.0g.In addition, three highly reliable Hall elements developed by Pioneer are used in the magnetic pole switching mechanism of the motor. In addition, fine noise is eliminated by requiring micron-order machining order of microns down to fine parts.Adopts a silent lift-up mechanism that achieves quiet and accurate operation.First of all, the arm is moved up and down using a moving coil system that applies the operation principle of a speaker and operates without contact with DC voltage.In addition, to detect the end position of the recording sound groove, a method of non-contact detection using a Hall element mounted inside the arm shaft and a magnet mounted opposite the Hall element is adopted, which realizes stable operation without impairing the performance of the arm.Equipped with a pure electronic quick stop mechanism that operates in conjunction with a silent lift-up mechanism and stops the turntable instantly.We have adopted a high-density cabinet that effectively controls the shaking of the cabinet due to the anti-energy effect of the rotational moment of the turntable with high inertia and high torque.In addition, by adopting a large insulator with a unique low center of gravity structure, the structure is resistant to external vibration.By using a damping adjustment adapter (sold separately), it is possible to adjust the oil braking at a level of 0 to 5 as in the case of the advanced model PL-70LII and PL-50LII.Includes an S-shaped replacement arm pipe (with large weight) for easy replacement of the head shell.Also, carbon graphite shell integrated straight arm pipe is sold separately.

sections.overview:
PL-50 :   80,000 (around 1980)PL-50L :   85,000 (around 1980)

A record player whose sound quality has been improved by inheriting the technology developed in the high-end PL-70.There were 2 types, the PL-50 of the normal version and the PL-50L with the newly developed moving coil system silent lift-up function.In order to pursue the limit of rotational accuracy, we have adopted an SH rotor type motor in which the rotor support point (bearing) located at the bottom of the motor is moved just below the turntable. By this, we have succeeded in almost matching the position of the center of gravity of the motor with that of the support point.As a result, the reverse conical motion with the lowest part of the motor shaft as a fulcrum, which occurs due to the slight clearance between the motor shaft and bearing, which could not be prevented by the conventional structure in which the position of the center of gravity and the position of the fulcrum were greatly deviated, is eliminated, and excellent rotational characteristics are secured.In addition, a quartz PLL DC servo Hall motor with a starting torque of 1.6kg-cm is used to eliminate load fluctuations caused by resistance received by the needle tip from the recording sound groove, and a 330kg-cm DC servo Hall motor is used to eliminate load fluctuations caused by resistance received by the needle tip from the recording sound groove.2A large turntable with a diameter of 31 cm has been adopted.In the magnetic pole switching mechanism of the motor, three Hall elements developed by Pioneer are used, and other fine parts are finished with micron-order machining accuracy to eliminate minute noise.A special anti-vibration agent has been applied to the back of the turntable to prevent noise that adversely affects sound quality.In order to eliminate low-frequency resonance and achieve high sensitivity at the same time, a silicon oil braking tone arm (capable of on/off operation) is adopted.This is a structure in which a damping fin (ring shape) is submerged in silicon oil injected into the oil cup at the upper part of the arm shaft, and damping is applied. Moreover, by cutting the tip of the fin at 45 degrees, it is designed to simultaneously apply appropriate braking in both horizontal and vertical directions.As a result, the Q (resonance sharpness) of the low-frequency resonance is reduced, and the mechanical impedance of the tone arm is flattened. In addition, the cross-modulation distortion is greatly improved by the synergistic effect of the mass concentration method that brings the main weight of the arm closer to the rotation axis, and clear reproduction sound is realized in the entire audible band.The arm base uses a heavy weight arm base made of die cast with a stabilizer effect, and the arm is firmly fixed to suppress partial resonance.Long type arm with effective length of 250 mm is adopted.A high-density cabinet with a combination of natural wood (Marble Ebony finish) and 4-layered solid board is adopted, which effectively prevents the cabinet from shaking due to the reaction of the rotational moment of the high torque motor.The insulator is equipped with a newly developed low-center-of-gravity structure insulator that provides excellent stability against external vibrations such as howling.By using a damping adjustment adapter sold separately, it becomes a braking level variable arm similar to PL-70, and the braking amount can be adjusted according to the compliance of the cartridge.When mounting a cartridge with heavy weight (Orthophone SPU-GT type, etc.), it is recommended to use an exchange weight (sold separately).The PL-50L is equipped with a silent lift-up mechanism that does not produce mechanical sounds.This is a moving coil system that applies the operation principle of a speaker to the elevation mechanism that moves the arm up and down. It operates without contact with DC voltage.In addition, the end position of the recording sound groove is detected by non-contact detection using a Hall element Hall element and a magnet inside the arm shaft is adopted, so that no side pressure is generated and sensitivity of the arm is not impaired.

A belt drive player that achieves more precise rotation with a brushless DC servo hole motor equipped with a rotational speed control device.The motor is a brushless motor using a Hall element developed by Pioneer.The driving magnetic field of this motor is generated by the current from the transistor circuit that works by switching the Hall element. The magnetic force change to the Hall element is sequentially and regularly performed by a pre-magnetized magnet rotor, and accurate rotation is obtained.The low-speed motor, which rotates at 10 times the speed of the turntable, reduces vibration and improves S/N and durability. In addition, since the power supply system uses a constant voltage circuit, it is not affected by fluctuations in power supply voltage.The DC servo mechanism of the motor consists of a revolution detector and a control circuit.Since a capacitor-type detector generates an AC signal by rotation, a change in the number of revolutions changes directly into a change in the oscillation signal. Since this detector is composed of a substrate attached to the rotor and stator of the motor, even a small rotational deviation changes to the oscillation frequency and controls the drive current to keep the motor rotation constant.33 1/3, 45 rpm speed switching is electronic by switching circuit constant. Therefore, there is no need to replace the conventional belt, so there is no trouble caused by the belt or its switching mechanism.In addition, it has a fine adjustment knob independent of 33 1/3 ? 45 rpm, and the rotation speed can be adjusted within   2%.Uses a polyurethane belt.The tone arm is S-shaped, and sensitivity is improved by using a new support mechanism for the bearing. In addition, the head shell is a lightweight type with hole opening, and in addition to the tracing capability of the tone arm, the tracking capability is greatly improved.The needle pressure can be adjusted easily by simply adjusting the weight with a direct-reading scale after balancing the front and back around the fulcrum.Pioneer's original anti-skating mechanism that applies magnetic repulsion is used to cancel the inside force. The needle pressure scale value shows the anti-skating bias value as it is. Since it is a built-in type built into the body, it does not interfere with operation and has excellent durability.A low-capacity code is used for the output code to reduce attenuation in the ultra-high band.The tone arm is raised and lowered using a hydraulic arm elevation mechanism with smooth operation by button operation.The cartridge is equipped with PC-20, a MM type cartridge.It uses a large insulator and the level can be adjusted.

sections.overview: This record player system is based on the concept of the PL-70 that directly addresses the essence of the player. It uses the latest technology for the tone arm and motor. It also features a silent lift-up function.The arm is made of originally developed carbon graphite with high internal loss and high rigidity. By combining it with the base of high-purity aluminum pipe, it realizes a low-mass, high-rigidity arm that is resistant to resonance. In addition, the arm pipe is of a straight type that is advantageous in weight and provides high strength. In addition, the arm pipe is of a tapered shape that increases in second moment of area as it approaches the center of the arm. Thus, the rigidity is increased while reducing the low-mass. In addition, brass with high Young's modulus is used for the connector at the base of the arm to obtain sufficient strength.The head shell is also made of a lightweight, highly rigid carbon fiber composite material. In addition to the excellent material, the shape is ribbed to increase the strength.Vibration analysis theory is applied to determine the shape of the tone arm. In this method, the entire resonance of the arm is grasped in real time by a computer modal analyzer, the overall balance is controlled, and the vibration characteristics are made flat. In the measurement method, sensors are attached to each part of the tone arm, and the vibration distribution is expanded to about 1000 times the actual vibration displacement by a computer, and it is observed as an animation.It employs a level variable oil braking system that realizes high sensitivity while suppressing harmful low-frequency resonance caused by warping or eccentricity of records.Silicone oil is injected into the oil cup located at the upper part of the arm shaft, and the damping is applied by sinking the ring-shaped braking fin with the tip cut at 45 degrees. Since the amount of braking suitable for both vertical and horizontal directions can be applied at one point, the Q of low-frequency resonance is lowered. By this, the suppression of con-modulation distortion, which makes the reproduced sound muddy, is improved by 9 dB.In addition, the brake oil uses silicon oil, which has less viscosity change with time and temperature. In addition, this silicon oil is stored in a high-precision molded oil cup to prevent oil bleeding and improve reliability.The level adjustment ring of the level variable oil braking system is free when the scale is 0, and the braking amount increases as the scale increases from 1 to 5. This level adjustment ring uses a helicoid type with high precision lapping processing to prevent partial resonance.The tone arm part adopts a mass concentration system in which the main weight is brought closer to the arm shaft and the equivalent mass of the needle tip is reduced. By reducing the moment of inertia of the tone arm, the basic performance before oil accuracy is also improved.It employs a simple contactless end detection system using a Hall element and magnet, and a silent lift-up mechanism using a moving coil drive system arm elevation without any operating noise.In addition, it is equipped with a pure electronic quick stop mechanism in which the arm gently rises when the performance ends and the turntable automatically stops.In principle, the drive motor uses a coreless quartz PLL DC servo motor that does not cause cogging, which is the cause of uneven rotation. This motor uses a flat coil to generate a magnetic field instead of an air-core for the drive coil, thereby eliminating the strength and weakness of a partial magnetic field and preventing cogging.In addition, the SH rotor (Stable Hanging Rotor) system has been adopted in order to improve the bare characteristics before the servo system. This system has a structure in which the rotor support point, which was previously located at the bottom of the motor, is moved just below the turntable. In addition, the lateral pressure applied to the bearing, which is the heart of the rotating system, is reduced to improve the stability of the turntable.The turntable uses a low-pressure casting method that is different from the conventional method. This is a hand-made method in which metal is slowly poured into an extremely precise mold and cooled naturally over a long period of time.
