sections.overview: A full auto player that uses an SH rotor type coreless motor.PL 570 is a full auto player that can perform auto lead in, Oatley turn, auto cut and auto repeat without touching the tone arm.In order to increase the reliability of this full-auto mechanism, the PL 570 is equipped with a microcomputer developed specifically for this purpose. It centrally controls the operation of the tone arm (horizontal and vertical directions) and the rotation, stop, and rotation number switching of the phono motor.In addition, a warning mechanism has been adopted. In the event that the start switch is pressed while the tone arm is fixed to the arm clamp by mistake, the START/STOP lamp flashes to give a warning. Moreover, after a certain period of time, the performance is automatically terminated and the lamp goes off.An SH rotor type coreless motor is used as the drive motor.In the SH-rotor system, the rotor support point, which used to be located at the bottom of the motor, is moved just below the turntable so that the center of gravity of the turntable almost coincides with the support point. This eliminates from the root the reverse cone motion and the rotational slippage caused by the lubricating oil used between the shaft and the bearing. In addition, the bare nature of the motor before the servo was applied is improved, and the rotation of the turntable is stabilized. In addition, parts such as shafts and bearings are also improved in accuracy of micron order or less by utilizing Pioneer's precision processing technology, and reliability and durability are improved.The SH rotor type coreless motor realizes smooth rotational torque without cogging by using a coreless structure in which a driving coil is an empty core and a flat coil is used to generate a magnetic field without using a core. In addition, the diameter of the coil for generating the magnetic field is increased, a thin flat coil is used for the coil, and the power efficiency required for torque generation is improved by using Pioneer's original new IC, and high torque is realized.The servo circuit uses a quartz PLL system that controls the phase difference by comparing the reference signal of the crystal oscillator with the speed detection signal of the motor.In order to improve the accuracy and reliability of the PL 570, a sample-and-hold type high-gain F-V converter, which is highly stable against ripple (erroneous signal), has been developed as a single-chip IC, and is used in the frequency control circuit and phase control circuit.The speed detection mechanism of the motor itself uses an all-round integration method. In this method, the AC signal obtained by the pole magnetized at equal intervals over the whole circumference of the lower surface of the rotor magnet and the print pattern coil with the same number of poles attached opposite to each other is integrated over the whole circumference to improve reliability. In addition, a special large magnet is used, and by doubling the magnetized magnetic pulse from the conventional 200 pole to 400 pole, it is possible to quickly apply servo against load fluctuation, and dynamic load characteristics are greatly improved.We have also adopted a brushless motor pole switching circuit that uses a Hall element developed by Pioneer.A straight arm using carbon graphite is adopted for the tone arm.This arm realizes high rigidity, low mass and no resonance by forming carbon graphite into a straight pipe with high mechanical stability and combining it with aluminum base.Carbon fiber composite material is used for the head shell to increase strength and reduce weight.High-purity oxygen-free copper wires are used in the signal transmission system to improve sound quality.The cartridge is equipped with a high power MC cartridge that can be used in the MM position.This cartridge uses Pioneer's independently developed 6-pole 4-magnet configuration for the left and right sides. Samarium-cobalt magnets with high energy product (BHmax) are placed opposite to each other in the same pole. As a result, a high magnetic flux of up to 10,000 Gauss can be obtained, and power is efficiently generated linearly from small amplitude to large amplitude. In addition, as the left and right sides are independently generated, there is essentially no interference between channels, and excellent separation characteristics are obtained.In this MC cartridge, the magnetic circuit and needle are separated and independent, so the needle exchange can be done as easily as MM type.The cabinet uses a coaxial suspension.In this system, the motor and tone arm are fixed to a single underboard, and the whole underboard is spring supported, preventing harmful resonance and suppressing howling.The operation buttons are all front operation type located on the front panel for improved operability.In addition, the frequently used power, start / stop and elevation buttons are self-illuminated.Equipped with a quick play mechanism that starts rotating the turntable when the tone arm is moved onto the record board, and with a quick stop climate that stops rotating when the tone arm is returned to the arm rest.Since the arm lifter is operated by a dedicated DC motor during manual operation, smooth and highly reliable elevation operation is possible.The exterior is finished in champagne gold.

sections.overview: Linear tracking player equipped with linear DD arm.It is equipped with a linear DD arm that combines the basic performance of the linear tracking system with proprietary technology.While the conventional linear tracking method has advantages such as 0 tracking error, it has a disadvantage that the SN ratio is poor and the playback sound is muddy. This is because the direct driving force of the arm is mechanically obtained from a rotary motor through a gear or belt. The vibration of the motor and the delay in the response speed of the power transmission part cause deterioration in sound quality.In the linear DD arm, a linear DD type motor is used, and electrical energy is directly extracted as linear energy without any mechanical conversion mechanism. This eliminates mechanical contact and eliminates vibration and other problems that cause sound quality degradation.In addition, the combination with an electronic full auto mechanism realizes a quiet and highly accurate arm drive.The cartridge is equipped with an MC cartridge with a new structure developed by Pioneer.This cartridge has a high output of 1.5 mV thanks to its efficient power generation mechanism, so it does not need a dedicated amplifier or head amplifier and can be connected directly to the MM position of the amplifier.In addition, this new structure has been thoroughly simplified, making it easy to replace needles, which was difficult with conventional MC cartridges.An SH rotor type coreless motor is used as the drive motor.By using a coreless motor without cogging and an SH rotor system with improved rotational accuracy, the bare characteristics of the motor are dramatically improved and excellent characteristics are realized.In addition, a quartz PLL is used in the servo circuit to improve stability and load resistance.Carbon graphite, which is lightweight and highly rigid, is used for the arm pipe. Carbon fiber is also used for the head shell, and a low mass tone arm with almost no resonance is realized. In addition, the theory of mass concentration is applied to the arm structure, and excellent traceability is exhibited.Oxygen-free copper wires are used for internal lead wires to improve sound quality.This is the first linear player in this class to be equipped with a universal tone arm, and most commercially available cartridges can be mounted.A high-precision electronic full auto mechanism is adopted, and a newly developed microcomputer controls linear tracking operation and rotation / stop / rotation speed switching of the phono motor.

D. motor using a Hall element.The motor used in the PL 1800 is a brushless type. Three hall elements detect the position of magnetic signals magnetized on the inner surface of the rotor in a contactless manner. Changes in magnetic field due to rotation are reliably converted into changes in current. In addition, since it is a high-torque type with a starting torque of 1kg-cm, start-up time is fast.The servo circuit uses a magnetic pulse detection type.In this system, a magnetic pulse for velocity detection is magnetized on the lower surface of the rotor, and a printed circuit board with a pulse pattern is installed on the lower surface facing the magnetic pulse. sections.overview: An armless player with a brushless DC servo direct drive hole motor.The motor is a direct drive phono motor that uses a Hall element.In place of the brush, which was indispensable for conventional DC motors, we applied the hole stopping method developed by Pioneer to the magnetic field detection of the switching mechanism. This reduces vibration compared with DC motors with mechanical switching mechanism, and improves S/N and durability.In addition, the motor rotates at 33 1/3 ? 45 rpm, which is the same as the number of revolutions of the record. Since the direct drive system directly drives the turntable, there is no intermediate reduction mechanism that causes uneven rotation, and excellent characteristics are obtained.The Hall element is a kind of semiconductor. It is a cross-shaped thin film metal made of N-type Insb alloy. It uses the "Hall effect" in which a voltage is generated between two terminals when an electric current flows through two terminals and a magnetic force is applied at a right angle to the other two terminals to convert magnetism into electricity.Pioneer has developed a new manufacturing method called the vacuum deposition method, and has reduced the thickness from the previous limit of 30-50 ? m to 0.8 ? m, realizing a low-cost and small-size Hall element.Equipped with a DC servo mechanism to control the rotation accurately at all times.In this control circuit, the rotation is automatically controlled by a capacitor-type oscillator that is not affected by changes in the ambient temperature or by the magnetic force of the rotor magnet, thus maintaining a stable rotational speed.Equipped with a brake mechanism that instantly stops the turntable when the power switch is turned off.A purely electronic system is used for changing the rotational speed, and the speed can be finely adjusted within a range of   4% while watching the strobe light carved on the outer circumference of the turntable.The flash lamp is equipped with a flashing switch so that it can be turned off when it is unnecessary.The cabinet is a double-walled 30mm-thick cabinet with a combination of plywood and metal base with a rosewood natural wood wood finish.A large insulator is used to reduce howling and external vibration.In addition, the height can be freely adjusted, and the level can be adjusted while looking at the level of the panel.You can attach any tone arm to the attached panel and use it. If you remove the dust cover, you can use up to 16 type arm.This board is a detachable type that can be easily removed with 6 screws, and you can easily exchange many kinds of arms by using sub panel sold separately.

sections.overview: The development and installation of the Linear D. D> arm solves the problem that had been a bottleneck until now.The Linear D. D. Arm developed by Pioneer Shinkai is mounted in order to move the strong arm base horizontally precisely and quietly. By this, factors that cause harmful noise and vibration are completely eliminated.The Linear D. D. arm is structurally very simple because the magnetic repulsion force generated by electrical energy can be directly converted into linear motion. Unlike conventional systems, the arm base can be directly driven without any transmission mechanism such as a rotary motor, gears, belts, or strings.Record sound In order to ensure that the arm base follows the movement of the needle tip that traces the groove, we have adopted a contactless arm shift detection mechanism that combines a cds and a lamp at the arm mounting part. By adding this detection output to a differential amplifier, we constitute a servo system that supplies the required amount of current.Moreover, since this arm shift detection angle is a small angle of 0.2 degrees, quick correction is possible. Moreover, since the arm shift detection mechanism makes accurate response correction not only in the inner circumferential direction of the record but also in the outer circumferential direction, there is no need to worry about unnecessary lateral pressure on the needle tip even if a record with eccentricity is traced, and high traceability is achieved.In the linear D. D. arm, a two way servo system is activated by the output voltage of the generator linked to the rotary arm feed section to enable smooth arm feed.All you need to do is to lightly touch the arm feed knob and turn it. The arm moves according to the direction and speed of rotation, and the feel of the fingertip becomes the arm action. This allows you to drop the needle from the middle of the middle of the record and start playing freely.The arm feed mechanism is designed to be safe so that it does not work during the performance of the record, so there is no risk of accidentally damaging the needle tip or the record.In addition, by moving the arm left and right by holding the finger of the arm, the arm shift detection mechanism and the two way servo automatically work to move the arm base, making it possible to perform the same operation with the same feeling as manual player.Uses a symmetrical straight arm.Since it is a short type with a short effective length, the inertia mass of the arm is reduced and the equivalent mass is also reduced to improve traceability.The material is a strong aluminum alloy, and since it is not subjected to bending process, the strain inside the pipe is reduced and harmful resonance is suppressed.A dynamic balance method is used for needle pressure application.In addition, it is a universal arm, and various cartridges from all over the world can be attached.A 1.4 kg arm base with sufficient strength is used for the arm base.Arm height adjustment mechanism is adopted, and suitable vertical tracking angle can be obtained according to the cartridge to be used.The SH rotor (Stable Hanging Rotor) system, in which the rotor support point (bearing) is moved just below the turntable, is used for the drive part.As a result, the center of gravity and the position of the supporting point almost coincide with each other, and the fluctuation of the turntable is suppressed.The motor has an inertial mass of 380kg-cm.2It employs a high-torque brushless DC servo motor that drives the turntable at a constant speed within 1/4 rotation (approximately 1 second). It is designed so that the rotational speed does not vary even under the load of approximately 150 tone arms with a needle pressure of 1.5g.High-density conifer particleboard with howling protection is used for the cabinet, and a large insulator with height adjustable up to 6 mm is used for the insulator.It uses an electronic arm elevation mechanism that uses a dedicated DC motor, allowing the arm to move up and down smoothly.In addition, it is equipped with an electronic auto-up mechanism that lifts the arm from the board immediately after the end of the recording performance, and the turntable stops as soon as the arm auto-up.No extra lateral pressure is applied to the needle tip as it is non-contact type.High-conductivity oxygen-free copper wires are used for all cables for signal transmission systems.The output jacks and terminal pins are gold-plated.It is equipped with 5 mm thick acrylic cover.It comes with a 7.7x7.7 high precision large level that can level the cabinet.

sections.overview:
Armless player that adopts quartz PLL system.Universal type arm mounting board is adopted, and domestic and overseas tone arms except for 16 inch long arm can be used.The mounting board uses laminated plywood with a metallic finish for easy drilling.The turntable uses a direct drive system, and the motor shaft directly drives the turntable without passing through a transmission mechanism.A high-torque brushless DC servo hole motor is used hole motor.The magnetic pole switching (switching circuit), which greatly influences the performance of the DD motor itself, adopts a brushless type using three Hall elements developed by Pioneer's original manufacturing method, and realizes high S/N and reliability.The XLC 1850 uses a quartz PLL system for the servo circuit with high detection accuracy. By comparing the output pulse of the generator attached to the rotating shaft of the motor with the pulse of the reference signal using a crystal, not only the frequency difference between the two is detected, but also the phase difference (time difference between lead and lag) is detected and the rotation speed is controlled. This enables accurate detection of long and weak speed changes that were considered difficult to detect with conventional methods, and always maintains the correct rotation speed.In place of the conventional strobe, a direct-reading pitch indicator is used to indicate the rotational speed during fine adjustment of speed.Since the deviation from the exact number of revolutions can be read directly in numerical values, it is easy to compare and play records at the same pitch and to confirm when the pitch of a record matches the pitch of an instrument.When the Quartz Lock is ON, this indicator is synchronized with the correct rotation speed with the word "Quartz" lit. When the brake is applied by an external force, the lamp goes out. When the Quartz Lock is OFF, the memory of the pitch indicator lights. The rotation speed of the turntable is measured by a combination of a Schmidt circuit and an integrating circuit for driving the meter, and the rotation speed can be displayed in analog form.The volume for fine adjustment has a special resistance curve so that it can turn in the same sense as the indicated angle of the meter at the time of adjustment, taking usability into consideration.Equipped with quick stop mechanism for electronic devices.In this system, when the stop button is pressed, the control circuit switches to generate torque to rotate the motor in the opposite direction and applies the brake rapidly. When the rotation is almost stopped, the power is turned off and the turntable stops.This drive circuit responds quickly when the motor speed is increased by electronic braking, and when the speed is changed from 45 rpm to 33 1/3rpm, servo is also activated and constant speed rotation is achieved immediately.By integrating the control circuit and drive circuit into an IC, unstable elements that cause performance degradation are eliminated.A bipolar IC is used for the drive circuit and a MOS IC is used for the control circuit.The cabinet is made of aluminum die cast with a thickness of 4 mm and a weight of 4.7 kg, and has a structure to prevent howling by analyzing resonance mode.The cabinet has a box structure with 24 ribs around it. In addition, a new material with low Q (low resonance) is used for the bottom cover. In addition, an insulator made of a combination of special rubber and die-cast solid is directly attached to the cabinet body howling margin by 3 db.A cut-core transformer is used for the power supply.The cut-core transformer has low leakage flux and excellent regulation. By floating mounting the transformer on the cabinet board, the effect of noise on sound quality is suppressed.A push type is used for the operation part.Concentrated layout on a single die-cast panel enables one touch operation.A removable transparent acrylic dust cover is used for the dust cover.Comes with one touch universal arm rest.Installation is one touch type and can be installed in any position by adhesive tape at the bottom.

1. Magnetic pulse detection type frequency generatorA magnetic pulse is magnetized on the lower surface of the rotor magnet (rotor magnet), and an AC signal (voltage) corresponding to the rotational speed of the motor is taken out by the speed detection board attached facing the pulse.2/3. Phase comparator, frequency comparatorThe AC signal obtained from the generator is amplified, passed through a waveform shaping, synthesis and multiplication circuit, and compared with the reference signal passed through a speed switching / dividing circuit. The control voltage corresponding to the phase difference is detected and converted into a DC signal, which is then combined with the output of the comparator and sent to the control circuit. This ensures phase lock and ensures accurate servocontrol. The comparator is also in parallel with the phase comparator to improve the transient characteristics of the motor and other characteristics of the PLL loop.4. Bidirectional discrimination circuit and comparison control circuitIt detects the magnitude of the combined output of each signal and the direction of the control output (acceleration / deceleration), amplifies the control signal accurately and quickly, and transmits it to the bidirectional drive circuit.5. Bi-directional drive circuitThe current is supplied to the motor according to the control signal applied by the control circuit and the position signal synthesis circuit. In this case, the control torque acts in both directions of acceleration and deceleration. Therefore, the motor has excellent responsiveness such as transient response to changes in motor speed due to disturbance and switching time for rotational speed.6/7. Position detection unit and position signal synthesis circuitThree Hall elements are arranged inside the motor with an electrical phase angle of 120  . These Hall elements generate signal voltages sequentially by the rotation of the motor and are synthesized into predetermined signals by the position signal synthesis circuit to switch the transistors of the bidirectional driving circuit (winding current switching operation).8. Reverse rotation prevention circuitAlthough this circuit is not related to normal operation, it functions as a protective circuit to ensure normal operation even if it is forcibly rotated backward by hand.9. Crystal oscillatorIt generates a reference signal that controls the number of revolutions of the phono motor. It uses a crystal resonator that is less affected by temperature and humidity and less subject to aging. It compensates for minute frequency differences precisely with a trimmer capacitor, making it a highly stable and accurate circuit.10. Frequency Divider CircuitThe crystal oscillator uses a higher frequency (3,072 MHz) than is actually used in consideration of more stable operation and rationality, and is divided to 6 kHz.11. Speed variable sub oscillatorIf you want to change the pitch of the playback section, you need to change the reference frequency. When the quartz lock is off, the motor rotation is synchronized with the frequency of this circuit.12. Rotation Speed Detection CircuitThe rotational speed comparison signal obtained by the frequency generator is inverted by a circuit with high input impedance so as not to affect the signal of the motor. After the level adjustment, it is converted into a DC signal by a low-pass filter and sent to the meter drive circuit.13. Meter drive circuit (operates only when lock is OFF)A differential amplifier consisting of two operational amplifiers compares the level of the DC signal obtained by the rotation speed detection circuit and drives the meter.14. Lock determination circuit (operates only when quartz lock is ON)The output of the differential amplifier in the meter drive circuit is passed through a circuit that performs an analog OR operation to determine whether the instrument is locked.15. Start-stop, flip-flop circuitWhen the Start / Stop button is pressed, the flip-flop circuit changes to 2 states (H/L) and issues an instruction to the AND circuit as well as ON-OFF of each oscillator. The flip-flop circuit is always set to the STOP state when the power supply is only ON.16. Stop Detection CircuitThe rotational speed comparison signal obtained by the frequency generator of the motor is input to the Schmidt circuit to detect the rotational stop.17. AND CircuitThe AND circuit turns off the power supply circuit only when the flip-flop circuit is in the stop state and the stop detection circuit is output.

? When the power switch is turned ON, the flip-flop circuit is always set to the STOP side, so the meter will light but the motor will not turn.? When the start button is pressed, the flip-flop circuit inverts, the AND circuit works, the power is turned on, and the motor rotates.? When the stop button is pressed, the flip-flop circuit is inverted again, and a stop instruction is issued to the AND circuit and the reference oscillation frequency is stopped. Since the reference frequency becomes 0 Hz, the signal is sent to the bidirectional driving circuit so that the reverse torque is generated by the control circuit and the control direction indicating circuit, and the frequency of the frequency generator is lowered.? When this frequency becomes almost 0 Hz, the AND circuit operates according to the stop detection instruction, the motor power supply is turned off, and the rotation stops completely.

Schmitt trigger circuitThe level of the AC waveform that is proportional to the number of revolutions of the motor from the frequency generator is adjusted to a certain height so that when frequency-voltage exchange is performed by the integrator circuit, a voltage that is accurately proportional to the frequency is output.Integrating circuitThis is an F-V (frequency-voltage) converter that converts AC voltage with a frequency proportional to the number of revolutions of the motor into DC voltage proportional to the number of revolutions of the motor.Differential amplifier circuitThe DC voltage, which is proportional to the number of revolutions of the motor and is exchanged by the integrator circuit, is compared with the reference voltage by this circuit. If the voltages A and B in the figure are equal, the motor is at the specified number of revolutions, the voltage to the meter is 0, and the meter shows a center speed deviation of 0. If the number of revolutions of the motor is higher than the specified number of revolutions, the voltage of A is higher than B, the voltage of A-B is amplified by a differential amplifier circuit, a + voltage is added to the meter, and the meter shows a + direction, and vice versa if the number of revolutions of the motor is lower than the specified number of revolutions.

sections.overview: A full auto player with a quartz PLL servo circuit.Quartz PLL is used for the servo circuit.In this method, the motor rotation speed is kept constant by comparing the pulses from the ??????? mounted on the motor rotation shaft with the pulses from the reference signal generator and detecting the phase difference (time difference between lead and delay). This enables accurate detection of minute speed changes with long periods, which were considered difficult to detect with conventional methods, and maintains the correct rotation speed at all times. In the quartz PLL method, a crystal is used as the oscillator of the reference signal generator, and a high-precision reference signal is obtained.The XL-A700 uses an IC circuit to increase the reliability of the circuit itself. Bipolar ICs are used for the drive circuit and MOS ICs are used for the control circuit.A bi-directional drive circuit is adopted for the drive circuit, and it can operate in both forward and reverse directions, so quick response is possible even when the motor speed increases.A brushless DC servo hole motor is used as the drive motor.This motor has high S/N and high durability by applying the functions of three Hall elements developed by Pioneer in the magnetic pole switching process.The turntable has a diameter of 32.4 cm and an inertial mass of 340kg-cm.2Precision machining turntable has been adopted.In addition, excellent characteristics have been obtained by using precision processed shafts and bearings.The strobe light is equipped with a waveform shaping circuit. In this circuit, the oscillation frequency (3 MHz band) of the crystal oscillator is divided by an electronic circuit to light it. This circuit eliminates the adverse effect of fluctuations in the power supply frequency. In addition, when the number of revolutions is switched, the frequency division ratio is changed to enable adjustment in one stripe pattern.The servo circuit also contains a highly accurate CR oscillator, enabling phase control even when quartz is turned off.You can also compare records at the same pitch and adjust the pitch of the records to match the pitch of the instrument. When the rotational speed is finely adjusted by 1%, 5.5 stripes flow at 33 1/3rpm and 7.5 stripes flow at 45 rpm in 10 seconds. Since the rotational speed fine adjustment range is   6%, it can be adjusted up to about a semitone.Equipped with a full auto mechanism.In addition to the motor for driving the turntable, the XL-A700 uses a precision gear motor exclusively for the automatic operation of the arm, so that no load is applied to the rotating system and high reliability and durability are obtained.The full auto mechanism allows for auto return, auto cut and repeat performance. It also has a quick play function that automatically turns on when the arm is moved onto the record board by hand.The return detection mechanism of the XL-A700 uses an optical system instead of the conventional mechanical system.The XL-A700 uses an LED to illuminate the overlapping position of the movable slit, and uses a phototransistor to detect light transmission and light shielding. The XL-A 200 uses a phototransistor to detect the position of the arm.S-shaped pipe arm is used for the tone arm.In addition to reducing the effective mass of this arm, an angular contact bearing is used for the vertical and horizontal rotating parts to reduce friction and obtain high sensitivity. In addition, a 6t aluminum panel with sufficient strength is used for the mounting base of the arm, and the inside of the cabinet is reinforced with thick steel plate (6 mm thick, 700g) to protect the tone arm from howling.MM type cartridge PC 330 / II is used.This cartridge realizes a light mass vibration system by combining a special heat-treated titanium pipe cantilever, rare-earth cobalt magnet, and special diamond needle. In addition, by adopting a single-end support system, high-frequency mechanical impedance can be kept low, improving sound quality.In addition, parts such as aluminum stylus knob and aluminum die-cast frame are used to reduce resonance.In the cabinet, the motor body, full-auto mechanism, tone arm, etc. are firmly fixed to a highly rigid aluminum die-cast frame to obtain high accuracy over a long period of time.By combining the rigidity of the die-cast frame with a hard plywood with moderate internal loss, howling and resonance are prevented.Uses a large insulator combining special rubber and die-cast solid.The level of this insulator can be adjusted (0.5 mm variable per one revolution of the insulator).Equipped with anti-skating mechanism and arm elevation mechanism.

sections.title: PIONEER-EXCLUSIVE S5
sections.overview: A speaker system that uses a unit that inherits the design philosophy of Technical Aucio Devices (TAD) and adopts a vertical twin system as a system that draws out the potential of this unit.The S5 uses a vertical twin system with a horn at the center and a woofer at the top and bottom.In this system, the acoustic energy of the two woofers is concentrated in the center and coincides with the horn axis, so that the range from low to high frequencies becomes a virtual co-axis centered on the horn, improving the sense of sound localization.In addition, it has excellent horizontal directivity, and the quick response of the woofer gives a crisp low sound.Two newly developed 25 cm cone type woofers are installed in the lower range.By combining a magnetic circuit using an alnico magnet with a lightweight vibration system, we have ensured linearity that does not lose balance from low volume to high input. In addition, by thoroughly increasing the initial motion sensitivity of the vibration support system, we have improved the balance at low volume, which was considered difficult in the past.In addition, by combining a special aging cone and a vibration system with good linearity, it is designed to resist changes over time.A horn type tweeter combining a driver unit and a wooden horn is mounted in the high range.The driver unit uses a powerful alnico magnetic circuit with a magnetic flux density of 18,000 gauss and a lightweight, high-hardness beryllium diaphragm with a diameter of 4.8 cm.The horn uses a newly developed wood horn to bring out the wide-band characteristics of the driver unit. It is made of Painted maple with excellent sound quality and is finished by hand. It solves the problems of high sensitivity and directional control in the wide band.The connection between the network and the unit is directly connected by crimping without using terminals. In particular, the Woofer unit is crimped even to the Kinshi line without using solder. Furthermore, the dedicated circuit is used for each woofer to prevent back-electromotive force interference between the woofers.In addition, oxygen-free copper wires are used for the choke coil and wire cord, and vibration countermeasures are applied to each material and cord to control resonance and noise. In addition, the wiring is also taken into consideration so that crosstalk between elements and wire cords does not adversely affect the wiring. The input to the network is directly and uniformly transmitted by radial power supply system.Particular attention has been paid to the material of the enclosure as well. The top plate and baffle plate upper part are made of Birds Eye Maple (maple), the other parts are made of walnut, and oil stain finish is applied.The structure is a tall boy type floor type. The baffle plate has an elliptic curve round baffle with a large arc to reduce sound reflection and diffraction phenomena.In addition, in order to prevent the vibration of each unit from interfering with each other by the baffle and making the sound muddy, all units are firmly fixed by the midship mount. In addition, a shield frame and a floating top are provided to eliminate resonance.The speaker terminal supports a bi-wired connection that separates the high-frequency and low-frequency circuits for independent power supply, and is equipped with a short bar so that it can be used as a single speaker terminal.The emblem is made of natural precious wood with laser processing.

sections.overview: A pre-main amplifier developed with new elements and new circuits to realize the "Magniwide power range" concept of full power reproduction at low distortion rate over an ultra-wide band.The A-0012 uses a group transistor RET with superior high-frequency switching characteristics. This device is made by combining hundreds of small transistors with superior high-frequency characteristics in parallel. It has high breakdown strength and can produce high output at high frequencies with low distortion.In addition, a DC amplifier configuration has been adopted to improve the low-frequency characteristics, extending the frequency characteristics to the ultra-low frequency range and improving the phase characteristics in the mid-low frequency range.The power supply consists of a large left and right independent transformer with an emphasis on dynamic characteristics and a 18,000 ? Fx4 capacitor.In addition, the power section through which a large current flows and the speaker terminals are wired on extremely thick Line 14 with a resistance value that is 1/4 of the conventional thick line. In addition, pure copper is used for the ground line of the power capacitor, and at the same time, the copper foil on the printed circuit board of each circuit is doubled to 70 ? thick, making for a thorough low-impedance design.It uses class AB operation and operates up to 3W, which accounts for most of the music signal, at class A, which has an established reputation for sound quality, with essentially no switching distortion or crossover distortion.In addition, since the power utilization factor is high efficiency close to that of general class B amplifiers, it is possible to obtain a dynamic range of up to 120W during peak playback.It has a 4 dc configuration consisting of an MC head amplifier, an equalizer amplifier, a flat amplifier, and a power amplifier. If a buffer amplifier is included, it can be called a 5 dc amplifier.Since all amplification stages are DC, there is no capacitor that causes phase distortion in the NFB loop of the amplifier circuit, and it has flat phase characteristics over a wide band and stable operation. It also improves transient response characteristics including the damping of back electromotive force from the speaker.In the equalizer amplifier section, a low-noise dual FET with excellent noise characteristics is used in the first stage differential section.In the dual FET, the entire element has a high SN ratio, and at the same time, a higher SN ratio is obtained by suppressing the voltage between the drain and gate of the FET by cascade connection to prevent generation of noise.The whole MC head amplifier section is divided into two systems. The first stage parallel connection symmetrical 3-stage direct-coupled A-class SEPP-DC amplifier is composed of two newly developed low-noise NPN and PNP transistors connected in parallel. It is designed to improve linearity when NFB is not applied by focusing on bare characteristics.In addition, the SN ratio is improved by adopting symmetrical circuit configuration.All stages of the flat amplifier section are DC to improve sound quality.In addition, a flat amplifier and bypass switch are installed in order to pursue higher purity playback sound. By jumping from a flat amplifier, a buffer amplifier and a power amplifier can be connected directly.Equipped with a change-over switch that can independently select 5 types of load resistance and 5 types of load capacity and can set a total of 25 types of cartridge load.In addition to the main control of the standard bass / treble, it is equipped with a twin-tone control with an ultra-low and ultra-high range control knob as a sub-control.It is also equipped with a tone ON-OFF switch that can obtain flat characteristics by bypassing the tone control circuit.Equipped with a subsonic filter that allows slope switching.The volume uses a continuously variable precision volume of decibel display with excellent corrosion resistance gold-plated sliding elements and terminals.The Phono terminal is gold-plated.Equipped with audio muting.A dedicated parent-child contact relay for each of speakers A and B is used for the protection circuit.Equipped with split switches for pre-part and power part, can be used separately.

sections.overview: This pre-main amplifier was developed based on the concept of wide range technology that expresses the nuance of music by focusing on sound quality outside the audible band.It is equipped with a newly developed wide-range circuit for stable amplification of input signals from digital devices.This is a simple circuit that uses a single-stage amplifier circuit to obtain the required gain. It has excellent current linearity and flat output impedance from low to high range.This allows for accurate reproduction and a spacious speaker drive over a wide bandwidth.In order to enhance the power supply capability, we have adopted a large power transformer in the power supply section to suppress the deterioration of sound quality caused by the leakage flux generated by the transformer.In order to prevent the generation of sound nigori due to the mutual interference of each circuit, the power supply section and power amplifier section are shielded, and the adjacent power amplifier section and voltage amplifier section are shielded and separated by a newly developed Aero heat sink. In addition, heat inside the amplifier, which generates a large amount of heat, is radiated effectively, and uniform temperature is realized.The volume uses a 40 mm square large unit to eliminate gang errors.In addition, a copper volume stabilizer is used through a copper volume stabilizer to prevent vibration from being transmitted to the volume.A computer simulation is also performed on one of the screw stops to select a position that is less susceptible to vibration, and copper plating is used for the screw, which is effective in absorbing vibration.A high-rigidity honeycomb structure has been adopted for the insulator to increase the vibration absorption rate, and an insulator is also attached directly under the heavy transformer to balance the dead weight.By attaching a cushion to the contact part and housing side of the insulator, the transmission of vibration is suppressed.The Phono equalizer uses a single-chip dual-FET input configuration.It features thick oxygen-free copper power cords with polarity indication, gold-plated I/O pin jacks, a vise speaker terminal, and well-designed resistors and capacitors.

sections.overview: This is a pre-main amplifier that inherits the technology of high-end machines.The chassis layout has a symmetrical twin monaural structure.In addition to the symmetrical layout of the internal circuit and structure represented by the twin transformer, the A-05 has a fully symmetrical structure including the front panel, rear panel, and volume, so that the environment such as current, magnetic field, temperature distribution, and mechanical stress distribution can be made uniform. This minimizes the characteristic error of L/R caused by parts.In addition, all compromises have been made to simplify the circuit, and the signal path has been straightened to achieve higher quality playback.Wide-range linear circuit ver. 5 is adopted to improve the time axis characteristics of the transmission system.Conventional amplifier circuits are equipped with choke coils for the speaker output terminals, capacitors for each input terminal, and phase compensation capacitors to ensure stability against high frequencies. However, these parts prevent the simplification of the circuit and the amplification of pure sound. The choke coil adversely affects the output impedance in the high frequency range, and the phase compensation capacitor adversely affects the sound quality.In order to solve this problem, the wide-range linear circuit is designed to obtain the necessary gain by one stage amplification using a current feedback circuit, and the damping factor is made flat over a wide range to obtain excellent speaker drive power.Dedicated tuning parts such as custom-designed volume and original organic semiconductor condenser are adopted.The power transformer uses a toroidal transformer with an oriented core.The core section without corners suppresses the generation of beat and improves the S/N feeling.It is equipped with a gain selector to cut off the excess gain and increase the purity of the sound when playing at a small volume.There are two selector positions, 40 dB and 26 dB. The 40 dB position gives you more power, and the 26 dB position gives you more natural music playback.The phono equalizer uses a single-chip dual FET as its input circuit.An OFC power cord is used for the power cable, and external noise is eliminated by drawing the power cord from directly under the power transformer.Uses gold-plated input / output terminals.A large vise type speaker terminal with low transmission loss is adopted.

sections.overview: Stereo pre-main amplifier with symmetrical twin monaural structure.In order to obtain realistic and rich stereo images, the A-07 has a symmetrical structure that includes CFCs, rear panels and volume in addition to the symmetrical layout of the internal circuit as represented by the twin transformer. This makes the environment such as current, magnetic field, temperature distribution, and mechanical stress distribution uniform, and minimizes left and right characteristic errors caused by parts.The A-07 is equipped with a wide-range linear circuit that obtains the required gain by one stage amplification using a current feedback circuit. This circuit flattens the damping factor over a wide range and realizes a reliable speaker drive. In addition, the stability of the circuit itself is enhanced by the adoption of a cross-array power stage, a newly developed output stage with excellent power linearity and temperature stability.As a result, superior high-frequency characteristics have been obtained, phase characteristics have been dramatically improved, and characteristics that are resistant to high-frequency noise have been realized.Uses carefully selected high-reliability parts.In addition to the custom-made polypropylene film condenser with thorough tuning of sound quality, we have adopted winding resistance, mold resistance and sealed relays that ensure stability regardless of the operating environment to achieve high accuracy and reliability.In addition, we have adopted a high-precision attenuator volume that is not easily affected by minute vibrations, enabling accurate and stable control by reducing left-right interlocking errors.Each block is separated by a frame in which each block is separated by a frame. Mutual interference between blocks is eliminated by shielding the amplifier, power supply and control.The rear panel has pin jacks arranged radially around the ground, which is the operation standard of the amplifier, to improve electrical stability. In addition, an aero-wing heat sink with excellent heat dissipation and vibration damping characteristics is adopted. The high heat transfer effect equalizes the temperature of the power transistor, while eliminating parallel planes in the structure itself to suppress standing waves and resonances that cause noise turbidity.Advanced Direct Construction is used to keep the signal path as simple as possible.In this method, the signal selected by the signal switching relay immediately after the input terminal is input to a single board connected to the volume and the amplifier circuit by the shortest length, thereby further shortening the signal path and improving electrical stability.It is equipped with a gain selector.This is a function to switch the gain of the amplifier to make the most of the output of the connected source device. When listening at a low volume or using a high-efficiency speaker, the S/N ratio can be improved by setting it to the 26 dB position, enabling fine volume control.An insulated circuit is adopted in which the electric circuit, control circuit and power supply section of both left and right channels are electrically independent. This circuit uses a photocoupler to eliminate interference caused by current loops between circuits.The Phono equalizer uses a single-chip dual-FET input configuration.Uses highly reliable gold-plated input terminal.The power cable is drawn from directly under the power transformer to reduce the influence of external noise, and large-capacity extra-thick OFC cable is used for wire material.A large vise type speaker terminal is adopted.

sections.title: PIONEER-EXCLUSIVE Pioneer
sections.overview: Pioneer engineers have kept the idea of "If we can express our will to the maximum in the fixed condition of pre-main amplifier" warm for 6 years. It uses simple circuit design for "straight sound". In addition, it is the highest quality pre-main amplifier which was born by incorporating all the technologies such as Exclusive C7 philosophy and technology.Symmetrical twin monaural structure is adopted.A shield box with a large current circuit power block on the left and right sides and a small signal input block in the rear center is placed around the central power supply section. The symmetrical structure with independent left and right channel circuits provides excellent separation.In addition to the length of the left and right signal paths and the configuration of parts, the temperature, magnetic field distribution, and vibration environment inside the main body that affect the operation of elements and circuits are made uniform, and the occurrence of left and right electrical and mechanical characteristic errors is suppressed.A pre-power isolated structure has been adopted to achieve the purpose of a separate amplifier, in which circuits with different roles of voltage amplification and current amplification operate properly, while maintaining the advantages of a pre-main amplifier, in which excellent balance and compactness can be obtained by connecting two amplifiers directly.The preamp circuit (from the input terminal to the voltage amplification stage) including the volume is shielded by a non-magnetic aluminum box. Moreover, this box is supported by a chassis through vibration control rubber. It adopts a floating structure. The power supply section is also separated from the rectifier circuit by making the pre-section and the power section independent of each other. This realizes complete separation.As a result, delicate input signals are isolated electrically and physically so as not to cause deterioration of sound quality due to circuit interference from the power section, fluctuation of the power section and vibration of the power section. This structure can be called a separate amplifier in a set.It is equipped with advanced direct construction which is a further development of direct construction which makes the signal path as short as possible.The signal switching relay and volume unit are controlled from the front panel right after the input terminal. The input block is located at the rear. In addition, the 16 power transistors of the power block are also located at the rear so that the shortest length is realized.The signal is routed directly from the input block to the power amplifier and processed at once at the rear of the amplifier. As a result, the paths between pre-power and power speaker terminals, which tend to be noise sources, are greatly shortened.In the input circuit, a signal switching relay is placed immediately after the input terminal to greatly improve crosstalk between each source. In addition, the buffer amplifier mounted on the same substrate as the relay drives low impedance, thereby realizing excellent channel separation by reducing impedance of the circuit.The power amplifier section is operated in pure class A operation. By expanding the exclusive super linear circuit developed by Pioneer to the final stage of large current, the low distortion of 0.05% is achieved despite the final stage non-feedback configuration, and the high damping factor of 200 is also achieved.The newly developed high-precision, integrally molded silent chassis is used for the chassis.Through in-depth research, we have developed a special resin material that is resistant to changes over time and has excellent anti-torsional and anti-shock properties. It supports the main body securely and at the same time, it has a shape that matches each block and efficiently disperses and absorbs internal and external vibrations.Since it is non-magnetic, electromagnetic induction noise and magnetic distortion are greatly suppressed.The power supply section uses a stack type electrolytic capacitor with low flux noise developed like a pure A-class amplifier, and a power transformer with low magnetic flux density, sufficient capacity, and excellent regulation characteristics to keep flux noise low.The volume uses a hand-made attenuator type with the same basic structure as the one used for Exclusive C7.Each step consists of carefully selected carbon resistance and high-precision contact points. Unlike conventional sliding resistance devices, which change the sound volume, it is less affected by temperature and humidity. It eliminates the sound quality change due to contact resistance and the level difference between left and right, enabling stable control.In order to maintain the design with the highest priority on sound quality, the attached functions such as tone control, balance, and loudness are omitted, and the speaker output is also single-system. This reduces the subtle influence of circuits and switches, and minimizes the effect of wiring steps and signal paths.In addition, the earth side of each input source is also switched simultaneously, and a separate earth design is adopted to eliminate signal interference between connected devices from the earth side.The Phono equalizer has a single-chip dual FET input configuration.One balanced input is mounted on the input terminal, and highly reliable gold-plated terminals are used for all terminals.The speaker terminal is a large vise type.It uses a large-capacity extra-thick type OFC power cord that suppresses the influence of external noise by drawing it from directly under the power transformer.It uses a high-grade type pure aluminum machined rotary knob and carefully selected resistors and capacitors.The concentrated arrangement of power transistors separates the part that absorbs the generated heat from the part that effectively diffuses it, and adopts a new heat radiation structure that takes into consideration the position and shape of the heat sink and the air flow path.The aluminum heat sink uses a new type that reduces resonance by changing the length of the fin.

sections.overview: This is a pre-main amplifier that focuses on the operability that allows you to enjoy music while focusing on sound quality.In the amplifier with remote control, distortion is generated by the semiconductor switch used. In order to eliminate this, a motor-driven rotary switch is adopted for the function switching. In addition, in order to suppress the deterioration of sound quality caused by the microcomputer for remote control, the transformer and power supply are separated for the microcomputer, and even the board is dedicated for the microcomputer. This prevents the control signal of the remote control from flowing into the audio part and suppresses noise generation.In addition, the operation of the microcomputer is stopped when the remote point is greatly improved.In addition, in order to prevent degradation of sound quality due to jitter (fluctuation of the clock edge), a PLL with an extremely high jitter suppression effect is adopted for the PLL that generates the clock, and the oscillation circuit is bonded with special resin in order to avoid the effect of vibration.When the D/A converter operates, only one master clock system is used, and the generation of unnecessary beat components is suppressed by eliminating other asynchronous clocks (such as microcomputer clocks).The digital filter over-samples by a factor of four to push unwanted high-frequency components into higher bands and eliminate aliasing noise.The digital filter uses a high-performance IC to achieve an in-band ripple within   0.0001 dB and an attenuation error of 100 dB.The low-pass filter consists of a 5th-order Butterworth low-pass filter with excellent phase characteristics, which is composed of FDNR discrete circuits to reduce phase distortion as well as smooth characteristics.We are also working to improve sound quality by using high-quality parts and grounding with oxygen-free copper bus bars.Equipped with a digital recording selector that demodulation, PLL, and digital filter are separated from analog sections such as D/A converter and analog low-pass filter by a separate board, and the digital section is shielded.In addition, by separating the power supply for the digital circuit and microcomputer from the power supply for the analog system from the transformer, we prevent interference with the analog system, which causes sections.overview: This pre-main amplifier was developed with the theme of high quality and dynamic range of the amplifier itself.By adopting dynamic power supply system and non-switching circuit, the concept of real dynamism is reflected in the overall to realize high power with high quality.A dynamic power supply system is used for the power supply part in order to cope with a wide dynamic range of the source and to make the speaker sound as much as possible even at large input.In this system, low voltage section (VL) and high voltage section (VHThe power supply circuit drives only the low-voltage part at the normal signal level and drives only the high-voltage part at the time of Tsutomu Dainyu. This greatly reduces the loss at the output-stage and enables high power.In addition, the high voltage section always follows the signal waveform with a constant voltage value, so that no waveform loss occurs.In addition, when a large signal repeatedly enters over a wide area, the high-voltage section remains locked as long as the signal continues. This design prevents waveform loss due to delay.The transformer employs a large toroidal transformer characterized by low flux leakage and high regulation. Eight electrolytic capacitors are installed for a total capacitance of 176,000 ? F. We have achieved a low impedance. In addition, we use non-magnetic parts such as copper lead wires and oxygen-free copper wires in the power supply to eliminate harmful magnetic distortion.The power section is equipped with an established non-switching circuit that realizes 0 switching distortion.Pioneer's proprietary high-speed bias servo circuit controls the bias current according to the input signal to keep the transistor in operation at all times. As a result, music contamination caused by switching distortion is fundamentally suppressed.An FET buffer circuit is adopted between the voltage and power amplifiers to completely separate the voltage and power amplifiers, greatly improving the bare characteristics before applying NFB.The input impedance of the FET is close to infinity, and even if the power amplifier receives load impedance fluctuations due to its nature, the effects do not appear on the input side. Moreover, the operation of the voltage amplifier is stable and the power amplifier can be driven with low output impedance (constant voltage drive). Therefore, the generation of distortion due to the nonlinearity of the power amplifier is suppressed, the effect of reaction signal from the speaker is eliminated, and the distortion factor of the power unit is further reduced.The MC head amplifier has a push-pull configuration from the input to the output. In addition, the input is parallel push-pull with ultra-low-noise FET. The feedback point of the DC servo is not the first stage but the second stage bias power supply so that the servo circuit does not affect the SN ratio.As a result, the S / N ratio is 74 dB, which is close to the theoretical limit of 76 dB due to the thermal noise of transistors in this circuit system.DC servo circuits are used for each of the MC head amplifier, equalizer amplifier, and power amplifier.As a result, all coupling capacitors from the MC input to the speaker output have been removed, and all stages have been switched to non-coupling capacitors. This eliminates the need to worry about the coloring of sound caused by capacitors, and realizes high-resolution sound quality.It is equipped with a line straight switch which can obtain high quality sound by directly connecting an equalizer amplifier and a power amplifier.Passes tone controls, modes, and balance volumes to simplify the signal path.Non-magnetic parts are used to suppress the magnetic distortion that adversely affects the sound quality and to obtain more pure sound quality.Copper lead wires are used for all semiconductors used in each amplifier stage, and copper is also used for lead wires and caps for main resistors such as emitter resistors.We also use copper-based lead wires for main capacitors and oxygen-free copper wires for main wiring materials.The chassis is plated with copper and has an H-shaped structure to prevent frame noise.In addition, the Lch and Rch of the power amplifier are independent, the large signal system and small signal system are separated, and the equalizer amplifier and MC head amplifier are all structurally cut off to prevent mutual interference.An extremely thick power cord with double insulation structure is used for the power cord.We also pay attention to the fact that sound changes depending on the polarity of the AC line, and thoroughly control the winding method of the transformer and the polarity of the power cord.

sections.overview: Pre-main amplifier with non-switching amplifier.In the non-switching amplifier, the bias value of the final stage is changed according to the input signal, and the transistor is not switched, so that a sufficient power can be obtained.Equipped with a line straight-through switch, it can pass a tone circuit, a loudness switch, a balance volume switch, and a mode switch. When the switch is on, the Bass, Treble, Loudness, Balance, and Mode indicators turn off to confirm that the circuit has passed.The DC servo circuits of the equalizer amplifier and power amplifier respectively cut out the unwanted ultra-low frequency components (power amplifier 1 Hz or less, equalizer 0.2 Hz or less). This eliminates the need for a coupling capacitor and enables sound quality with less coloring.A direct power supply system is adopted in which each power supply is incorporated into a power amplifier board and an equalizer amplifier board. This reduces cord routing and greatly reduces impedance, while reducing interference between large signal circuits and small signal circuits.The circuit configuration of the power supply uses inverted Darlington to obtain low impedance characteristics over a wide range. In addition, a thick copper plate is used to connect the ground from the MC circuit board to the tone amplifier board to further reduce impedance.Capacitors and resistors that affect sound quality are made non-magnetic, and copper lead resistors are used for the emitter resistor of the power transistor, and copper terminal low-impedance type is used for the volume.In addition, an electrolytic capacitor for audio is used for the capacitor to suppress the inductance component and eliminate the non-linear impedance to the current change.The MC head amplifier has a 3-stage direct-coupled DC configuration with a low-noise transistor in the first stage, and high gain (28 db) and low distortion factor are achieved by improving the circuit configuration.In addition, in order to bring out the performance of the MC cartridge to be used, it is equipped with MC cartridge load switching of High / Low stage switching type.The equalizer amplifier uses a dual FET input DC servo circuit to eliminate coupling capacitors for both input and output. Moreover, Pioneer's new current mirror differential circuit (PAT. P.) and final stage SEPP enable ultra-low distortion that cannot be measured in the audible band from 20 Hz to 20 kHz.For cartridge load switching, the additional resistance and load capacity can be switched independently in 4 stages each.The tone control circuit is an NF type with first stage dual FET, new current mirror differential, and last stage emitter follower.In addition, it is equipped with a subsonic filter that can be activated even when the line straight switch is ON. This subsonic filter does not pass through the active element above the cutoff frequency, thus reducing the effect on sound quality.A new current mirror circuit is also employed in the front stage of the power amplifier, and a group transistor (EBT) with superior high-frequency characteristics is employed in the final stage to reduce distortion over a wide range.The power indicator lights red when the muting circuit is in operation and green when the muting circuit is in normal operation. The operation status can be confirmed.The Phono input terminal is gold-plated.

sections.overview: This pre-main amplifier was developed as the culmination of a fundamental review of the circuit, construction and physical properties, which are the origins of the amplifier, in order to respond to digital sources.The design philosophy of this amplifier is roughly divided into three points.First, each signal block is appropriately arranged in order to make the signal path the shortest distance. Second, thorough anti-vibration and anti-resonance measures are taken. Third, the drive performance of the speaker is improved at low load.We are solving various problems by investing various technologies in these areas.First, a structure called direct construction is adopted in order to make the signal path the shortest distance.By separating each circuit block and shielding the I/O block, adverse effects such as internal signal degradation and interference between signals can be prevented.The input block allows remote mechanical control of the Input & Recording Selector and the main volume to minimize signal routing. The input signal selected by the Input Selector does not flow to the front panel when the Source Direct Switch is turned ON, so you can enjoy even more pure sound.The power amplifier block is laid out along the signal flow and guides the output of the power stage directly to the speaker selector. Again, the distance from the power supply is the shortest.In the speaker selector block, the speaker terminals are directly attached to the circuit board on which the relay is attached so that the shortest speaker terminal A is given priority and the terminal A is placed on the lower side.In order to completely eliminate vibration and resonance, a resonance free construction method is adopted. Four types of honeycomb shapes are adopted, and vibration and resonance are totally reduced by combining the transformer part and volume system.Honeycomb made by punching is used for bottom plates and bonnet cases. For extruded aluminum honeycomb heat sinks to effectively suppress vibration and resonance of power transistors. Honeycomb made by resin molding is used for large honeycomb insulators to suppress external vibration.The transformer case is made of cast iron with high shielding effect, high rigidity, high internal loss, excellent vibration damping characteristics, and almost no resonance frequency. Pitch material with high thermal conductivity is filled between the case and the transformer body, and a heat radiation fan is installed to prevent the internal resistance of the transformer winding from increasing due to temperature rise.In addition, it uses a newly developed large-capacity sealed capacitor that is less susceptible to electromagnetic induction.Since sound quality is adversely affected by a structure in which a load is applied to the axis of the volume or vibration is generated, we have adopted a method of balancing the weight in both directions centering on the bearing of the rotary knob of the volume to prevent mechanical stress from being applied to the volume body. In addition, in order to minimize the effect of the vibration of the amplifier, the shield cover supporting the volume base is floated from the body part with special paper to absorb the resonance of 2 to 4 kHz which is harmful to sound quality.Non-switching circuit type III is adopted.This circuit is an upgraded version of Type II, in which switching distortion does not occur in principle, and has succeeded in suppressing thermal distortion by instantaneously stabilizing the idle current that drifts when the power switch is turned on, when a large signal is input, or when the outside temperature changes.In addition, detection and correction of input / output signal difference of the power stage is improved to reduce non-linear distortion. Furthermore, voltage amplification stage and power amplification stage are clearly separated. Since the power amplification stage concentrates on the speaker drive, there is no influence on the voltage amplification stage even at large output, and speaker drive performance at low load is improved.It uses a newly developed sealed capacitor in which the cathode of the aluminum electrolytic capacitor and the aluminum case are connected more securely. By strongly shielding the capacitor element, noise from the capacitor itself is eliminated, and high S/N is achieved.The Phono equalizer can be turned off when you do not listen to a record to prevent unwanted noise.In addition, the recording selector also has an OFF function, and the sound purity is enhanced by a simple circuit configuration.The equalizer uses a unique NF-CR type circuit to stabilize the operation in the mid - and high-frequency range, and uses low-noise Hi-gm FET to improve S/N.Copper plated parts are used for the rear panel and bottom plate to prevent electro-striction and vibration.The power cord is a thick oxygen-free copper power cord with polarity indication. This cord is made of insulating material with low dielectric constant to reduce the capacitance of the power cord, thus reducing the influence of external noise.In addition, the polarity of transformer windings is controlled to minimize noise coming through the cord.Uses parts that emphasize sound quality such as fuse for audio.Machined pure aluminum is used for rotary knobs and other parts.

sections.overview: Pre-main amplifier with super linear circuit.Semiconductor amplification devices such as transistors have inherent non-linearity (distortion). In order to eliminate this non-linear distortion, we have adopted a super linear circuit at the first stage of the power section.In this method, the non-linearity of the transistor and the non-linearity of the reverse mode are paired and canceled. This makes it possible to make the non-linearity of the transistor almost linear.As a result, we succeeded in reducing NFB to about 1/1000 of the conventional one because of improved bare characteristics, and solved the unstable factors such as TIM strain caused by NFB.In a class B amplifier, the transistor amplifier is switched in principle.In order to resolve this switching distortion and obtain high-purity sound quality, a non-switching circuit is installed in the power amplifier.This method uses a high-speed bias servo circuit to control the bias current according to the input signal to keep the transistor in an operating state at all times. As a result, the transistor does not switch and switching distortion is essentially 0.We also pursue 0 crossover distortion, carefully select transistors with high pair characteristics, and set the operating point to the optimum point to achieve input / output characteristics with high linearity and close to 0 crossover distortion.A DC servo circuit is used in the power amplifier section to cut out the unnecessary ultra-low frequencies that degrade sound quality without using a capacitor.This DC servo realizes a circuit configuration that does not use any coupling capacitor from the AUX or Tuner input to the SP output, eliminating the coloring of sound by the coupling capacitor.It is equipped with a line straight switch for more refined sound quality.Equipped with MM/MC switching function that can use MC cartridge.Equipped with a Rec Out selector, it is equipped with an indicator that shows at a glance which terminal of Rec1 or Rec2 is receiving the recording output.

sections.overview: A pre-main amplifier that employs a super-linear circuit to cancel out non-linear distortion of transistors.Taking note of the inherent nonlinearity (distortion) of semiconductors, we have adopted a super linear circuit in the first stage of the power section.The Super Linear Circuit, which is Pioneer's original technology, is a circuit that eliminates the non-linearity (distortion) of transistors without relying only on NFB (negative feedback) like conventional amplifiers. It is a circuit that sets a transistor with a reverse mode non-linearity in the non-linearity of the transistor and cancels the non-linearity by using a current mirror circuit to obtain an equivalent excellent linearity.As a result, the fundamental characteristics (bare characteristics) are improved, so that a large amount of negative feedback (NFB) does not need to be applied as in conventional systems, and it is reduced to about 10 dB, 1/1000 of the conventional level.As a result, the NFB-induced TIM distortion, degradation of frequency characteristics during phase correction, and instability in the high-frequency range are eliminated, and the inherent advantage of NFB, which produces output signals similar in shape to input signals, can be utilized.The power stage and driver stage are equipped with non-switching circuits in order to ensure sound quality without distortion.This method is based on Pioneer's proprietary high-speed bias servo circuit. By controlling the bias current according to the input signal, the transistor is always kept in an operating state. By this method, the transistor does not switch in principle, and switching distortion is essentially 0.We also pursue 0 crossover distortion and carefully select the transistors to be adopted. By using transistors with high pair characteristics and setting the operating point to the optimum point, input / output characteristics with output characteristics with higher linearity.A clean servo regulator is used to supply power to the first stage of the equalizer amplifier and power amplifier.Compared with the conventional serial control type, it is a parallel control type with a smaller output current loop. The impedance of the power supply becomes 0 equivalently, and the influence on other signal circuits is suppressed.As a result, crosstalk, such as signal leakage, is eliminated, resulting in higher sound quality.DC servo circuits are used for both the equalizer amplifier and the power amplifier.As a result, all coupling capacitors in the signal system from the MC input terminal to the SP output terminal are removed, and non-coupling capacitors are used in all stages.This suppresses the generation of phase shift and transient intermodulation distortion.It is equipped with a line straight switch in order to obtain more refined sound quality.MC cartridge can be used and MC/MM can be switched.In addition, MM / load capacity and MC / load resistance can be switched to bring out the performance of the cartridge.It is equipped with a subsonic indicator that notifies mixing of unnecessary ultra-low frequency (20 Hz) by light.It is equipped with a Rec Out selector and an indicator to let you know at a glance which terminal of Rec1 or Rec2 outputs the recording output.

This minimizes energy loss, which adversely affects sound quality, and realizes excellent power linearity, low load drive capability, and compact circuit.In addition, they are fixed extruded material heat sinks to eliminate mutual interference.The chassis is designed to be vibration-free and resonance-free.It uses an aero wing chassis that disperses and attenuates internal vibration, and stabilizers made of thick steel plates for the volume and transformer mounting parts. In addition, a newly adopted solid brass stabilizer made of solid brass is attached to the bottom of the chassis to improve the strength of the chassis and correct the left and right weight balance.In addition, copper-plated steel plates are used for the chassis and rear panel.Wide range linear circuit is used for the circuit structure.This circuit uses a simple circuit configuration to obtain the necessary gain by current feedback type one stage amplification. This circuit has excellent current linearity and enables a speaker drive with stable output impedance characteristics over a wide range.The power supply is equipped with a super-ring toroidal transformer.This transformer realizes a clean power supply because it has low loss and small ????????? inside the amplifier.In addition, custom parts developed through thorough trial listening are used for the smoothing capacitor.Equipped with SB (surround back) mode.This mode allows all tone control circuits to pass through, creating a simple circuit with only volume and power amplifiers, which can be used as a surround back amplifier.Uses an inlet type 3P extra-thick OFC power cord.Speaker terminal for banana plug is adopted.Uses gold-plated input / output terminals.Wireless remote control is included.

sections.overview: This pre-main amplifier of the UK series was developed and designed by Mr. John Bamford of the UK aiming at simplicity and straightness.Based on the concept of "Simple is best", it intentionally excludes tone control, balance control and headphone port.By reducing the number of auxiliary circuits, the contact points of the switch are reduced and wasteful routing of the signal path is greatly reduced.Newly developed wide range linear circuit is adopted.This circuit has a simple structure in which the required gain is obtained by a single-stage amplifier circuit. It has a feature that the output impedance is flat from the low band to the high band, enabling stable driving over a wide band.In addition, the low-load drive design improves the drive performance of the speaker at low load.The A-UK3, which was developed by further improving the amplifier released in the UK, uses a large volume with sound quality tuning in order to realize the expansion of low and high frequencies so that the sound spreads around the wide speaker.In order to eliminate resonance in the casing, a honeycomb structure with excellent rigidity is used for the heat sink that reduces vibration of the internal transformer. The same honeycomb structure is also used for the chassis and five insulators that support the casing to reduce the adverse effect of vibration on sound quality.In addition, the position of the screw stopper is determined based on computer simulation, and copper-plated screw with high vibration absorption rate is used for the position which is least affected by vibration.A simple circuit configuration is achieved by using only one speaker output system.On top of that, two terminals are provided for bi-wiring connection.A replaceable inlet system is used for the power cord.
