sections.title: PIONEER-EXCLUSIVE Pioneer
sections.overview: Pre-main amplifier with all stages directly connected circuit.The power amplifier section uses a 2-power supply system OCL circuit directly connected to all stages.Since no coupling capacitor or output capacitor is used between each stage, the small inductance of the capacitor does not adversely affect the wide-range characteristics. Moreover, there are no unstable elements such as oscillation caused by the coupling capacitor. Therefore, a large amount of NF can be applied, and the distortion is kept low over the band.The protection circuit is a combination of one power relay, seven transistors, and nine diodes.When the DC balance of the output stage is lost and the DC component flows, the differential amplifier detects this and cuts the relay circuit to protect the speakers.In addition, in the event of a trouble such as short-circuiting the speaker terminals or excessive current flowing in the output stage, the AC component of the output stage is detected and a protective circuit operates to protect the power transistor.This protection circuit also functions as a power muting, so that noise at the time of power-on is suppressed.In addition, this protection circuit is automatic recovery type, so it returns to normal condition when the trouble is solved.The head amplifier uses a 3-stage direct connection EE feedback circuit.The control amplifier uses a 3-stage direct-coupled circuit with a low-noise FET at the first stage.In addition, since the NFB circuit uses a tone selector to switch the elements in the circuit, accurate tone control is possible in 3 db steps.When the tone control is in the flat position, the tone is completely canceled.Equipped with Low and High filters with cutting characteristics of 12dB/oct.This eliminates unpleasant sounds at low frequencies, such as motor gobos and the hum component of program sources, and noise at high frequencies, such as record scratch noise.Equipped with two tape input / output systems.Two systems of Phono input terminals are mounted.The Phono2 has a MM-MC changeover switch and uses MC cartridges in addition to MM cartridges.In addition, by using the transformer for MC cartridge sold separately, it becomes possible to reproduce with higher quality MC cartridge.A microphone input jack is installed on the front panel.Two AUX inputs are installed.Equipped with an audio muting switch that lowers the output level by 20 dB.A switch on the rear panel allows you to separate the preamp and power amp sections.Center channel terminal for extracting L + R signal is mounted.

sections.overview: An authentic pre-main amplifier designed for ease of use.All stages of the power amplifier are connected to a semi-power complimentary service system. The first stage is equipped with an operation amplifier and an input bias compensation circuit to achieve high DC stability.The equalizer amplifier is a 2-stage direct-coupled system that combines a low-noise transistor with a low-noise resistor and a styrofoam capacitor to improve S/N and stability.CR-type tone control has been adopted, and in pursuit of component accuracy, the tone control knob has obtained characteristics with less waviness in the frequency characteristics in the flat position.

sections.overview: Stereo pre-main amplifier using pure complimentary service OCL ocL system directly connected to all stages.The equalizer uses a carefully selected PNP type low-noise transistor for the first stage and a 3-stage direct amplifier with an emitter follower circuit for the second stage.The high gain of the first stage satisfies the requirements for a low-noise, high-gain head amplifier.In order to completely suppress the deviation of the RIAA playback curve, the NFB element of the equalizer and the element of the part receiving NFB use nichrome evaporated metal film resistance with 1% error and styrene capacitor with 2% error.In the control amplifier section, an FET with high input impedance is used for the first stage, so no noise change occurs regardless of the adjustment position of the volume control.Bass and Treble are equipped with independent turn-over switches, each of which can independently select the turn-over frequency, so you can control the tone according to the characteristics and effect of the source.Equipped with a tone defeat switch that can select tone flat with one touch regardless of the turnover position or tone characteristics.The power circuit uses a direct-coupled pure complimentary service OCL system for all one stage differentials.In addition to the one stage differential amplifier, the bias temperature guarantee circuit at the first stage provides sufficient DC stability, so that the 0 potential at the output point does not collapse even with large temperature changes.In addition, the use of a large radiator and a power transistor with high breakdown strength provides a high degree of safety, and high power is obtained in a stable state.PNP and NPN transistors with the same pair characteristics are used for the driver and power transistor.In addition, the use of a large radiator, a current limiting circuit, and an electronic protective circuit increases the safety level.There are two circuits for the TapeMon jacks, and duplication is also possible.In addition, it is equipped with a two circuit speaker terminal which can play A, B, A + B individually or in combination.It has a built-in subsonic filter (5 Hz, 12dB/oct) to cut unwanted noise in the ultra low frequency range.The protective circuit is a combination of an electronic circuit and a power relay. An indicator lights when the protective circuit is activated.It also serves as a power muting to eliminate shock noise when the power supply is turned on.Attached is the measured data for each unit.

sections.overview: This is a stereo pre-main amplifier with an emphasis on output characteristics of wide-band and low distortion factor. It adopts a positive and negative two power supply system for all circuits, and a differential amplifier is installed in the first stage of each section.The equalizer consists of two can-shield transistors with little noise variation with time and two low-noise transistors for a first stage differential amplifier with three stage direct connection NFB.Since the differential amplifier can apply 100% of the DC NFB, the DC stability is improved, and by using carefully selected elements, high S/N and low distortion characteristics are obtained.By using nichrome evaporated metal film resistor (error of 1%) and Styrofoam capacitor (error of 2%) for NFB element and NFB receiving element of the equalizer, the accuracy of   0.2 dB is achieved in RIAA deviation of 30 Hz to 15000 Hz.There are two input circuits for both Phono and AUX. The level of Phono2 and AUX2 can be controlled for the straight input of Phono1 and AUX1.In particular, the Phono2 circuit is designed to control the level without affecting the input impedance and dynamic margin when using a high-output cartridge. This circuit is useful for alternate playback using two cartridges with different outputs or for comparative listening.By the positive and negative two power supply system, the input / output point is always kept near 0 potential, and the shock noise caused by switch switching is drastically reduced.The control circuit for the bass and treble is a twin-tone control that can be divided into the main and sub control.Main gain and loss characteristics of 1 kHz, Bass gain and loss characteristics of   10 dB at 100 Hz, and Treble gain and loss characteristics of   10 dB at 10 kHz are obtained.Sub can be controlled by   5 dB at 50 Hz for bass and   5 dB at 20 kHz for treble.By combining and controlling Main and Sub, approximately 2000 different tone characteristics can be created.A level setting mechanism is provided to eliminate the inconvenience of reducing the volume at night, when the volume is adjusted by a small control range near the MIN point of the volume control.This circuit can be switched in three stages of 0 dB, -15dB and -30dB, and the whole level can be attenuated according to this indication, so that it can always be adjusted in a useful rotation range near the center of the volume.The control section also uses a differential amplifier with 100% DC NFB at the first stage, and has a 3-stage direct connection NF type circuit configuration.A can-shield transistor is used in the first stage to obtain high reliability even with long-term aging.Equipped with a tone defeat switch that can immediately obtain flat characteristics.Low/High subsonic filters that cut sharply at 12dB/oct are built-in.The power circuit uses a one stage differential pure complimentary service OCL circuit.In addition, we have adopted PNP and NPN type drivers and power transistors selected according to the pair characteristics.In addition, a large radiator, a current limiting circuit, and an electronic protection circuit are employed to ensure that a large power can be obtained.It is equipped with a protective circuit combining an electronic circuit and a power relay.Equipped with an audio muting switch, the volume can be instantly reduced by -20dB.Equipped with speaker output jacks for enjoying A, B and A + B.In addition to the pre-main split switch, the power amplifier can also be equipped with a subsonic filter when it is separated. It is also fully equipped with various auxiliary circuits.Actually measured data is attached to each unit.

sections.overview: A pre-main amplifier with improved sound quality by adopting a two power supply system for all circuits and a differential amplifier in the first stage of each section.With the positive and negative two power supply system, the input / output point is always kept close to 0 potential, so the shock noise generated when the switch is switched is almost zero.This is especially important in the low-level section, such as the equalizer stage, where a high-gain amplifier is placed at the rear.The SEPP circuit is used for the output stage of the equalizer amplifier to increase the power utilization factor, to obtain high output with low distortion, to increase the allowable input, and to widen the dynamic margin.A differential amplifier is used in the first stage and 100% DC NFB is applied to achieve low distortion and excellent DC stability over a wide range.In addition, it is difficult to cause any deviation of the operating point for transient input.The transistor uses a carefully selected low-noise can-shield type to prevent noise from changing over time due to humidity.An NFB element for obtaining the RIAA curve and a Styrofoam capacitor (error 2%) and Nichrome evaporated metal film resistor (error 1%) with less error are used for the NFB receiving part.There are two input circuits for both Phono and AUX. Phono1 and AUX1 are straight and Phono2 and AUX2 are level control circuits.By applying the level control of the Phono2 in particular, you can adjust the level when comparing two types of cartridges with different output voltages using two players (or twin-tone arms).Since the level control is adjusted according to the amount of NFB, consideration is given so that the dynamic margin is not insufficient even when this control is reduced for a high-output cartridge.The input impedance of the Phono2 terminal can be selected in three levels : 25k  , 50k   and 100k  . The optimum value can be selected depending on the type of cartridge.Two tape decks can be connected simultaneously to enable tape-to-tape duplication as well as alternate playback by switching between switches.Both Bass and Treble have twin tone controls with smaller knobs on either side of each.Turning the large middle knob (main) provides general tone control, while turning the flat main knob and turning the small left and right knobs (sub) controls the very low and high ranges.In this way, by making the tone control capable of controlling two characteristics, it is possible to control characteristics that have not been possible until now.The Main and Treble can be controlled in 11 positions with 2 dB steps. Bass can be controlled by   10 dB at 100 Hz, and Treble can be controlled by   10 dB at 10 kHz.In the flat position, the NFB circuit has only a resistance without the capacitor, so the frequency characteristic becomes flat.The Sub control can be controlled independently of the Main control within   6 dB in 2 dB steps and 7 positions at 50 Hz for Bass and 20 kHz for Treble.When used in combination with Main, approximately 6000 types of controls are possible.Equipped with a tone defeat switch that flattens the frequency response by quick action regardless of the position of the main and sub control.Like the equalizer amplifier, the control amplifier uses a first stage differential 3-stage direct-coupled circuit to which DC NFB can be multiplied by 100%.The first stage differential amplifier uses a can-shield transistor with less noise variation over time, and uses highly reliable and carefully selected parts.The Low filter operates at 30 Hz, Subsonic, and Off in three stages, while the High filter operates at 12 kHz, 8 kHz, and Off in three positions, each at 12dB/oct, and sharply cuts unwanted ultra-low sound vibrations and tape hissing without losing the playback sound.In particular, the High filter is composed of L and C passive elements and has excellent transient characteristics, which tend to be problematic in high frequency bands.Equipped with a level set mechanism that can expand the adjustment range of volume.The set knob on the same axis as the main volume lowers the level to -15dB and -30dB. You can adjust the volume near the center (at an angle around 12 o' clock on the clock) even when listening at a low volume.Because the relationship between the volume level and the rotation angle of the volume changes when the level set is switched, the range of motion of the Loudness contour also changes in conjunction.At a level set knob of 0 dB, the loudness is active from the volume control Min to 40% (approximately 11 o' clock), at a point of -15dB, it is active up to 60% (approximately 1 o' clock), and at a point of -30dB, it is active over all rotations.All stages of the power amplifier are directly connected with pure complimentary service OCL circuit system. In addition, two stages of differential amplifier and bias guarantee circuit are used to obtain stability.The first stage differential amplifier is equipped with a can-shield transistor to prevent noise and other changes over time due to humidity.The power circuit receives two constant-current load circuits.This circuit suppresses changes in idle current due to fluctuations in power supply voltage, etc., eliminates transient crossover distortion, and provides playback sound with low distortion rate from high power to minute output.By inserting a current amplifier circuit between the constant current load circuit, the operating points of the two differential amplifiers can be selected optimally, reducing noise and increasing gain. Therefore, a large amount of NFB can be stably applied, so that low distortion and high power can be obtained over a wide bandwidth.Pure complimentary service pair transistors of driver and power stage are carefully selected PNP and NPN types with excellent characteristics.In addition to using materials with high breaking strength, we also use a large radiator, current limiting circuit and electronic protective circuit to improve stability and reliability of operation.Equipped with a full-scale protection circuit that combines relays and electronic circuits.When the protection circuit operates, the protection lamp on the front panel lights up to indicate an error.This protection circuit also functions as a power muting when the power is turned on, so that no shock noise is generated when the switch is turned on.The power supply section uses a highly regulated power transformer and 15,000 ? Fx2 large-capacity power supply capacitor, and the driver stage uses a constant voltage power supply circuit to eliminate unstable elements caused by the power supply.You can switch between three pairs of speakers (A, B and C), or two pairs of speakers (A + B and A + C) at the same time.In addition, the B position has a level control that allows you to control the volume of only the speakers connected to the B position. You can also compare two sets of speakers with different efficiency at the same level.Since the level control circuit is located before the power amplifier section, there is no change in the output impedance that drives the speaker system depending on the control.Basic performance such as power, distortion factor and residual noise was measured for all units, and the data is attached to each unit.

sections.overview: This is a pre-main amplifier equipped with twin tone control as well as improving the precision of each circuit for higher sound quality.The power amplifier section has one stage of differential amplifier and is equipped with a pure complimentary service OCL circuit directly connected to all stages with parallel push-pull configuration. By adopting parallel push-pull, linearity of current characteristics is improved, and distortion is suppressed to realize large output. In addition, since the pre-driver is a stabilized power supply, transient crossover distortion in minute output is eliminated.In addition, the stability of the circuit is improved by supplying   2 power supplies and adopting a differential amplifier. Furthermore, by installing a bias compensation circuit, the fluctuation of offset voltage is suppressed even with the change of external temperature, and the characteristics are further stabilized.The equalizer is a 3-stage direct-coupled circuit with   2 power supplies using a low-noise transistor at the first stage. By using the second stage as an emitter follower, a large gain can be obtained at the first stage, and a large amount of stable NFB is applied.In addition, by using   2 power supplies, the circuit is more stable and noise is prevented when switching, and by using carefully selected NFB elements with less deviation, the characteristics are improved.The flat amplifier in the control section is a 2-stage direct connection type by the combination of PNP-NPN. By applying NFB in both AC and DC, distortion can be reduced, and it can be sent to the tone circuit with low impedance, so that the tone circuit can operate under more ideal conditions.In addition, the stability of the midpoint potential is maintained by   2 power supply, and noise at switching is eliminated.The NF-type tone circuit is used, and Pioneer's original twin-tone control that can change the amount of NFB with a switch-type resistor with less deviation is used. This greatly expands the control function.In addition to the main control, this twin-tone control has sub controls. The main control can be adjusted by   8 dB in 2 dB steps, and the sub control can be adjusted by   6 dB in 2 dB steps. The main control can be used as a general tone control when only the main control is used. The sub control can be used as a general tone control when only the sub control is used to change only the very low and very high frequencies.In addition, a tone on/off switch is provided so that flat characteristics can be obtained.Two tape decks can be connected. sections.overview: This pre-main amplifier achieves high sound quality by using an excellent circuit structure and carefully selected high-precision parts.The EQ consists of a first stage differential, a 3-stage direct connection, a final stage class A operation pure complimentary service SEPP and two positive and negative power supplies. In addition, the NFB device for obtaining EQ deviation uses carefully selected elements such as a nichrome evaporated metal film resistor with a resistance error of   1% and a temperature characteristic of   50ppm/c, and a styrene capacitor with a capacitance error of   2%. These elements provide excellent characteristics.A voltage of   30 V is applied to this circuit. The maximum output of the equalizer amplifier is 18 V, the maximum allowable input is 300 mV, and the sensitivity is 2.5 mV. This circuit has a large dynamic margin.In order to maximize the performance of many cartridges, both Phono1 and 2 are equipped with cartridge load switching switches that can independently select 4 types of load resistance and 4 types of load capacity.The flat amplifier in the control section consists of a first stage differential and a two stage direct-coupled circuit. By using differential amplification in the first stage, the operating point is selected in the linear region of the transistor to reduce distortion.Both Bass and Treble use a twin-tone control with main and sub two variable positions. Variable uses a switch-type volume in 2 dB steps.A 32-step attenuator is used for the volume, and the gang error between the left and right channels is as small as 0.5 dB or less, and the error with the indicated value on the panel surface is within   0.5 dB.In addition, it is equipped with a muting lever of -20dB, and delicate volume adjustment is possible by combination.The power amplifier circuit is composed of   2 power supply, 2 stage differential amplifier current mirror circuit and final stage parallel push-pull pure complimentary service OCL circuit.The input is a differential amplifier to suppress voltage fluctuations due to changes in external temperature and to reduce distortion. The pre-driver stage is made to be a constant current by the current mirror circuit to increase bare characteristics and to reduce distortion with sufficient NFB, and at the same time, even order harmonic distortion is suppressed. The NFB loop from the output stage has a large time constant so that the circuit operation is similar to that of a DC amplifier and phase shift is reduced. The output stage is a parallel push-pull to stably take out a large output.The radiator uses an efficient chimney style to enhance thermal stability.The power supply section uses two power transformers with independent left and right channels, and consists of two heavyweight transformers and a 12,000 ? Fx4 large-capacity capacitor.With this two power transformer configuration, channel crosstalk is improved by eliminating channel interference at the power supply.The protection circuit consists of a highly reliable twin-contact power relay and a fast response electronic circuit.It also eliminates power-on clicks.It is equipped with auxiliary functions such as pre-power separation terminal, 2-system tape monitor, tone on-off switch, loudness contour, low-cut (subsonic) and high-cut filter.

sections.overview: A stereo pre-main amplifier developed by inheriting the design philosophy of SA-9900.Like SA-9900, it adopts a side terminal system in which input / output terminals are arranged on the left and right panels.As a result, the input terminal is completely integrated with the equalizer board to prevent degradation of the high-frequency characteristics caused by the shielding wire.The power amplifier section uses a pure complimentary service OCL circuit directly connected to all stages. It consists of a single stage differential with   2 power supplies and a parallel push-pull configuration.By making the load of the pre-driver constant current, the bare gain is increased, and by applying the optimum NFB, the distortion is reduced over a wide band. By using the power supply before the output stage as a stabilizing power supply, the transient crossover distortion at minute outputs is eliminated. By using the parallel push-pull output stage, the linearity of current characteristics is improved and distortion is reduced.In addition, a differential amplifier and a bias compensation circuit are adopted to improve stability, so that fluctuation of offset voltage due to external temperature change is minimized.The equalizer is equipped with a differential amplifier using a low-noise transistor can-shielded at the first stage to stabilize the output mid-point and improve the SN ratio. In addition, 100% DC NFB is applied to reduce distortion and improve stability.In addition, the final stage SEPP operates in class A operation until large amplitude, enabling high output voltage to be extracted at a low distortion rate.In addition, carefully selected high-precision elements are used to improve sound quality.There are two Phono inputs, one of which is capable of level adjustment up to -12dB and 4-point switching of input impedance.For level adjustment, NFB changes up to -6dB, and output volume changes from -6dB to -12dB.The tone circuit is a 2-stage direct-coupled circuit. By using FET in the first stage, noise variation due to volume position is minimized. In addition, NFB is applied to the 2-stage direct-coupled circuit in both AC and DC, and is sent to the tone circuit in the next stage with low impedance, making it an ideal condition for tone circuit operation.In addition, the voltage at the midpoint is stabilized by two power supply systems, plus and minus 24 v (total 48 v).The volume uses a full-scale attenuator type volume with 22 contacts, and the use of high-precision printing resistors reduces gang errors.It also has a 3-step lever type attenuator.NFB type tone control is adopted, and 3-step turnover frequency switching is adopted to expand the control range.It is also equipped with a tone on/off switch.It is equipped with a duplicate switch that can dub tapes 1 to 2 and 2 to 1.The power supply section is equipped with two large electrolytic capacitors of 18,000 ? sections.overview: A pre-main amplifier that pursues high output and low distortion and employs a unique side terminal system.The side terminal method is adopted. The input terminals are integrated with the equalizer board, and the shield line connecting the phono terminal and the equalizer terminal is eliminated to prevent degradation of the high-frequency characteristics due to stray capacitance of the shield line.All stages of the power amplifier are directly connected and pure complimentary service OCL circuit with 3-stage Darlington connection, and the output stage is parallel push-pull type.The 2-stage differential amplifier and bias compensation circuit provide sufficient stability by controlling the DC component to the speaker terminal even when there is a change in external temperature.The two constant-current circuits expand the operating range of the transistor and increase the bare characteristics of the circuit. Moreover, not only NFB from the output stage but also appropriate NFB is applied to the differential part to improve the bare characteristics.In addition, by applying NFB from the output stage, deterioration and instability of transient characteristics are eliminated. Furthermore, by providing a large time constant to this circuit, phase shift in the ultra-low frequency range is eliminated.The constant current circuit suppresses changes in the idle current due to fluctuations in the power supply voltage, and the newly developed bias supply method enables constant compensation for temperature differences between transistors caused by self-overheating of transistors, eliminating transient crossover distortion with a stable idle current from high power to minute output.In addition, by floating the emitter resistor of the driver stage from the midpoint and operating it as class A until very large amplitude, crossover distortion in this stage is eliminated.We use carefully selected power transistors with excellent characteristics and strong breaking strength. We also use a large radiator to prevent trouble. In addition, we use an electronic protective circuit using relays and a current limiting circuit.In addition, a newly developed temperature detection circuit is used to control the supply voltage of the output stage when the temperature of the radiator reaches 85   C or higher to keep the temperature of the radiator within a certain range.The first stage of the EQ circuit is a low-noise FET differential amplifier designed to stabilize the mid-point and reduce the audible noise level. The second stage voltage amplifier uses a constant current load to obtain a linear Takamasu depth and improve the distortion characteristics. The SN ratio is also improved by using a noise-selective transistor.The circuit is supplied with a high voltage of   48 v to ensure a sufficient dynamic margin, and the NFB element for the RIAA curve uses a Nichrome metal-coated resistor with very low error and a Styrofoam capacitor to obtain excellent characteristics.The level of the Phono2 input can be adjusted up to -12dB. Up to -6dB is done with an NFB circuit, and from -6dB to -12dB is done with the sy volume. When the input is limited to -6dB or more, the maximum allowable input becomes approximately twice as large as 1 V.Also equipped with 4-point switching impedance switching.In the first stage of the control circuit, an FET differential amplifier that can apply 100% of DC NFB is installed, and   48 v is supplied by a 2-power supply system. The SN ratio is raised by the adoption of FET, and click noise when switching is prevented by the 2-power supply system.As well as the equalizer circuit, the voltage amplifier circuit uses a constant current load to improve the bare characteristics of the circuit. Moreover, since no bootstrap circuit is used, the phase characteristics and transient characteristics in the low frequency range are improved.The tone circuit uses a twin-tone control method, which allows general tone control for the main only operation, ultra-high and ultra-low frequency control for the sub only operation, and a wide range of control by combining the main and sub.For these two controls, the main is NFB type and the sub is CR type, and a tone control on/off switch is installed.The volume is a true attenuator-type volume with a 22-contact high-precision printed resistor with 2 dB-step decibels for direct reading of attenuation, illuminated by an edge light.Also equipped with a lever type attenuator that can be switched to 3 stages.The power supply section is equipped with two 22,000 ? F large electrolytic capacitors.Equipped with 2-step switching type low-cut / high-cut filter.It is equipped with a duplicate switch. By turning on the switch, you can copy tapes from 1 to 2 and from 2 to 1.Data on actual measurement of each product is attached to each product.

A professional studio monitor speaker system developed for small control rooms and editing.In addition to inheriting the design philosophy of the model2401twin and model2402, we are pursuing sound that can respond to a wide range of genre sources by responding to the diversification of music sources and high quality sound.A 25 cm cone woofer TAD TL-1102 is mounted in the low range.The diaphragm is a composite cone made of natural pulp, which has undergone an aging process, laminated with a special film, and coated with a special damping paint.In addition, the magnetic circuit uses an internal magnetic type with an Alnico magnet that can reduce the second harmonic distortion in principle. By designing with a margin for the magnet operating point, the sensitivity drop due to demagnetization at high power is also kept low.Furthermore, in order to stabilize the transmission of driving force, the yoke and plate of the magnetic circuit are integrally molded by a special casting method, and the center pole is also screwed to the yoke. This improves the synthesis of the magnetic circuit by approximately four times.The driver unit TAD TD-2002 and the compact design horn TAD TH-2002 are mounted in the high range.The TD 2002 uses a lightweight and highly rigid 4.8 cm beryllium diaphragm and an alnico magnet with a magnetic flux density of approximately 20,000 Gauss to achieve excellent linearity. In addition, the phasing plug, which prevents phase disturbance of sound waves, uses an annular slit type that facilitates phase matching in ultra-high frequencies. The power supply section has been reviewed and the terminal on the diaphragm assay is now a direct power supply terminal that directly goes out of the back cover. This reduces the influence of internal AC magnetic flux and sound pressure and provides clear sound quality.The TH-2002 is a horn whose directivity is controlled by wave-front control technology. The directivity angle is set to 60   horizontally and 30   vertically in consideration of small-capacity monitor rooms. In addition, by adopting an asymmetric vertical horn based on the Asymmetrical Pattern, Axis & Level (APAXIAL) method, smooth output-sound pressure characteristics are obtained, and directivity control in the vertical direction is actively performed. This reduces the influence of reflection from the top of the enclosure or from the ceiling and provides clear orientation. In addition, by adopting AFAST (Acoustic Filter Assisted System Tuning) to suppress the resonance characteristic of the horn, the sound is absorbed by the acoustic tube installed in the upper part of the horn, and the back and forth movement of sound image due to pitch (sound height) is eliminated, and the articulation of reproduced sound is improved.Sold separately, there was a special speaker stand for model2251 for listening.The dedicated speaker stand CP-2251 uses a 3-point support system regardless of the flatness of the ground surface to ensure stability. It is also constructed in a triangular shape with a thick wooden frame so that the sound quality is not adversely affected by resonance or sound reflection.You can adjust the sound quality by making the triangular bottom face or top face face to the listening position, or by supporting the point with the attached wooden pole.There was a dedicated CGR speaker cable, TAD TC-105, to match the model2251 CGR (Capacitive Gap Reduction) system.Two 4-core conductors are connected to each other to form a + wire and a - wire. The amount of attenuation is reduced by careful selection of constituent materials. In addition, the structure has a braided ground wire on the sheath side and a center ground wire in the center of the 4-core conductor to eliminate the influence of unnecessary current.

sections.overview: This is a pure malt speaker system that uses TAD technology to further improve sound quality.Pioneer established the Environmental Protection Promotion Committee in 1991 and has been working on three visions : Safety (no toxic substances), Cleanliness (no waste), and Ecology (no use of limited resources). The Pure Malt Speaker Series was developed in collaboration with Suntory.Casks made of hard white oak, more than 100 years old, are used to mature whiskies for about 50 years. A pure malt speaker recycles the barrel's side plate as an enclosure, which, unlike a freshly cut plate, has a soft, lingering sound when tapped.The enclosure color is celtee oak, the color of the hardened barrel.In addition, the barrel laminated wood used for the enclosure is made with the same straight grain cutting method as that used for high-class furniture. The natural pattern called "Toraki" can be seen. In addition, each piece has a different character, such as the nail marks of the barrel and the stain marks of the whiskey, which are unique features of the barrel side plate made with the barrel side plate. Each piece has a different character.A 10 cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.The diaphragm uses a pulp diaphragm that inherits the know-how of TAD. This diaphragm is made by a busy process of finely grinding rare pulp, making it with high-quality water, and producing it in a special single-cavity mold. It achieves the high rigidity and internal loss characteristic of natural materials, and the concentric corrugation ribs increase the diaphragm strength and enable sound with good response.The edge part uses foamed polycarbonate urethane which is a new material that is light and excellent in internal loss, and the reproducibility of minute sound is improved by the TAD traditional corrugation shape with excellent linearity.A bass-reflex system is used for the enclosure, and a hollowed-out duct made material is used for the duct.The speaker terminals come directly out and are firmly attached to the back plate of the enclosure.Grill net comes with 2 kinds of variation and you can choose from 2 of deep red and deep green according to your preference.A portion of the sales of these speakers was donated to the Green Fund of the National Land Afforestation Promotion Organization.

sections.title: PIONEER-EXCLUSIVE Pioneer
sections.overview: A Series speaker system developed with the theme of home theater and home concert hall.Two 16 cm cone type woofers are installed in the lower range.The cone uses Kevlar fiber. In order to realize an ideal unit material, the thickness, direction of fiber and cutting are taken into consideration, and satin weave is used. In addition, nonwoven fabric of aramid fiber is used for the mat material, and the contradictory elements of rigidity and internal loss required as a speaker unit are balanced at a high level.A 13 cm coaxial type unit is installed in the middle and high range.This unit combines a 13 cm cone type mid-range and a 3 cm dome type tweeter. The mid-range diaphragm uses Kevlar fiber.In addition, Pioneer has introduced the HSDOM (Harmonized Synthetic Diaphragm Optimum Method) for the tweeter. By analyzing the material, shape, edge, etc. of the diaphragm using the finite element method with a computer, it is designed to maximize each function and performance. By combining piston motion and divided vibration in a well-balanced manner, ultra-high frequency reproduction is achieved. The diaphragm of this tweeter uses a 20-micron titanium oxide diaphragm, and ultra-high frequency reproduction up to 50 kHz is achieved.It is equipped with a ribbon-type super tweeter for ultra-high frequency and realizes ultra-high frequency reproduction up to 120 kHz.The enclosure uses a bass reflex system.In addition to increasing the strength of the baffle plate and top plate, we have placed reinforcing plates at the optimum position inside to thoroughly suppress unnecessary vibration generated by each unit.In addition, the S-A7 introduces Reflection Free Alignment ( ) layout and Acousitcal Filter Assited System Tuning (AFAST) technology.The   layout reduces the effect of sound reflected from the floor surface on the woofer. When the woofer is placed with a large talk from the floor surface, the difference in distance between the sound that directly reaches the ear from the woofer and the sound that is reflected from the floor surface and reaches the ear becomes large, preventing the undulation of the sound pressure in the low middle range due to interference.AFAST technology uses an acoustic tube inside the enclosure to absorb standing waves and resonance sounds to suppress unwanted box sounds, and to eliminate backward and forward movement of sound images due to pitch fluctuations.Uses a large gold plated input terminal.

sections.overview: This speaker system was developed as a new-generation reference for high-definition media such as DVD audio by applying the technology and experience accumulated in the past.This speaker uses AFAST (Acoustic Filter Assisted System Tuning) technology.By using an acoustic tube in the enclosure and in the horn opening, it suppresses unnecessary box ringing by absorbing standing waves and resonance sound, and eliminates unstable back and forth movement of sound image due to fluctuation of pitch (sound height), thus enhancing clear reproducibility.A 25 cm cone type woofer is installed in the low range.The diaphragm is made of cone paper equivalent to the TAD unit which is well known as a studio monitor speaker. It is mixed with Kevlar and subjected to aging treatment so that the sound quality is sufficiently tuned.A 3 cm compression driver and an AFAST horn are installed in the high range.The compression driver is a high-efficiency design incorporating TAD design know-how. It uses a lightweight and highly rigid 3 cm edge-wise voice coil to reproduce sound with excellent response.In addition, AFAST technology has been introduced into the horn, and by mixing copper powder, both strength and internal loss are increased, and resonance is suppressed by increasing weight.A ribbon-type super-tweeter has been newly developed and installed in order to reproduce the ultra-high frequency range that DVD audio enables.By adopting a magnetic circuit using neodymium magnet and aluminum ribbon, it is possible to reproduce ultra-high frequency range up to 120 khz with high efficiency.Each unit is fixed from the rear of the enclosure to provide high resolution and high dynamic range.In the network section, high-quality sound parts are used for wiring cords, choke coils, capacitors, and terminals, and a dividing network is used to reduce loss and leakage. Special attention is paid to paid to the phase characteristics between units to achieve smoothness as a system.It is also equipped with switching terminals for bi-wiring connection, bi-amplifier connection and multi-amplifier drive.Equipped with 3-position switching type level control for tweeter.It is designed in pursuit of the ideal speaker system of "the enclosure does not sound but only the diaphragm".First of all, strength is improved by adopting a trapezoidal structure, and in addition, unnecessary resonance is suppressed by a three layer structure sandwiching special damping material.In addition, acoustic tubes based on AFAST technology, a further development of Pioneer's TAD professional studio monitor technology, are placed inside the enclosure to significantly reduce the amount of sound absorbing material and eliminate the generation of standing waves, which has been considered a weak point of the tall boy type (patent pending).In addition, it has a separate structure with a trapezoidal enclosure divided into upper and lower parts, a special ceramic speaker base weighing 24 kg, and a round form method.The bass reflex structure provides sound paths in all directions from the lower part of the enclosure and dimples on the base for natural low sound reproduction.

sections.title: PIONEER-EXCLUSIVE Pioneer
sections.overview: Based on wave front control technology and high-speed technology, this speaker system was developed by introducing new high-sensitivity technology in order to realize more realistic sound field and sound image reproducibility.Two 25 cm cone type woofers with ALCC (alginate composite cone) diaphragm are used for the low range.This diaphragm is made of a mixture of alginic acid fiber to increase the bonding strength between high-strength polyarylate fiber and pulp. Alginic acid fiber extracted from seaweed such as kelp works as a binder for both, improving the bonding strength and obtaining high rigidity and internal loss.The magnetic circuit uses a double anti-magnetic magnet with a canceling magnet and drives at a magnetic flux density of 14,300 Gauss. In addition, the T-shaped pole provides a symmetrical magnetic flux distribution and provides excellent power linearity even when the voice coil is large in amplitude.The damper uses a butterfly type damper with low mechanical loss and air resistance and excellent initial motion sensitivity. Combined with a lightweight woofer diaphragm, this damper enables accurate responses even to minute inputs.A horn type tweeter is used for the high frequency range.The driver is equipped with a rear type compression driver.This is the same system as the Technical Audio Devices (TAD) unit and Exclusive S5. The sound guided by the fading plug adjacent to the diaphragm is collected at the center of the outlet and emitted from the horn at once. This rear type has excellent phase and high-frequency characteristics because the length of the sound path is the same for each sound path.The diaphragm is made of highly responsive 3 cm diameter titanium, and the back cover is made of aluminum die cast.In addition, the horn section uses a newly designed slant angle oval wave horn that is integrally molded with the front port. When set to the front, the horn flare has an inclination of 10 degrees, and both L and R tweeters face inward respectively, so that more natural sound field and sound image localization can be obtained at the central listening point.In addition, the horn has an oval shape with a soft curved surface, so that it has a wide horizontal directivity and a wider listening area for stereo playback.The horn is made of aluminum die-cast with high rigidity and high molding accuracy to ensure vibration control so that the horn itself does not generate excessive vibration.The network is distributed specifically for the unit for sound quality, and the network board is floating from the enclosure to avoid vibration.A full midship mount is adopted to prevent vibration of the unit from being transmitted to the baffle.Both the woofer and tweeter are firmly secured inside the enclosure to prevent unwanted vibration of the baffle.The enclosure takes advantage of the bass reflex effect for higher efficiency and has ports on the front and rear baffles. In addition, ports are provided at the same position so that they pass through the front and rear baffles to disperse the anti-resonance of the port.In addition, a large capacity enclosure (72L) is adopted to fully demonstrate the performance of the unit, and the depth is enlarged to improve the low-frequency characteristics.In addition, by rounding the corner of the baffle to a large extent, the wavefront diffraction is controlled, thereby reducing the diffraction phenomenon.The enclosure is made of high-density particle board with a Reed-Dark-Brown finish.

sections.overview: This speaker system was developed with the concept of high sensitivity and high efficiency, inheriting the design philosophy of TAD (Technical Audio Devices) and Exclusive S5 in search of the reality of the original sound.Two 25 cm cone type woofer using ALCC (alginic acid composite cone) diaphragm is used for the low range.This ALCC diaphragm is made by mixing alginic acid fiber and papermaking in order to increase the bonding force between high strength polyarylate fiber and pulp. Alginic acid fiber extracted from kelp and other seaweeds acts as a binder to increase the bonding force.In addition, the magnetic circuit uses a double magnet magnetic circuit with a canceling magnet, and achieves a high magnetic flux density of 14,300 gauss. In addition, a T-shaped pole is used to obtain a uniform magnetic flux density from front to back, improving the linearity of amplitude against input.In addition, in order to improve response at the time of Oire force and Dainyu force, we have adopted a butterfly-type damper with a revised shape.A horn type tweeter is used for the high range.The horn driver is equipped with a rear-type compression driver that provides high resolution and excellent linearity.This compression driver uses the same method as TAD and Exclusive S5. The sound emitted from the diaphragm is guided to the center by a fading plug designed based on fluid dynamics research. The sound is compressed and radiated from the horn. In particular, since the diaphragm is a rear type with the sound generating direction on the rear side, the length of the sound path of the fading plug is the same. There is no phase disturbance of the sound from each slit, and the high-frequency characteristics are excellent.The diaphragm of this driver is made of 3 cm titanium nitride, and a back cover made of aluminum die-cast with excellent vibration resistance is attached to the back of the diaphragm to prevent unnecessary vibration.The horn section is equipped with a large oval wave horn designed with a flared shape to send out spherical waves, thereby realizing a natural sound spread close to a point source.In addition, by rounding the horn opening, the reflection of sound is reduced and the sound is smoothly connected to the outside. The horn shape is oval-shaped, so the horizontal directivity is wide and natural sound can be obtained in a wide range of listening points.For the material of this horn, aluminum die-cast with high molding accuracy and excellent vibration control is adopted.In addition, AFAST (Acoustic Filter Assisted System Tuning), a new technology introduced in TAD, has been introduced, and a resonator is installed in the upper part of the horn. This makes it possible to smooth out changes in phase and to obtain more precise sound localization and reproduction sound.In the network section, only elements with a low distortion factor are carefully selected and distributed to each unit to prevent temporal interference between units.In addition, the network board is floated from the enclosure to isolate vibration from each unit.In order to prevent unwanted vibration of the baffle from adversely affecting playback sound, the tweeter woofer is fixed by Pioneer's unique midship mounting method.By fixing the unit inside instead of the baffle, unnecessary vibration of the baffle is reduced.The enclosure has two ports on the front to take advantage of the bass reflex effect that enhances the low range.Compared to a single port of the same area, there is less mid-range leakage from the enclosure and less noise turbidity due to interference from the unit.In addition, since the opening uses a special R-shaped elastic body, there is little wind noise and sound waves are emitted smoothly.Furthermore, in order to improve the low-frequency characteristics, it is a large-capacity enclosure with an internal volume of 100L, and the extremely thick baffle is used as a round baffle to prevent the sound diffraction phenomenon.In addition, the material is acoustically examined high-density particle board, and the finish is a flower-like finish in Redish dark brown color.There is an attenuator that can adjust the high-frequency level at the bottom of the input terminal. It can be adjusted according to the condition of the room with 2 positions of Normal/Decrease.

sections.overview:
3,000,000 (1 unit, released in October 2003)

TAD (Technical Audio Devices), which was launched in 1975, developed a high-end speaker system as the ultimate home use speaker for every environment, from conventional audio playback to playback of high-resolution formats such as DVD-Audio and SACD.Led by Mr. Andruw Jones, a speaker engineer who has traveled between KEF and Infinity, an American R & D center, a Pioneer TAD development team, and an international engineering team consisting of Tohoku Pioneer were formed. The Japanese TAD development team was in charge of the speaker unit, and Andruw Jones was in charge of the total coordination and speaker system.Two 25 cm cone woofers are installed in the low range, and 20 cm cone woofer is installed in the middle and low range.The newly developed OFGMS (Optimized Field Geometry Magnet Structure) magnetic circuit is used for the magnetic circuits of Woofer and Midbus. In order to eliminate the non-linear component caused by the magnetic circuit which remains slightly in the conventional short voice coil type magnetic circuit, the magnetic flux density in the magnetic circuit is made uniform by providing a slit in the plate located outside the voice coil.It is equipped with 16 cm and 3.5 cm CST coaxial units for mid - and high-range and high-range.The CST (Coherent Source Transducer) driver has a structure in which a mid-range cone designed to the optimum shape is placed in the director part in the directional control of the tweeter. This structure solves the response problem of phase and axis deviation of the conventional driver. In addition, by making the phase of the tweeter and mid-range the same, the sound is reproduced with the same sound balance over a wide band from the center of the CST in any direction axially symmetric.The diaphragm is made of beryllium, which is also used in professional TADs. By using a vapor deposition method for manufacturing, the combination of particles realizes high rigidity and internal loss that are unthinkable for metals. The diaphragm resonance of the drive unit is pushed out of the audible reproduction band and the reproduction accuracy is improved.The enclosure uses Structurally Inert Laminated Enclosure Technology (SILENT enclosure). Constructed from more than 50 individually fabricated layers of birch plywood, each part is rigorously designed to prevent standing waves in the cabinet, making it less susceptible to unwanted vibrations from Woofer reaction forces and sound pressure due to the lack of cabinet joints.In addition, the ISO (Isolation) Drive technology has been introduced so that the top of the speaker with the CST is separated from the bottom of the speaker, which is the bass enclosure, and the CST itself is mounted to isolate vibration from the top enclosure, which fully insulates the CST driver from unwanted vibrations generated by the bass speakers and resonance of the cabinet.

sections.title: PLATINUM AIRPULSE3-1
sections.overview:
20,000,000 (2 units 1 set, sold in September 1997)

An all-horn speaker system developed by Platinum Audio using an innovative design method.The Air Pulse 3.1 is a three way electrical and four way acoustic system. It is large in size to achieve multi-high-quality, deep bass playback. For this reason, it is constructed as a modular system consisting of three subassemblies for ease of transportation and installation.The top and bottom of the three modules are identical low-frequency horns and contain a low-medium / low-frequency unit. The middle module consists of two mid-low horns coupled to the low-medium / low-frequency unit and an intermediate / high-frequency horn assembly sandwiched between them.You can rotate the low-range horns according to the listening room condition and preference.Two 30-cm cone type woofers are installed in the low and mid low ranges. The front of the diaphragm is used for the mid and low range horn and the back is used for the low range horn.The diaphragm is made of a laminated, specially made composite material that provides complete piston motion over the entire playback band and uses a magnet assembly weighing 11 kg and a voice coil of 100 mm diameter.This unit does not use an electrical crossover network to separate the low and mid-low frequencies, but determines the playback band by accurately calculating the acoustic cut-off points of the low and mid-low frequency horns. In the case of a low-frequency driver, the combination of the inductance generated by the volume of air in contact with the diaphragm and the capacitance generated by the acoustic reactance of the horn throat forms an acoustic filter equivalent to a two pole network, which determines the upper frequency limit for playback. By matching this with the cut-off frequency of the mid-low frequency horn, the mid-low frequency crossover is achieved. By using this system, excess parts can be eliminated, distortion can be reduced, and transient characteristics and phase characteristics are improved.The low-frequency horn uses a split composite horn that is designed to operate as a corner horn, extending the cut-off frequency to approximately 20 Hz. The shape of the horn is a 3.5m hyperbolic exponential horn with a spiral shape and a moderate aperture.The horn is driven by air vibrations fed into a slotted cylinder at the back of the low-frequency unit, and by carefully matching the air load to the throat between the diaphragm and horn throat, a flat response within the regeneration band is achieved.The throat to diaphragm pressure ratio is set at 3 : 1 as the optimum value to match the elastic modulus of the woofer diaphragm.The mid-range and low-range horns use an omnidirectional radiation type horn that uses the front surface of a woofer cone for output. The horn is a 812 mm diameter horn cut from a block of laminated wood and reproduces the 125 Hz to 900 Hz band.The mid-range is equipped with a 10-cm dome mid-range with an aluminum-alloy diaphragm. Similar to the mid-range horn, the horn emits sound from the laminated wood in all horizontal directions.A 9.5 cm ring type tweeter with an aluminum alloy diaphragm is mounted in the high range. By using a unique frame structure and upper and lower horn parts, sound is radiated in all horizontal directions.Copper clad aluminum flat ribbon wire is used for the 75 mm diameter voice coil.The 3-band crossover network is housed in a pedestal.All components of capacitors, coils and resistors used in this network are individually selected and of the highest quality available. All connections are made with pure silver wire and silver joints are used for soldering.The network circuitry is isolated from the enclosure to eliminate the effects of acoustic energy within the enclosure.The enclosure is made possible by the cooperation of a woodworking expert, Scott Schmidt, whose work is housed in the New York City Galleria d'arte moderna di Firenze.All wood components of Air Pulse 3.1 are made of the best available materials. The mid-range and high-range horns are made of special laminated wood. The horns are carved out of blocks of these laminated wood and cause little resonance. All baffles are precisely machined by a woodworking machine (computer-controlled NC multi-head lauter CMS PF102R8).The spiral-shaped wall of the low-frequency horn is made from a combination of high-density fiberboard, phenolic resin, high-mass elastomeric dump material, and wood, providing very high rigidity and non-resonance.

sections.title: PLATINUM REFERENCE1
sections.overview: This bookshelf type speaker system was announced as a super tuned model based on the basic design of the Platinum Solo.It is equipped with a 9 cm metal cone type woofer in the low range and a 2.5 cm metal dome type tweeter in the high range.These units are designed for the Solo/Duo and are selectively used within   0.5 dB of the characteristic deviation so that the total frequency characteristic is kept within   1 dB.The network section uses metalized PP capacitors and other high-quality parts. In particular, the coil uses an air-core type with a special structure in which a wide copper foil is wound in the form of a tape. This coil has frequency-reactance characteristics that are very close to those of an ideal inductor. In addition, there is no degradation of high-frequency linearity due to the skin effect, making it possible to minimize electrical loss and compression.In addition, the heat generated by the resistance element is discharged from the heat sink installed on the back of the network to suppress the temperature rise of the network.The enclosure uses a new material, Abonite Solid.With a specific gravity approximately 2.6 times that of MDF, Abonite Solid has a texture and feel similar to that of marble. Moreover, it is homogeneous and stable unlike natural materials. This material is used in a 2-ply (26 mm thick) and is assembled into a tough box structure.In addition, by adopting die-cast rear baffle and top / bottom plate, excellent rigidity and damping effect are realized.The exterior is polished to make use of the texture of Abonite.The sound is tuned with the front grill attached, and the grill is non-detachable.

sections.title: PRIMARE MODEL302
sections.overview: A CD player developed as a pair player based on the design concept of the full balance integrated amplifier Model301L.The pickup mechanism performs linear tracking operation by straight sledge method, and the servo mechanism that controls the operation of the mechanism is equipped with a digital servo system unique to Primer. Since various servo characteristics are controlled by software control, reliability that is difficult to adjust manually is acquired and stable operation is realized.In addition, silicon rubber material is used for mounting the entire pickup part to reduce propagation of internal vibration.The digital and analog sections are provided as separate power sources to reduce mutual interference. The analog section has a large-capacity custom-made power transformer with independent left and right channels from the secondary winding to eliminate crosstalk caused by the power source.Taking advantage of this design, we have adopted a fully balanced transmission that amplifies + and - signals under the same conditions and bridges them out.The analog section is assembled with carefully selected parts. In addition, the standby function, which can only turn off the power of the digital section, keeps the power continuously energized to keep the best condition.The D/A conversion circuit uses the Bar-Brown 20-bit Sine Magnitude D/A converter PCM1702. The Sine Magnitude method eliminates the 0 cross distortion, the biggest problem in multi-bit conversion, by independently converting the + / - waveform of the signal.The Model302 realizes multi-bit conversion by arranging the PCM1702 independently on the left and right channels, so that the effect of high-frequency noise is less than that of the single-bit method and the performance of the multi-bit method which can directly convert disk information is brought out.The digital filter is 20-bit 8-times oversampling to reduce waveform errors due to requantization.As an analog filter, we have succeeded in obtaining natural sound quality by using a GIC filter with a gentle third order curve. The GIC filter has the advantage of using an active element but not generating distortion or noise because the signal passes through only passive elements.The chassis has a housing structure with a 10 mm thick front panel separated from the main body, which increases the rigidity of the chassis as a whole and prevents digital noise from the display from being transmitted to the audio circuit.It comes with a remote controller that enables basic operation and display on/off.

sections.title: PROCEED PCD
sections.overview: CD player for better sound quality and higher reliability.The internal circuit board consists of the transport section, power supply section, decoder section, D/A converter to analog output section, and display control section. These circuit boards are placed with sufficient space between them to eliminate interference between elements and circuits that can cause sound quality degradation. They are also placed adjacent to each other at an angle of 90 degrees.Since these boards are plug-in type, it is possible to upgrade by exchanging each circuit board.The internal structure of the PCD is a rigid frame structure using aluminum pull-out material with a transport mechanism at the center. This is based on the same principle as that used in building construction. It does not generate resonance for both high-frequency and low-frequency vibrations, and works effectively for vibration control.The cabinet interior of the PCD, including the frame structure, is coated with conductive paint and anti-rust treatment to prevent accumulation of static electricity.The transport mechanism is Philips' CDM1MKII.It is equipped with an 18-bit monolithic D/A converter from Bar Brown for the highest quality audio. In addition, to minimize noise and distortion, each DAC is fully tested for power supply, and the MSB is carefully adjusted as installed prior to shipment.The digital filter uses a high-precision type with 8 times oversampling.Oversampling to avoid quantization noise may lead to resolution degradation due to jitter distortion if the oversampling is too high, so PCD selects 8 x oversampling to maximize the sound quality advantage of the technology at that time.Each circuit of the PCD, including the D/A converter circuit, is a hybrid system with selected elements to achieve the best performance, and the PCD uses a continuous power supply system to maximize the performance of the parts.The main power switch is located on the back panel of the unit and normally uses the standby power switch on the front panel to ensure stable operation of each part.The power supply section is equipped with a power supply circuit equivalent to a high-precision measuring instrument, incorporating Mark Levinson's expertise in preamp design. To prevent interference between circuits via power supply lines, a total of 13 power supplies are supplied, and 12 of them are regulated independently. For example, in the audio output circuit alone, a total of four regulation circuits are provided to supply power independently to the plus and minus channels of the left and right channels.We have also made unique efforts to reduce the impedance of the grounding circuit and to set the optimum grounding point.One unbalanced and one balanced analog output terminal and one coaxial digital output terminal are installed.It comes with a wireless remote control that allows you to operations except power ON/OFF and disk tray IN/OUT.

sections.overview: Based on the D/A converter circuit and analog audio circuit developed for PCD, a D/A converter was developed by adding a unique interface circuit.In a PDP, the interface circuit at the input stage improves the digital signal.In this circuit, the input signal passes through a top-of-the-line pulse transformer for computers and is fed into a proprietary DAS receiver circuit, which removes any distortion from the transmission path and adjusts the waveform to a shape close to the original signal before sending it to the D/A converter stage.The analog circuits incorporate as much as possible the results of Mark Levinson's amplifier development.In addition, the power supply circuit for PCD is adopted as it is, and PDP with less load compared with PCD realizes a sufficient power supply.There are four types of digital input jacks, a coaxial Route 3 and a balanced one, which can be selected with the select switch on the front panel. The selected digital signal automatically determines the sampling frequency and displays the corresponding frequency from among 32, 44, and 48.In addition to one unbalanced and one balanced output terminal, a coaxial digital output terminal is also installed.This digital output does not directly output the input digital signal, but is output after the waveform is adjusted by the DAS receiver in the interface circuit of the input stage.
